from hashlib import sha256

from django.db import transaction

from .models import Notification, NotificationEmailOutbox


def notify_many(employees, notification_type, title, message, link=None, created_by=None):
    """Create notices in batches without inserting once per employee."""
    employee_ids = dict.fromkeys(employee.pk for employee in employees if employee)
    return Notification.objects.bulk_create([
        Notification(employee_id=pk, notification_type=notification_type, title=title,
                     message=message, link=link or '', created_by=created_by)
        for pk in employee_ids
    ], batch_size=100)


def notify(employee, notification_type, title, message, link=None, created_by=None):
    """Tạo 1 thông báo cho 1 nhân viên. Gọi hàm này ở bất kỳ đâu cần báo tin."""
    if not employee:
        return None
    return Notification.objects.create(
        employee=employee,
        notification_type=notification_type,
        title=title,
        message=message,
        link=link or "",
        created_by=created_by,
    )


@transaction.atomic
def notify_with_email_draft(
    employee, notification_type, title, message, link, email_subject, email_body,
    created_by=None, idempotency_key=None,
):
    """Create an in-app notice and, if an address exists, an Outlook mail draft.

    Mail is never sent by the server. Locking the employee row serializes duplicate
    event handling for this recipient; the unique key remains the final DB guard.
    """
    if not employee:
        return None, None

    from apps.hrm.models import Employee

    recipient = Employee.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=employee.pk)
    raw_key = idempotency_key or f"{notification_type}:{link or ''}:{recipient.pk}"
    if len(raw_key) > 200:
        raw_key = f"{notification_type[:40]}:{sha256(raw_key.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()}"

    email = (recipient.company_email or recipient.personal_email or "").strip()
    existing = NotificationEmailOutbox.objects.filter(idempotency_key=raw_key).select_related(
        "notification"
    ).first() if email else None
    if existing:
        return existing.notification, existing

    notification = notify(recipient, notification_type, title, message, link, created_by)
    if not email:
        return notification, None

    outbox, _ = NotificationEmailOutbox.objects.get_or_create(
        idempotency_key=raw_key,
        defaults={
            "notification": notification,
            "recipient_email": email,
            "subject": email_subject,
            "body_text": email_body,
            "status": "Draft",
            "created_by": created_by,
        },
    )
    if outbox.notification_id != notification.pk:
        notification.delete()
        notification = outbox.notification
    return notification, outbox

Kiến trúc\n\n```\nPortal (template base.html)\n  └─ nút chat nổi + trang /assistant/  (assistant/templates, static JS/CSS)\n       └─ POST /assistant/api/search/  (login required, rate limit)\n            └─ services.ask(question, user)\n                 ├─ nlp.parse(question) → ParsedQuery\n                 ├─ db_search.search(ParsedQuery, user)     → ORM, SQL Server\n                 ├─ sharepoint_search.search(ParsedQuery)    → GraphClient (mở rộng)\n                 └─ rank + trả SearchResponse {results[], parsed, took_ms}\n```\n\n- Module hóa theo modular monolith hiện có; không đổi kiến trúc, không thêm service ngoài.\n- `apps/m365/graph_client.py`: thêm `search_files()`; giữ nguyên các phương thức hiện có.\n\n## 3. Thành phần chi tiết\n\n### 3.1 `apps/assistant/nlp.py`\n\nParser quy tắc, deterministic, không học máy:\n\n| Nhận diện | Mẫu | Đầu ra |\n|---|---|---|\n| Số hiệu văn bản | `1234/QĐ-VH`, `CV 12/2026` | `doc_number` |\n| Khoảng thừơng gian | \"tháng 6\", \"quý 2\", \"năm 2025\", \"từ ... đến ...\", \"tuần trước\" | `date_from`, `date_to` |\n| Loại văn bản | công văn đi/đến, quyết định, hợp đồng, đơn nghỉ phép, biên bản, tờ trình | `doc_type` |\n| Cụm trích yếu | ngoặc kép `\"nghỉ phép không lương\"` | `phrases[]` |\n| Từ khóa còn lại | sau loại bỏ stopword tiếng Việt | `keywords[]` |\n\nQuy tắc ưu tiên: số hiệu > cụm trích yếu > từ khóa. Không parse được gì → toàn bộ câu làm `keywords` (fallback tìm tự do).\n\n### 3.2 `apps/assistant/search/db_search.py`\n\n- Tìm trên 3 model chính (trường đích chốt khi implement sau khi đọc model hiện hữu):\n  - `OfficialDispatch`: số hiệu, trích yếu, đơn vị gửi/nhận, ngày văn bản.\n  - `Document`: tiêu đề, danh mục, ghi chú.\n  - `PersonnelDecision`: số quyết định, loại, ngày hiệu lực.\n- Truy vấn ORM (`icontains`, `range`), không raw SQL; mỗi kết quả gắn `url` tới trang chi tiết hiện có.\n- **Phân quyền:** áp dụng đúng bộ lọc quyền của view danh sách tương ứng (đọc kỹ view hiện hữu trước khi code; trích hàm chung nếu chưa có). Ngưởi dùng không thấy tài liệu ngoài quyền kể cả khi hỏi trúng từ khóa.\n\n### 3.3 `apps/m365/graph_client.py` — bổ sung\n\n- `search_files(query, folder=None)`: gọi Graph `POST /search/query` (entityType `driveItem`, giới hạn site SharePoint IHRMS). Timeout mặc định của `_request`.\n- Nếu lỗi 403/404 (chưa được cấp quyền search): fallback duyệt các thư mục cấu hình (`M365_FOLDER_*`), lọc theo tên file chứa `query`; ghi log một lần mỗi phiên để admin biết cần consent.\n- Trả về `[{name, web_url, last_modified, folder}]` — không tải nội dung file.\n\n### 3.4 `apps/assistant/services.py`\n\n- `ask(question, user)`: parse → tìm song song DB + SharePoint (chịu lỗi từng nguồn) → gộp → xếp hạng → `SearchResponse`.\n- Xếp hạng: trùng số hiệu (đầu tiên, cố định đứng đầu) > trùng cụm trích yếu > số từ khóa trùng > ngày mới nhất.\n- Kết quả SharePoint lỗi: trả kết quả DB + cờ `partial=True`, UI hiển thị cảnh báo \"SharePoint tạm không khả dụng\".\n\n### 3.5 `apps/assistant/models.py`\n\n```python\nclass SearchQueryLog(BaseAuditModel):\n    user            # FK security.User\n    question        # CharField 500\n    parsed_filters  # JSONField (bộ lọc sau parse)\n    result_count    # int\n    sources         # CharField: \"db\", \"sharepoint\", \"db+sharepoint\"\n    took_ms         # int\n    error_note      # CharField, nullable\n```\n\nKhông lưu kết quả/nội dung tài liệu. Admin chỉ đọc.\n\n### 3.6 Views, URLs, UI\n\n- `GET /assistant/` — trang chat (login required).\n- `POST /assistant/api/search/` — JSON `{question}` → `{results[], parsed, took_ms, partial}`; rate limit 30 req/phút/user (cache đếm đơn giản); validate độ dài câu hỏi ≤ 500 ký tự.\n- Nút chat nổi chèn qua `base.html`; panel chat lazy-load JS khi ngưởi dùng mở lần đầu.\n- UI theo design system hiện hữu (docs/UI_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md): gợi ý nhanh \"Công văn gần đây\", \"Quyết định tháng này\"; thẻ kết quả có icon nguồn (IHRMS/SharePoint), tiêu đề, dòng metadata, link; hỗ trợ bàn phím (Enter gửi, Esc đóng); trạng thái loading/empty/error.\n\n### 3.7 Thông báo/email (rà soát, không xây mới)\n\n- Đối chiếu từng luồng duyệt: nghỉ phép, kỳ lương, công văn (`document/hcns`), activity → xác nhận đã gọi `notify`/`notify_with_email_draft`, đúng ngưởi nhận, đúng idempotency.\n- Phát hiện lỗ hổng → vá trong phạm vi nhỏ, test tương ứng. 8	App Registration trên Azure AD cần các quyền: Sites.ReadWrite.All,
9	Files.ReadWrite.All, và đã được admin M365 bấm "Grant admin consent".

27	GRAPH_SCOPE = ["https://graph.microsoft.com/.default"]
28
29	# Ngưỡng theo tài liệu Graph API: tệp <= 4MB dùng PUT trực tiếp; lớn hơn phải
30	# dùng "upload session" (upload theo từng khối).
31	SIMPLE_UPLOAD_LIMIT = 4 * 1024 * 1024  # 4 MB
32	CHUNK_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # phải là bội số của 320 KiB theo yêu cầu Graph

35	class GraphAPIError(Exception):
36	    """Lỗi khi gọi Microsoft Graph API (mạng, xác thực, hoặc phản hồi lỗi)."""
37	    def __init__(self, message, *, status_code=None, retry_after=None):
38	        super().__init__(message)
39	        self.status_code = status_code
40	        self.retry_after = retry_after

44	class GraphNotConfigured(GraphAPIError):
45	    """Chưa điền đủ M365_TENANT_ID / M365_CLIENT_ID / M365_CLIENT_SECRET trong .env."""
46
47
48	class GraphClient:
49	    """
50	    Wrapper mỏng quanh Microsoft Graph API. Tự lấy & cache access token,
51	    tự dò site_id / drive_id theo tên site + tên thư viện, và cung cấp các
52	    thao tác tệp cơ bản (upload/download/delete/exists/url).
53
54	    Instance này an toàn dùng lại nhiều lần (token được cache trong tiến
55	    trình, tự làm mới khi gần hết hạn).
56	    """
57
58	    _lock = threading.Lock()
59
60	    def __init__(self):
61	        self.tenant_id = getattr(settings, "M365_TENANT_ID", "") or ""
62	        self.client_id = getattr(settings, "M365_CLIENT_ID", "") or ""
63	        self.client_secret = getattr(settings, "M365_CLIENT_SECRET", "") or ""
64	        self.site_hostname = getattr(settings, "M365_SHAREPOINT_HOSTNAME", "") or ""
65	        self.site_path = getattr(settings, "M365_SHAREPOINT_SITE_PATH", "") or ""
66
67	        self._token = None
68	        self._token_expires_at = 0
69	        self._site_id_cache = None
70	        self._drive_id_cache = {}
71
72	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
73	    # Xác thực
74	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
75	    def is_configured(self) -> bool:
76	        return bool(self.tenant_id and self.client_id and self.client_secret)
77
78	    def _require_configured(self):
79	        if not self.is_configured():
80	            raise GraphNotConfigured(
81	                "Chưa cấu hình M365_TENANT_ID / M365_CLIENT_ID / M365_CLIENT_SECRET "
82	                "trong .env. Xem docs/16_M365_Integration_Setup.md."
83	            )
84
85	    def _get_token(self) -> str:
86	        self._require_configured()
87	        with self._lock:
88	            if self._token and time.time() < self._token_expires_at - 60:
89	                return self._token
90
91	            try:
92	                import msal
93	            except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - phụ thuộc môi trường
94	                raise GraphAPIError(
95	                    "Thiếu thư viện 'msal'. Chạy: pip install -r requirements.txt"
96	                ) from exc
97
98	            app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
99	                client_id=self.client_id,
100	                client_credential=self.client_secret,
101	                authority=AUTH_AUTHORITY.format(tenant_id=self.tenant_id),
102	            )
103	            result: dict = app.acquire_token_for_client(scopes=GRAPH_SCOPE)  # type: ignore[assignment]
104	            if "access_token" not in result:
105	                raise GraphAPIError(
106	                    "Không xác thực được với dịch vụ lưu trữ.", status_code=503
107	                )
108
109	            self._token = result["access_token"]
110	            self._token_expires_at = time.time() + result.get("expires_in", 3600)
111	            return self._token
112
113	    def _headers(self, extra=None):
114	        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self._get_token()}"}
115	        if extra:
116	            headers.update(extra)
117	        return headers
118
119	    def _request(self, method, url, **kwargs):
120	        headers = kwargs.pop("headers", {}) or {}
121	        try:
122	            response = requests.request(method, url, headers=self._headers(headers), timeout=60, **kwargs)
123	        except requests.RequestException as error:
124	            raise GraphAPIError("Không kết nối được dịch vụ lưu trữ.", status_code=503) from error
125	        if response.status_code >= 400:
126	            retry_after = response.headers.get("Retry-After")
127	            raise GraphAPIError(f"Graph trả lỗi HTTP {response.status_code}.",
128	                status_code=response.status_code, retry_after=retry_after)
129	        return response
130
131	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
132	    # Dò site_id / drive_id (cache lại vì hiếm khi đổi)
133	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
134	    @property
135	    def site_id(self) -> str:
136	        if self._site_id_cache:
137	            return self._site_id_cache
138	        if not (self.site_hostname and self.site_path):
139	            raise GraphNotConfigured(
140	                "Chưa cấu hình M365_SHAREPOINT_HOSTNAME / M365_SHAREPOINT_SITE_PATH trong .env."
141	            )
142	        url = f"{GRAPH_BASE}/sites/{self.site_hostname}:{self.site_path}"
143	        data = self._request("GET", url).json()
144	        self._site_id_cache = data["id"]
145	        return self._site_id_cache
146
147	    def _drive_id(self, library_name: str) -> str:
148	        """Trả về drive_id của một Document Library (ví dụ 'Documents', 'CongVan')."""
149	        if library_name in self._drive_id_cache:
150	            return self._drive_id_cache[library_name]
151
152	        url = f"{GRAPH_BASE}/sites/{self.site_id}/drives"
153	        data = self._request("GET", url).json()
154	        for drive in data.get("value", []):
155	            if drive.get("name", "").lower() == library_name.lower():
156	                self._drive_id_cache[library_name] = drive["id"]
157	                return drive["id"]
158
159	        raise GraphAPIError(
160	            f"Không tìm thấy thư viện tài liệu '{library_name}' trong site SharePoint. "
161	            "Kiểm tra lại tên thư viện (Document Library) trên SharePoint."
162	        )
163
164	    def _item_url(self, library_name: str, path: str, suffix: str = "") -> str:
165	        drive_id = self._drive_id(library_name)
166	        path = path.lstrip("/")
167	        return f"{GRAPH_BASE}/drives/{drive_id}/root:/{path}{suffix}"
168
169	    def _ensure_parent_folders(self, library_name: str, path: str) -> None:
170	        """Create missing parent folders in a drive before uploading a file."""
171	        parent_path = posixpath.dirname(path.strip("/"))
172	        if not parent_path:
173	            return
174
175	        drive_id = self._drive_id(library_name)
176	        parent = ""
177	        for folder_name in parent_path.split("/"):
178	            if not folder_name:
179	                continue
180	            children_url = (
181	                f"{GRAPH_BASE}/drives/{drive_id}/root/children"
182	                if not parent
183	                else f"{GRAPH_BASE}/drives/{drive_id}/root:/{parent}:/children"
184	            )
185	            try:
186	                self._request(
187	                    "POST",
188	                    children_url,
189	                    json={
190	                        "name": folder_name,
191	                        "folder": {},
192	                        "@microsoft.graph.conflictBehavior": "fail",
193	                    },
194	                )
195	            except GraphAPIError as exc:
196	                if exc.status_code != 409:
197	                    raise
198	            parent = posixpath.join(parent, folder_name)
199
200	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
201	    # Thao tác tệp
202	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
203	    def upload_file(self, library_name: str, path: str, content: bytes) -> dict:
204	        """Tải tệp lên thư viện. Tự chọn upload đơn giản hoặc upload session
205	        theo dung lượng tệp. Trả về JSON metadata (driveItem) của Graph."""
206	        self._ensure_parent_folders(library_name, path)
207	        if len(content) <= SIMPLE_UPLOAD_LIMIT:
208	            url = self._item_url(library_name, path, ":/content")
209	            response = self._request(
210	                "PUT", url, data=content,
211	                headers={"Content-Type": "application/octet-stream"},
212	            )
213	            return response.json()
214
215	        return self._upload_large_file(library_name, path, content)
216
217	    def _upload_large_file(self, library_name: str, path: str, content: bytes) -> dict:
218	        session_url = self._item_url(library_name, path, ":/createUploadSession")
219	        session = self._request("POST", session_url, json={}).json()
220	        upload_url = session["uploadUrl"]
221
222	        stream = io.BytesIO(content)
223	        total = len(content)
224	        start = 0
225	        last_response = None
226	        while start < total:
227	            chunk = stream.read(CHUNK_SIZE)
228	            end = start + len(chunk) - 1
229	            # Upload session dùng URL đã ký sẵn, KHÔNG cần header Authorization.
230	            last_response = requests.put(

from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractUser
from django.db import models


class Role(models.Model):
    """Theo 10_RBAC_Permission_Matrix.md mục 2 — 8 vai trò chuẩn."""
    role_code = models.CharField(max_length=30, unique=True, db_column="RoleCode")
    role_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, db_column="RoleName")

    class Meta:
        db_table = "tblRole"

    def __str__(self):
        return self.role_name


class User(AbstractUser):
    role = models.ForeignKey(
        Role, null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        db_column="RoleID", related_name="users",
    )
    employee = models.OneToOneField(
        "hrm.Employee", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        db_column="EmployeeID", related_name="user_account",
    )
    external_object_id = models.CharField(
        max_length=100, null=True, blank=True, unique=True,
        db_column="ExternalObjectId",
    )

    class Meta:
        db_table = "tblUser"


class SecurityEvent(models.Model):
    """Access metadata only: never store values, filenames, query strings or secrets."""
    user = models.ForeignKey('security.User', null=True, on_delete=models.SET_NULL)
    action = models.CharField(max_length=40)
    resource = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    record_id = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True)
    occurred_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True, db_index=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'tblSecurityEvent'
        ordering = ('-occurred_at',)

80	def people_matches(scope, query):
81	    """Normalize only safe search columns after scope, bounded on both backends.
82
83	    A bounded probe and one result query add at most one SELECT to the previous
84	    direct result query. No collation/schema changes or sensitive field loads.
85	    """
86	    ordered = scope.order_by("full_name", "pk")
87	    candidates = list(ordered.values_list("pk", "full_name", "employee_code", "company_email")[:PEOPLE_SCAN_LIMIT + 1])
88	    limited = len(candidates) > PEOPLE_SCAN_LIMIT
89	    if limited:
90	        matches = ordered.filter(Q(full_name__icontains=query) | Q(employee_code__icontains=query)
91	                                 | Q(company_email__icontains=query))
92	    else:
93	        needle = normalized(query)
94	        ids = []
95	        for pk, *fields in candidates:
96	            if any(needle in normalized(field or "") for field in fields):
97	                ids.append(pk)
98	                if len(ids) == 21:
99	                    break
100	        matches = ordered.filter(pk__in=ids)
101	    return matches.select_related("department").only(
102	        "pk", "full_name", "employee_code", "company_email", "department__department_name")[:21], limited

108	def global_search(request):
109	    query = request.GET.get("q", "").strip()[:100]
110	    people, pages = [], []
111	    search_limited = False
112	    if len(query) >= 2:
113	        needle = normalized(query)
114	        pages = [dict(label=label, href=reverse("portal:" + route))
115	                 for label, route, permission in PAGES
116	                 if page_visible(request.user, route, permission)
117	                 and needle in normalized(label)]
118	        employee = _get_employee(request)
119	        qs, _ = dashboard_employee_scope(request.user, employee)
120	        if qs is None:
121	            qs = Employee.objects.filter(pk=employee.pk) if employee and not employee.is_deleted else Employee.objects.none()
122	        matches, search_limited = people_matches(qs, query)
123	        can_open = has_permission(request.user, "manage_hr") or has_permission(request.user, "view_all_employees")
124	        for person in matches:
125	            people.append(dict(name=person.full_name, code=person.employee_code, email=person.company_email,
126	                               department=person.department.department_name if person.department else "—",
127	                               href=reverse("portal:hr_employee_detail", args=[person.pk]) if can_open
128	                               else reverse("portal:profile") if employee and person.pk == employee.pk else None))
129	    return render(request, "portal/global_search.html", dict(search_query=query,
130	                  search_people=people[:20], search_pages=pages, search_more=len(people) > 20,
131	                  search_limited=search_limited))

6	def managed_departments_for(user, *, global_roles=(), scoped_roles=(DEPT_MANAGER,)):
7	    """Departments a role may target in department-scoped write workflows."""
8	    from apps.organization.models import Department
9
10	    qs = Department.objects.all()
11	    if not getattr(user, "is_authenticated", False) or not getattr(user, "is_active", False):
12	        return qs.none()
13	    role = get_role_code(user)
14	    if getattr(user, "is_superuser", False) or role in global_roles:
15	        return qs
16	    if role not in scoped_roles:
17	        return qs.none()
18	    employee = getattr(user, "employee", None)
19	    if not employee or employee.is_deleted:
20	        return qs.none()
21	    return employee.managed_departments.all()

26	    from apps.hrm.models import Employee
27
28	    qs = Employee.objects.all()
29	    departments = managed_departments_for(

31	    )

37	def visible_dispatches_for(user, queryset=None):
38	    from apps.document.models import OfficialDispatch
39	    qs = queryset if queryset is not None else OfficialDispatch.objects.all()
40	    if not user.is_authenticated or not user.is_active:
41	        return qs.none()
42	    if user.is_superuser:
43	        return qs
44	    employee = getattr(user, 'employee', None)
45	    role = get_role_code(user)
46	    if role in ('PROJECT_MANAGER', 'PROJECT_COORDINATOR'):
47	        qs = qs.filter(dispatch_type='Outgoing')
48	    elif not has_permission(user, 'access_outgoing_document'):
49	        if not employee:
50	            return qs.none()
51	        scope = Q(assigned_to=employee)
52	        if employee.department_id:
53	            scope |= Q(department_id=employee.department_id)
54	        qs = qs.filter(scope)
55	    if role not in ('SUPER_ADMIN', 'DIRECTOR', 'HR_MANAGER', 'HR_OFFICER'):
56	        private_scope = Q(created_by=user)
57	        if employee:
58	            private_scope |= Q(assigned_to=employee) | Q(signer=employee)
59	        qs = qs.filter(Q(security_level='Normal') | private_scope)
60	    return qs

63	def can_read_file(user, obj):

65	        return False
66	    employee = getattr(user, 'employee', None)
67	    if employee and employee.is_deleted:
68	        return False
69	    if user.is_superuser:
70	        return True
71	    role = get_role_code(user)
72	    label = obj._meta.label_lower

83	    if label == 'document.officialdispatch':

85	    if label == 'office.incomingdocument':

87	    if label == 'office.outgoingdocument':
88	        return has_permission(user, 'access_outgoing_document')
89	    if label == 'recruitment.candidate':

91	    if label in ('leave.leaverequest', 'hrm.employeeprofilechangerequest'):

Rank/merge algorithm — concrete scoring:
- dispatch_no exact icontains match → score 100
- doc_number match in original_doc_no/decision_no/document_no → 100
- phrase in title/trích yếu → 50 each phrase
- keyword in title → 10; in other text fields → 5 each
- date range filter boosts? Simpler: filters restrict; ranking = score + recency tiebreak (days since date desc). Cap results 20.

```json
{

  "results": [{"source": "ihrms"|"sharepoint", "type": "official_dispatch"|"document"|"personnel_decision"|"file", "title": "...", "meta": "...", "url": "...", "date": "2026-09-01"|null}]
}
```

Rate limit: cache key f"assistant:rl:{user.pk}", 30 requests, 60s window using cache.add semantics: add(key, 1, 60) — if False, incr; block when > 30. Return 429 JSON.

Parser specifics (deterministic, testable):
- normalize: lowercase, strip accents (reuse normalized() pattern from search.py)
- doc number regex: r'\b(\d{1,5}/[A-Za-zĐđ0-9\-]+(?:-[A-Za-z0-9]+)*)\b' also "số 123" prefix optional
- quoted phrases: r'"([^"]+)"'
- date: "tháng (\d{1,2})(?:\s*năm\s*(\d{4}))?", "quý ([1-4])(?:\s*năm\s*(\d{4}))?", "năm (\d{4})", "tuần trước", "tháng trước", "hôm qua" → relative to today (injectable `today` param for tests)
- doc type keywords mapping: {"công văn đến": Incoming, "công văn đi": Outgoing, "văn bản nội bộ/chỉ đạo": InternalDirective, "công văn": any dispatch, "quyết định": personnel_decision, "hợp đồng": (out of scope? no model chosen — skip; spec says 3 models only: OfficialDispatch, Document, PersonnelDecision) ... "tài liệu": document, "văn bản": any}
- stopwords: Vietnamese common words list

**Rate limiter** in views:
```python
def _throttle_ok(user) -> bool:
    key = f"assistant:rl:{user.pk}"
    try:
        if caches["default"].add(key, 1, 60):
            return True
        count = caches["default"].incr(key)
        return count <= 30
    except ValueError:
        return True
```

```python
QUOTED_RE = re.compile(r'"([^"]+)"')
MONTH_RE = re.compile(r"tháng\s+(\d{1,2})(?:\s*(?:năm|\/)\s*(\d{4}))?", re.IGNORECASE)
QUARTER_RE = re.compile(r"quý\s+([1-4])(?:\s*năm\s*(\d{4}))?", re.IGNORECASE)
YEAR_RE = re.compile(r"\bnăm\s+(\d{4})\b", re.IGNORECASE)

DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS = [
    ("công văn đến", "Incoming"), ("công văn đi", "Outgoing"),

STOPWORDS = {"tìm", "kiếm", "cho", "tôi", "mình", "xin", "hãy", "về", "của", "và", "các", "những", "một", "là", "ở", "theo", "giúp", "với", "được", "bị", "trong", "ngoài", "từ", "đến", "ngày", "giờ", "nào", "này", "ấy", "đó", "anh", "chị", "bạn", "mới", "gần", "nhất", "gần đây"}
```

Date parsing logic:
- "tuần trước" → today-7d..today; "tháng trước" → previous month; "năm ngoái" previous year; "hôm nay"; "hôm qua"
- month w/o year → current year (if future month > current month+? keep simple: current year)
- quarter → quarter month range
- year → full year
- "từ A đến B" with ISO dates: FROM_TO_RE = r"từ\s+(\d{1,2}[/-]\d{1,2}[/-]\d{4})\s*(?:đến|tới)\s+(\d{1,2}[/-]\d{1,2}[/-]\d{4})" parse with %d/%m/%Y or %Y-%m-%d.

parse() pipeline:
1. strip, collapse spaces
2. phrases from quotes (remove from working string)
3. doc number (remove)
4. dates (remove matched spans)
5. doc type (remove)
6. remaining tokens split; filter stopwords & len<2; → keywords

```python
def _search_dispatches(parsed, user):
    qs = visible_dispatches_for(user, OfficialDispatch.objects.select_related("department", "dispatch_book"))
    if parsed.doc_type in ("Incoming", "Outgoing", "InternalDirective"):
        qs = qs.filter(dispatch_type=parsed.doc_type)
    if parsed.doc_type == "document":  # only documents wanted → skip dispatches
        return []
    if parsed.doc_number:
        qs = qs.filter(Q(dispatch_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number) | Q(original_doc_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number))
    else:
        text_q = Q()
        for phrase in parsed.phrases:
            text_q |= Q(title__icontains=phrase) | Q(issuing_organization__icontains=phrase)
        for kw in parsed.keywords:
            text_q |= Q(title__icontains=kw) | Q(issuing_organization__icontains=kw) | Q(dispatch_no__icontains=kw)
        if text_q:
            qs = qs.filter(text_q)
    if parsed.date_from: qs = qs.filter(issue_date__gte=parsed.date_from)
    if parsed.date_to: qs = qs.filter(issue_date__lte=parsed.date_to)
    rows = []
    for d in qs.order_by("-issue_date")[:50]:
        score = _score(parsed, title=d.title, number=d.dispatch_no, extra=(d.original_doc_no or "", d.issuing_organization))
        rows.append({...})
    return rows
```

Score function:
```python
def _score(parsed, *, title, number, extra=()):
    score = 0
    if parsed.doc_number and parsed.doc_number.replace(" ", "") in (number or "").replace(" ", ""):
        score += 100
    for phrase in parsed.phrases:
        if phrase.casefold() in (title or "").casefold():
            score += 40
    for kw in parsed.keywords:
        if kw.casefold() in (title or "").casefold():
            score += 10
        else:
            for field_val in extra:
                if kw.casefold() in (field_val or "").casefold():
                    score += 5
                    break
    return score
```
Then filter score>0 when constraints exist; sort in services.

m365 search_files:
```python
def search_files(self, query: str, top: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
    self._require_configured()
    payload = {
        "requests": [{
            "entityTypes": ["driveItem"],
            "query": {"queryString": query[:200]},
            "from": 0, "size": top,
            "fields": ["name", "webUrl", "lastModifiedDateTime", "parentReference"],
        }]
    }
    data = self._request("POST", f"{GRAPH_BASE}/search/query", json=payload).json()
    prefix = f"https://{self.site_hostname}{self.site_path}"
    results = []
    for block in data.get("value", []):
        for hit in block.get("hitsContainers", []):
            for hit_item in hit.get("hits", []):
                resource = hit_item.get("resource", {})
                web_url = resource.get("webUrl") or ""
                if web_url.startswith(prefix):
                    results.append({
                        "name": resource.get("name", ""),
                        "web_url": web_url,
                        "last_modified": resource.get("lastModifiedDateTime", ""),
                    })
    return results[:top]
```
list_folder_files:
```python
def list_folder_files(self, library_name: str, folder: str = "") -> list[dict]:
    drive_id = self._drive_id(library_name)
    base = f"{GRAPH_BASE}/drives/{drive_id}/root"
    url = f"{base}:/{folder.lstrip('/')}:/children" if folder else f"{base}/children"
    data = self._request("GET", url, params={"$top": 200}).json()
    items = []
    for entry in data.get("value", []):
        if "folder" in entry:
            continue
        items.append({"name": entry.get("name",""), "web_url": entry.get("webUrl",""), "last_modified": entry.get("lastModifiedDateTime","")})
    return items
```

m365_search.search_sharepoint:
```python
FALLBACK_FOLDERS = ("", "CongVan", "CongVanDen", "CongVanDi")  # override via settings at runtime
def search_sharepoint(parsed) -> tuple[list[dict], str | None]:
    client = get_graph_client()
    if not client.is_configured():
        return [], "not_configured"
    terms = parsed.phrases + parsed.keywords
    query = " ".join(terms)[:200] if terms else (parsed.doc_number or "")
    if not query.strip():
        return [], None
    try:
        hits = client.search_files(query)
        return [_to_result(h) for h in hits], None
    except GraphAPIError as exc:
        if exc.status_code in (403, 400):
            return _fallback_listing(client, terms, parsed), "search_fallback"
        return [], "unavailable"
```
Fallback listing filters normalized name contains any normalized term; cap 20.
_to_result: {"source": "sharepoint", "type": "file", "title": name, "meta": "SharePoint", "url": web_url, "date": parsed ISO→date or None, "score": computed}
Score: phrase in name +40; kw in name +10; doc_number in name +100.

Folder settings: read from django.conf.settings: M365_SHAREPOINT_LIBRARY (default "Documents"), M365_FOLDER_DISPATCHES etc. — fallback folders tuple = (settings.M365_FOLDER_DISPATCHES, "CongVanDen"...). To stay concrete: `folders = [getattr(settings, name, default) for name, default in (("M365_FOLDER_DISPATCHES","CongVan"),("M365_FOLDER_INCOMING","CongVanDen"),("M365_FOLDER_OUTGOING","CongVanDi"))]`.

services.ask:
```python
def ask(question: str, user) -> dict:
    parsed = nlp.parse(question)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    db_results = db_search.search_database(parsed, user)
    sp_results, sp_error = m365_search.search_sharepoint(parsed)
    took_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
    merged = sorted(db_results + sp_results,
                    key=lambda r: (-r["score"], -(r["date"].toordinal() if r["date"] else 0)))[:20]
    sources = "db+sharepoint" if (db_results and sp_results) else ("db" if db_results else ("sharepoint" if sp_results else "none"))
    SearchQueryLog.objects.create(
        user=user, question=question[:500], parsed_filters=_parsed_dict(parsed),
        result_count=len(merged), sources=sources, took_ms=took_ms,
        error_note=sp_error, created_by=user,
    )
    results = [{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != "score"} for r in merged]
    return {"query": question, "parsed": _parsed_dict(parsed), "took_ms": took_ms,
            "partial": bool(sp_error), "results": results}
```
Note: SharePoint search when Graph unconfigured → error_note "not_configured" → partial=True... but that's normal on dev without M365. partial semantics = "results incomplete because a source failed". not_configured → set error_note None to avoid noisy partial on dev? Spec: partial when dependency unavailable. Keep not_configured → partial False (source simply not enabled). I'll set: error_note="not_configured" → partial False. Hmm simpler: search_sharepoint returns ([], None) when not configured. Decide: return ([], "not_configured") but services maps it to partial only for "unavailable"/"search_fallback"? Cleanest: partial = sp_error in ("unavailable", "search_fallback"). I'll write that.

```python
@login_required
@require_POST
@never_cache
def api_search(request):
    try:
        data = json.loads(request.body.decode("utf-8") or "{}")
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return JsonResponse({"error": "invalid_json"}, status=400)
    question = str(data.get("question", "")).strip()[:500]
    if len(question) < 2:
        return JsonResponse({"error": "question_too_short"}, status=400)
    if not _throttle_ok(request.user):
        return JsonResponse({"error": "rate_limited"}, status=429)
    return JsonResponse(services.ask(question, request.user))
```

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

def get_role_code(user):
    """Mã vai trò của tài khoản, None nếu chưa gán vai trò."""
    role = getattr(user, "role", None)
    return role.role_code if role else None


def get_role_name(user):
    role = getattr(user, "role", None)
    if role:
        return role.role_name
    if getattr(user, "is_superuser", False):
        return "Quản trị viên cấp cao"
    if getattr(user, "is_staff", False):
        return "Quản trị viên"
    return "Nhân viên"


def has_permission(user, permission):
    """Tài khoản có quyền này không. Superuser luôn có mọi quyền."""
    if not getattr(user, "is_authenticated", False) or not getattr(user, "is_active", False):
        return False
    if getattr(user, "is_superuser", False):
        return True
    if permission in STAFF_ALSO_ALLOWED and getattr(user, "is_staff", False):
        return True
    return get_role_code(user) in PERMISSION_MATRIX.get(permission, ())


def permission_flags(user):
    """Toàn bộ quyền dưới dạng can_<tên quyền> để dùng trong template."""
    return {f"can_{name}": has_permission(user, name) for name in PERMISSION_MATRIX}

Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.\n\n**Goal:** Thêm chatbot tìm kiếm tài liệu (công văn/tài liệu/quyết định + SharePoint) vào portal IHRMS, bằng parser tiếng Việt thuần quy tắc (không LLM), kèm rà soát độ phủ thông báo/email hiện có.\n\n**Architecture:** App Django mới `apps.assistant` theo modular monolith: `nlp.parse()` → `db_search.search_database()` (ORM + `visible_dispatches_for`/`has_permission`) song song với `m365_search.search_sharepoint()` (Graph `/search/query`, fallback duyệt thư mục) → `services.ask()` gộp/xếp hạng + ghi `SearchQueryLog` → JSON API `/assistant/api/search/` → panel chat vanilla JS trên `base.html`.\n\n**Tech Stack:** Django 5.2, Python 3.12, SQL Server (ODBC 17) + SQLite test, Microsoft Graph (msal/requests), vanilla JS/CSS theo design tokens hiện hữu.\n\n**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-19-assistant-chatbot-design.md`\n\n## Global Constraints\n\n- Chỉ làm việc trên nhánh `main`; đầu mỗi Task kiểm tra `git status --short` sạch trước khi commit.\n- Không đưa `.env`, dữ liệu thật, tệp đính kèm nhân sự, secret vào Git; không dùng tài khoản/danh tính ngưởi dùng thật để kiểm thử (chỉ tài khoản QA/fixtures giả).\n- Server không gửi email; không bật gửi thư tự động. Không gọi API AI/LLM bên ngoài.\n- Mọi query DB qua ORM; mọi endpoint mới yêu cầu đăng nhập; kết quả tài liệu lọc theo quyền server-side.\n- Trường `db_table` tiếp tục prefix `tbl`; model kế thừa `BaseAuditModel` (`apps.common.models`).\n- Không sửa `print_forms.css` (nếu lỡ động phải tăng `?v=` trong `base.html` và chạy print UAT).\n- Commit message kiểu gitmoji-lite đang dùng: `feat(scope): …`, `test(scope): …`, `chore(scope): …`.\n- Migration app mới nằm trong commit riêng có `sqlmigrate` đối chiếu 2 backend trước khi giao.\n\n---\n\n## File Structure\n\n**Tạo mới:**\n- `src/apps/assistant/__init__.py` — rỗng.\n- `src/apps/assistant/apps.py` — AppConfig `AssistantConfig`, label `assistant`.\n- `src/apps/assistant/models.py` — `SearchQueryLog(BaseAuditModel)`.\n- `src/apps/assistant/nlp.py` — `ParsedQuery`, `parse(question, today=None)`.\n- `src/apps/assistant/db_search.py` — `search_database(parsed, user)` + helpers nội bộ `_search_dispatches/_search_documents/_search_decisions/_score`.\n- `src/apps/assistant/m365_search.py` — `search_sharepoint(parsed)` + `_fallback_listing`.\n- `src/apps/assistant/services.py` — `ask(question, user)`.\n- `src/apps/assistant/views.py` — `assistant_page(request)`, `api_search(request)`, `_throttle_ok(user)`.\n- `src/apps/assistant/urls.py` — `app_name = \"assistant\"`, 2 route.\n- `src/apps/assistant/admin.py` — `SearchQueryLogAdmin` read-only.\n- `src/apps/assistant/tests_nlp.py`, `tests_db_search.py`, `tests_m365_search.py`, `tests_services.py`, `tests_api.py`, `tests_ui.py`.\n- `src/apps/assistant/templates/assistant/chat.html`.\n- `src/static/js/assistant.js`, `src/static/css/assistant.css`.\n\n**Sửa:**\n- `src/config/settings.py` — thêm `'apps.assistant'` vào `INSTALLED_APPS` (sau `'apps.lifecycle'`, dòng 141).\n- `src/config/urls.py` — thêm `path(\"assistant/\", include(\"apps.assistant.urls\"))` sau route `reports/`.\n- `src/apps/m365/graph_client.py` — thêm `search_files()`, `list_folder_files()` (cuối class `GraphClient`, trước `get_web_url`).\n- `src/apps/m365/tests.py` — bổ sung 2 test class cho 2 hàm mới (mock `GraphClient._request`).\n- `templates/base.html` — thêm CSS link, nút nổi `#assistantFab`, `<div id=\"assistantDock\" hidden>`, block `extra_js`, script `assistant.js`.\n- `apps/notification/tests.py` — bổ sung test độ phủ thông báo công văn (Task 9).\n- `docs/PROJECT_WORK_LOG.md` — mục nhật ký đợt này (Task 10).\n\n---\n\n## Task 1: Scaffold app assistant + model SearchQueryLog + migration\n\n**Files:**\n- Create: `src/apps/assistant/__init__.py`, `apps.py`, `models.py`, `admin.py`, `urls.py` (placeholder views sẽ thay ở Task 7 — file chỉ định nghĩa route trỏ tới views chưa có sẽ ImportError; do đó Task 1 chỉ tạo `urls.py` ở bước cuối sau khi views tồn tại? Không — Task 1 chỉ tạo model + apps + admin, chưa gắn URL. URLs gắn ở Task 7.)\n- Create: `src/apps/assistant/tests_ui.py` (chứa test model ở đây tạm? Không — tạo `tests_models.py`.)\n\n**Interfaces:**\n- Produces: `SearchQueryLog` với fields: `user` (FK security.User, related_name `assistant_search_logs`), `question` (CharField 500), `parsed_filters` (JSONField default dict), `result_count` (PositiveIntegerField), `sources` (CharField 30), `took_ms` (PositiveIntegerField), `error_note` (CharField 100, null/blank), bảng `tblAssistantSearchLog`, kế thừa `BaseAuditModel`.\n\n- [ ] **Step 1: Viết test model**\n\n```python\n# src/apps/assistant/tests_models.py\nfrom django.test import TestCase\nfrom django.contrib.auth import get_user_model\nfrom apps.assistant.models import SearchQueryLog\n\n\nclass SearchQueryLogModelTests(TestCase):\n    def test_create_minimal(self):\n        User = get_user_model()\n        user = User.objects.create_user(username=\"log-tester\", password=\"x\")\n        log = SearchQueryLog.objects.create(\n            user=user, question=\"tim cong van\", parsed_filters={\"keywords\": [\"cong\", \"van\"]},\n            result_count=3, sources=\"db\", took_ms=12, created_by=user,\n        )\n        self.assertEqual(log._meta.db_table, \"tblAssistantSearchLog\")\n        self.assertEqual(log.error_note, None)\n        self.assertEqual(str(log.pk), str(SearchQueryLog.objects.get().pk))\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 2: Chạy test, xác nhận fail**\n\n```powershell\ncd D:\\QLHCNS\\src\npython manage.py test apps.assistant.tests_models -v 2\n```\nKỳ vọng: FAIL — `ModuleNotFoundError: apps.assistant`.\n\n- [ ] **Step 3: Tạo app scaffold + model**\n\n```python\n# src/apps/assistant/__init__.py  (rỗng)\n\n# src/apps/assistant/apps.py\nfrom django.apps import AppConfig\n\n\nclass AssistantConfig(AppConfig):\n    default_auto_field = \"django.db.models.BigAutoField\"\n    name = \"apps.assistant\"\n    label = \"assistant\"\n    verbose_name = \"Trợ lý tài liệu\"\n```\n\n```python\n# src/apps/assistant/models.py\nfrom django.db import models\nfrom apps.common.models import BaseAuditModel\n\n\nclass SearchQueryLog(BaseAuditModel):\n    \"\"\"Nhật ký truy vấn chatbot: không lưu nội dung/kết quả tài liệu.\"\"\"\n\n    user = models.ForeignKey(\n        \"security.User\", on_delete=models.CASCADE,\n        related_name=\"assistant_search_logs\", db_column=\"UserID\",\n    )\n    question = models.CharField(\"Câu hỏi\", max_length=500, db_column=\"Question\")\n    parsed_filters = models.JSONField(\"Bộ lọc đã parse\", default=dict, db_column=\"ParsedFilters\")\n    result_count = models.PositiveIntegerField(\"Số kết quả\", default=0, db_column=\"ResultCount\")\n    sources = models.CharField(\"Nguồn\", max_length=30, db_column=\"Sources\")\n    took_ms = models.PositiveIntegerField(\"Thờ gian (ms)\", default=0, db_column=\"TookMs\")\n    error_note = models.CharField(\"Ghi chú lỗi\", max_length=100, null=True, blank=True, db_column=\"ErrorNote\")\n\n    class Meta:\n        db_table = \"tblAssistantSearchLog\"\n        ordering = [\"-created_date\"]\n        verbose_name = \"Nhật ký truy vấn trợ lý\"\n        verbose_name_plural = \"Nhật ký truy vấn trợ lý\"\n```\n\n```python\n# src/apps/assistant/admin.py\nfrom django.contrib import admin\nfrom .models import SearchQueryLog\n\n\n@admin.register(SearchQueryLog)\nclass SearchQueryLogAdmin(admin.ModelAdmin):\n    list_display = (\"user\", \"question\", \"result_count\", \"sources\", \"took_ms\", \"created_date\")\n    search_fields = (\"question\",)\n    list_filter = (\"sources\",)\n\n    def has_add_permission(self, request):\n        return False\n\n    def has_change_permission(self, request, obj=None):\n        return False\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Đăng ký app, tạo migration**\n\nSửa `src/config/settings.py` — Để đối chiếu SQL Server: bật môi trường có `.env` trỏ SQL Server test (theo `docs/Server_Trial_Readiness_2026-09-27.md`), chạy lại `sqlmigrate assistant 0001` và lưu 2 đầu ra để chép vào work log ở Task 10. Nếu máy hiện tại không có SQL Server test, ghi nhận trong work log theo đúng mục \"Khi bị giới hạn công cụ\" của AGENTS.md.\n\n- [ ] **Step 6: Commit (migration commit riêng theo AGENTS.md)**\n\n```powershell\ncd D:\\QLHCNS\ngit add src/apps/assistant/__init__.py src/apps/assistant/apps.py src/apps/assistant/models.py src/apps/assistant/admin.py src/apps/assistant/tests_models.py src/apps/assistant/migrations src/config/settings.py\ngit commit -m \"feat(assistant): search query log model with migration\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## Task 2: Parser câu hỏi tiếng Việt (nlp.py)\n\n**Files:**\n- Create: `src/apps/assistant/nlp.py`\n- Test: `src/apps/assistant/tests_nlp.py`\n\n**Interfaces:**\n- Consumes: không gì (thuần Python).\n- Produces:\n  - `ParsedQuery` dataclass: `doc_number: str | None`, `phrases: list[str]`, `keywords: list[str]`, `date_from: date | None`, `date_to: date | None`, `doc_type: str | None`.\n  - `parse(question: str, today: date | None = None) -> ParsedQuery`.\n  - `doc_type` ∈ {`None`, `\"dispatch\"`, `\"Incoming\"`, `\"Outgoing\"`, `\"InternalDirective\"`, `\"document\"`, `\"personnel_decision\"`}.\n\n- [ ] **Step 1: Viết test**\n\n```python\n# src/apps/assistant/tests_nlp.py\nfrom datetime import date\nfrom django.test import SimpleTestCase\nfrom apps.assistant.nlp import parse, ParsedQuery\n\n\nclass QueryParserTests(SimpleTestCase):\n    def test_doc_number(self):\n        p = parse(\"tìm công văn số 1234/QĐ-VH\")\n        self.assertEqual(p.doc_number, \"1234/QĐ-VH\")\n        self.assertEqual(p.doc_type, \"dispatch\")\n\n    def test_doc_number_without_prefix(self):\n        self.assertEqual(parse(\"công văn 12/2026 về ngân sách\").doc_number, \"12/2026\")\n\n    def test_quoted_phrase(self):\n        p = parse('tìm \"nghỉ phép không lương\" tháng 6')\n        self.assertEqual(p.phrases, [\"nghỉ phép không lương\"])\n        self.assertNotIn(\"không\", p.keywords)\n\n    def test_month_current_year(self):\n        p = parse(\"công văn tháng 6\", today=date(2026, 10, 19))\n        self.assertEqual(p.date_from, date(2026, 6, 1))\n        self.assertEqual(p.date_to, date(2026, 6, 30))\n\n    def test_month_with_year(self):\n        p = parse(\"hồ sơ tháng 3 năm 2025\", today=date(2026, 10, 19))\n        self.assertEqual((p.date_from, p.date_to), (date(2025, 3, 1), date(2025, 3, 31)))\n\n    def test_quarter(self):\n        p = parse(\"quý 2 năm 2026\", today=date(2026, 10, 19))\n        self.assertEqual((p.date_from, p.date_to), (date(2026, 4, 1), date(2026, 6, 30)))\n\n    def test_year_only(self):\n        p = parse(\"công văn năm 2025\", today=date(2026, 10, 19))\n        self.assertEqual((p.date_from, p.date_to), (date(2025, 1, 1), date(2025, 12, 31)))\n\n    def test_relative_last_month(self):\n        p = parse(\"công văn tháng trước\", today=date(2026, 10, 19))\n        self.assertEqual((p.date_from, p.date_to), (date(2026, 9, 1), date(2026, 9, 30)))\n\n    def test_relative_last_week(self):\n        p = parse(\"tuần trước\", today=date(2026, 10, 19))\n        self.assertEqual(p.date_from, date(2026, 10, 12))\n        self.assertEqual(p.date_to, date(2026, 10, 19))\n\n    def test_from_to_range(self):\n        p = parse(\"từ 01/06/2026 đến 30/06/2026\", today=date(2026, 10, 19))\n        self.assertEqual((p.date_from, p.date_to), (date(2026, 6, 1), date(2026, 6, 30)))\n\n    def test_doc_type_variants(self):\n        self.assertEqual(parse(\"công văn đến\").doc_type, \"Incoming\")\n        self.assertEqual(parse(\"công văn đi\").doc_type, \"Outgoing\")\n        self.assertEqual(parse(\"văn bản chỉ đạo nội bộ\").doc_type, \"InternalDirective\")\n        self.assertEqual(parse(\"quyết định bổ nhiệm\").doc_type, \"personnel_decision\")\n        self.assertEqual(parse(\"tài liệu quy trình\").doc_type, \"document\")\n\n    def test_keywords_strip_stopwords_and_type_words(self):\n        p = parse(\"tìm giúp tôi công văn về ngân sách quý 4\", today=date(2026, 10, 19))\n        self.assertEqual(p.doc_type, \"dispatch\")\n        self.assertIn(\"ngân sách\", p.keywords)\n        for w in (\"tìm\", \"giúp\", \"tôi\", \"về\", \"công\", \"văn\", \"quý\"):\n            self.assertNotIn(w, p.keywords)\n\n    def test_no_diacritics_keywords_normalized(self):\n        p = parse(\"Cong van nghi phep\")\n        self.assertIn(\"cong van nghi phep\", p.keywords)  # full fallback keeps raw text\n        self.assertEqual(p.doc_type, \"dispatch\")\n\n    def test_fallback_whole_question_as_keywords(self):\n        p = parse(\"abcdefgh\")\n        self.assertEqual(p.doc_number, None)\n        self.assertEqual(p.keywords, [\"abcdefgh\"])\n\n    def test_empty_and_short(self):\n        self.assertEqual(parse(\"\").keywords, [])\n        self.assertEqual(parse(\"  a  \").keywords, [])\n\n    def test_parse_result_is_dataclass(self):\n        p = parse(\"công văn tháng 6\", today=date(2026, 10, 19))\n        self.assertIsInstance(p, ParsedQuery)\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 2: Chạy test, xác nhận fail**\n\n```powershell\npython manage.py test apps.assistant.tests_nlp -v 2\n```\nKỳ vọng: FAIL — `ModuleNotFoundError: apps.assistant.nlp`.\n\n- [ ] **Step 3: Viết implementation**\n\n```python\n# src/apps/assistant/nlp.py\n\"\"\"Parser câu hỏi tiếng Việt cho trợ lý tài liệu.\n\nThuần quy tắc, deterministic, không LLM. Pipeline: số hiệu → cụm ngoặc kép →\nmốc thờ gian → loại văn bản → từ khóa còn lại (đã bỏ stopword).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport unicodedata\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import date, timedelta\n\nDOC_NUMBER_RE = re.compile(\n    r\"(?:số\\s*)?(\\d{1,5}\\s*/\\s*[A-Za-zÀ-ỹ0-9]+(?:\\s*-\\s*[A-Za-zÀ-ỹ0-9]+)*)\",\n    re.IGNORECASE,\n)\nQUOTED_RE = re.compile(r'\"([^\"]+)\"')\nMONTH_RE = re.compile(r\"tháng\\s+(\\d{1,2})(?:\\s*(?:năm|\\/)\\s*(\\d{4}))?\", re.IGNORECASE)\nQUARTER_RE = re.compile(r\"quý\\s+([1-4])(?:\\s*năm\\s*(\\d{4}))?\", re.IGNORECASE)\nYEAR_RE = re.compile(r\"\\bnăm\\s+(\\d{4})\\b\", re.IGNORECASE)\nFROM_TO_RE = re.compile(\n    r\"từ\\s+(\\d{1,2}[\\/\\-]\\d{1,2}[\\/\\-]\\d{4})\\s*(?:đến|tới)\\s+(\\d{1,2}[\\/\\-]\\d{1,2}[\\/\\-]\\d{4})\",\n    re.IGNORECASE,\n)\n\nDOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS = [\n    (\"công văn đến\", \"Incoming\"),\n    (\"công văn đi\", \"Outgoing\"),\n    (\"văn bản chỉ đạo nội bộ\", \"InternalDirective\"),\n    (\"chỉ đạo nội bộ\", \"InternalDirective\"),\n    (\"văn bản nội bộ\", \"InternalDirective\"),\n    (\"quyết định\", \"personnel_decision\"),\n    (\"công văn\", \"dispatch\"),\n    (\"văn bản\", \"dispatch\"),\n    (\"tài liệu\", \"document\"),\n]\n\nSTOPWORDS = {\n    \"tìm\", \"kiếm\", \"tìm kiếm\", \"cho\", \"tôi\", \"mình\", \"em\", \"anh\", \"chị\", \"bạn\",\n    \"xin\", \"hãy\", \"về\", \"củа\", \"củа\", \"va\", \"và\", \"các\", \"những\", \"một\", \"là\",\n    \"ở\", \"theo\", \"giúp\", \"với\", \"được\", \"bị\", \"trong\", \"ngoài\", \"từ\", \"đến\",\n    \"ngày\", \"nào\", \"này\", \"đó\", \"mới\", \"gần\", \"nhất\", \"gần đây\", \"liên quan\",\n}\n\n_TYPE_TOKENS = set()\nfor _label, _code in DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS:\n    _TYPE_TOKENS.update(_label.split())\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ParsedQuery:\n    doc_number: str | None = None\n    phrases: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    keywords: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    date_from: date | None = None\n    date_to: date | None = None\n    doc_type: str | None = None\n\n    def has_constraints(self) -> bool:\n        return bool(self.doc_number or self.phrases or self.keywords or self.date_from or self.date_to)\n\n\ndef normalize(text: str) -> str:\n    return \"\".join(\n        c for c in unicodedata.normalize(\"NFD\", text.casefold().replace(\"đ\", \"d\"))\n        if not unicodedata.combining(c)\n    )\n\n\ndef _last_day_of_month(year: int, month: int) -> date:\n    if month == 12:\n        return date(year, 12, 31)\n    return date(year, month + 1, 1) - timedelta(days=1)\n\n\ndef _parse_iso(value: str) -> date:\n    for fmt in (\"%d/%m/%Y\", \"%d-%m-%Y\", \"%Y-%m-%d\"):\n        try:\n            return date.fromisoformat(value) if \"%Y\" == fmt[:2] else datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date()\n        except ValueError:\n            continue\n    raise ValueError(value)\n\n\ndef _extract_dates(text: str, today: date) -> tuple[str, date | None, date | None]:\n    match = FROM_TO_RE.search(text)\n    if match:\n        start = _parse_iso(match.group(1).replace(\"-\", \"/\") if \"-\" in match.group(1) and match.group(1).count(\"-\") == 2 else match.group(1))\n        end = _parse_iso(match.group(2).replace(\"-\", \"/\") if \"-\" in match.group(2) and match.group(2).count(\"-\") == 2 else match.group(2))\n        return (text[:match.start()] + \" \" + text[match.end():], start, end)\n\n    lowered = text.casefold()\n    if \"tuần trước\" in lowered:\n        return (text.replace(\"tuần trước\", \"\", 1), today - timedelta(days=7), today)\n    if \"tháng trước\" in lowered:\n        first = today.replace(day=1)\n        prev_end = first - timedelta(days=1)\n        return (text.replace(\"tháng trước\", \"\", 1), prev_end.replace(day=1), prev_end)\n    if \"năm ngoái\" in lowered:\n        return (text.replace(\"năm ngoái\", \"\", 1), date(today.year - 1, 1, 1), date(today.year - 1, 12, 31))\n\n    match = QUARTER_RE.search(text)\n    if match:\n        quarter = int(match.group(1))\n        year = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else today.year\n        start = date(year, quarter * 3 - 2, 1)\n        return (text[:match.start()] + \" \" + text[match.end():], start, _last_day_of_month(year, quarter * 3))\n\n    match = MONTH_RE.search(text)\n    if match:\n        month = int(match.group(1))\n        year = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else today.year\n        if 1 <= month <= 12:\n            start = date(year, month, 1)\n            return (text[:match.start()] + \" \" + text[match.end():], start, _last_day_of_month(year, month))\n\n    match = YEAR_RE.search(text)\n    if match:\n        year = int(match.group(1))\n        return (text[:match.start()] + \" \" + text[match.end():], date(year, 1, 1), date(year, 12, 31))\n\n    return (text, None, None)\n\n\ndef parse(question: str, today: date | None = None) -> ParsedQuery:\n    today = today or date.today()\n    text = \" \".join(question.split())[:500]\n    parsed = ParsedQuery()\n\n    match = QUOTED_RE.search(text)\n    if match:\n        parsed.phrases = [p.strip() for p in QUOTED_RE.findall(text) if p.strip()][:5]\n        text = QUOTED_RE.sub(\" \", text)\n\n    match = DOC_NUMBER_RE.search(text)\n    if match:\n        parsed.doc_number = re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \"\", match.group(1))\n        text = DOC_NUMBER_RE.sub(\" \", text, count=1)\n\n    text, parsed.date_from, parsed.date_to = _extract_dates(text, today)\n\n    lowered = \" \" + normalize(text) + \" \"\n    for label, code in DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS:\n        if f\" {normalize(label)} \" in lowered:\n            parsed.doc_type = code\n            text = re.sub(re.escape(label), \" \", text, count=1, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n            break\n\n    if parsed.doc_type in (\"Incoming\", \"Outgoing\", \"InternalDirective\"):\n        pass  # giữ nguyên, đây là dispatch subtype\n    elif parsed.doc_type == \"dispatch\" and any(\n        normalize(k) in lowered for k in (\"cong van den\", \"cong van có.\n\nMỗi nhánh dùng đúng quy tắc visibility của view tương ứng: dispatch dùng\nvisible_dispatches_for; document chỉ status Approved; personnel decision theo\nmanage_hr / approve_personnel_decision.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom django.db.models import Q\nfrom django.urls import reverse\n\nfrom apps.document.models import Document, OfficialDispatch, PersonnelDecision\nfrom apps.document.hcns.catalog import FORMS\nfrom apps.security.data_access import visible_dispatches_for\nfrom apps.security.permissions import has_permission\n\nfrom .nlp import ParsedQuery\n\nRECENT_LIMIT = 10\nSCAN_LIMIT = 50\nMAX_PER_TYPE = 15\n\n\ndef _score(parsed: ParsedQuery, *, title: str, number: str = \"\", extra: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> int:\n    score = 0\n    if parsed.doc_number and parsed.doc_number.casefold() in (number or \"\").replace(\" \", \"\").casefold():\n        score += 100\n    title_fold = (title or \"\").casefold()\n    for phrase in parsed.phrases:\n        if phrase.casefold() in title_fold:\n            score += 40\n    for kw in parsed.keywords:\n        if kw.casefold() in title_fold:\n            score += 10\n            continue\n        for value in extra:\n            if kw.casefold() in (value or \"\").casefold():\n                score += 5\n                break\n    return score\n\n\ndef _has_constraints(parsed: ParsedQuery) -> bool:\n    return parsed.has_constraints()\n\n\ndef _search_dispatches(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:\n    if parsed.doc_type == \"document\" or parsed.doc_type == \"personnel_decision\":\n        return []\n    qs = visible_dispatches_for(user, OfficialDispatch.objects.select_related(\"dispatch_book\"))\n    if parsed.doc_type in (\"Incoming\", \"Outgoing\", \"InternalDirective\"):\n        qs = qs.filter(dispatch_type=parsed.doc_type)\n    if parsed.doc_number:\n        qs = qs.filter(\n            Q(dispatch_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number) | Q(original_doc_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)\n        )\n    elif _has_constraints(parsed):\n        text_q = Q()\n        for phrase in parsed.phrases:\n            text_q |= Q(title__icontains=phrase) | Q(issuing_organization__icontains=phrase)\n        for kw in parsed.keywords:\n            text_q |= Q(title__icontains=kw) | Q(issuing_organization__icontains=kw) | Q(dispatch_no__icontains=kw)\n        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()\n    if parsed.date_from:\n        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__gte=parsed.date_from)\n    if parsed.date_to:\n        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__lte=parsed.date_to)\n    if not _has_constraints(parsed):\n        qs = qs.order_by(\"-received_or_sent_date\")[:RECENT_LIMIT]\n    rows = []\n    for d in qs.order_by(\"-received_or_sent_date\")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:\n        title = f\"[{d.get_dispatch_type_display()}] {d.dispatch_no} - {d.title}\"\n        meta = f\"{d.get_dispatch_type_display()} · {d.dispatch_no} · {d.issuing_organization}\"\n        score = _score(parsed, title=d.title, number=f\"{d.dispatch_no} {d.original_doc_no or ''}\",\n                       extra=(d.issuing_organization, d.dispatch_no))\n        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:\n            continue\n        rows.append({\n            \"source\": \"ihrms\", \"type\": \"official_dispatch\", \"title\": title, \"meta\": meta,\n            \"url\": reverse(\"portal:dispatch_detail\", args=[d.pk]),\n            \"date\": d.issue_date, \"score\": score,\n        })\n    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]\n\n\ndef _search_documents(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:\n    if parsed.doc_type not in (None, \"document\") and parsed.doc_type not in (\"Incoming\", \"Outgoing\", \"InternalDirective\", \"dispatch\"):\n        if parsed.doc_type != \"document\":\n            return []\n    if parsed.doc_type == \"personnel_decision\":\n        return []\n    qs = Document.objects.filter(status=\"Approved\").select_related(\"category\")\n    if parsed.doc_number:\n        qs = qs.filter(document_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)\n    elif _has_constraints(parsed):\n        text_q = Q()\n        for phrase in parsed.phrases:\n            text_q |= Q(document_name__icontains=phrase) | Q(category__category_name__icontains=phrase)\n        for kw in parsed.keywords:\n            text_q |= Q(document_name__icontains=kw) | Q(document_no__icontains=kw)\n        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()\n    if parsed.date_from:\n        qs = qs.filter(effective_date__gte=parsed.date_from)\n    if parsed.date_to:\n        qs = qs.filter(effective_date__lte=parsed.date_to)\n    if not _has_constraints(parsed):\n        qs = qs.order_by(\"-effective_date\")[:RECENT_LIMIT]\n    rows = []\n    for doc in qs.order_by(\"-effective_date\")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:\n        score = _score(parsed, title=doc.document_name, number=doc.document_no,\n                       extra=(doc.category.category_name,))\n        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:\n            continue\n        rows.append({\n            \"source\": \"ihrms\", \"type\": \"document\",\n            \"title\": f\"{doc.document_no} - {doc.document_name}\",\n            \"meta\": f\"Tài liệu · {doc.document_no} · {doc.category.category_name}\",\n            \"url\": reverse(\"portal:document_list\"),\n            \"date\": doc.effective_date, \"score\": score,\n        })\n    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]\n\n\ndef _search_decisions(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:\n    if parsed.doc_type not in (None, \"personnel_decision\", \"dispatch\"):\n        return []\n    can_manage = has_permission(user, \"manage_hr\")\n    if not (can_manage or has_permission(user, \"approve_personnel_decision\")):\n        return []\n    qs = PersonnelDecision.objects.select_related(\"employee\")\n    if not can_manage:\n        qs = qs.filter(Q(status=\"PendingApproval\") | Q(history__created_by=user)).distinct()\n    if parsed.doc_number:\n        qs = qs.filter(decision_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)\n    elif _has_constraints(parsed):\n        text_q = Q()\n        for phrase in parsed.phrases:\n            text_q |= Q(employee__full_name__icontains=phrase) | Q(decision_no__icontains=phrase)\n        for kw in parsed.keywords:\n            text_q |= Q(employee__full_name__icontains=kw) | Q(employee__employee_code__icontains=kw) | Q(decision_no__icontains=kw)\n        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()\n    if parsed.date_from:\n        qs = qs.filter(decision_date__gte=parsed.date_from)\n    if parsed.date_to:\n        qs = qs.filter(decision_date__lte=parsed.date_to)\n    if not _has_constraints(parsed):\n        qs = qs.order_by(\"-created_date\")[:RECENT_LIMIT]\n    rows = []\n    for dec in qs.order_by(\"-created_date\")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:\n        template_title = FORMS.get(dec.template_slug, {}).get(\"title\", dec.template_slug)\n        title = f\"{dec.decision_no or dec.template_slug} - {template_title} - {dec.employee.full_name}\"\n        score = _score(parsed, title=title, number=dec.decision_no,\n                       extra=(dec.employee.full_name, template_title))\n        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:\n            continue\n        rows.append({\n            \"source\": \"ihrms\", \"type\": \"personnel_decision\", \"title\": title,\n            \"meta\": f\"Quyết định · {dec.decision_no or '—'} · {template_title}\",\n            \"url\": reverse(\"portal:personnel_decision_detail\", args=[dec.pk]),\n            \"date\": dec.decision_date, \"score\": score,\n        })\n    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]\n\n\ndef search_database(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:\n    return (\n        _search_dispatches(parsed, user)\n        + _search_documents(parsed, user)\n        + _search_decisions(parsed, user)\n    )\n```\n\n- [ ] class GraphClient (sau get_metadata, trước get_web_url)\n    def search_files(self, query: str, top: int = 20) -> list[dict]:\n        \"\"\"Tìm kiếm driveItem bằng Graph /search/query, giới hạn trong site IHRMS.\n\n        Cần app permission cho phép search (Sites.Read.All / Sites.ReadWrite.All).\n        GraphAPIError(403/400) nghĩa là chưa được consent — caller tự fallback.\n        \"\"\"\n        self._require_configured()\n        payload = {\n            \"requests\": [{\n                \"entityTypes\": [\"driveItem\"],\n                \"query\": {\"queryString\": query[:200]},\n                \"from\": 0,\n                \"size\": top,\n                \"fields\": [\"name\", \"webUrl\", \"lastModifiedDateTime\"],\n            }]\n        }\n        data = self._request(\"POST\", f\"{GRAPH_BASE}/search/query\", json=payload).json()\n        prefix = f\"https://{self.site_hostname}{self.site_path}\"\n        results = []\n        for block in data.get(\"value\", []):\n            for container in block.get(\"hitsContainers\", []):\n                for hit in container.get(\"hits\", []):\n                    resource = hit.get(\"resource\", {}) or {}\n                    web_url = resource.get(\"webUrl\") or \"\"\n                    if web_url.startswith(prefix):\n                        results.append({\n                            \"name\": resource.get(\"name\", \"\"),\n                            \"web_url\": web_url,\n                            \"last_modified\": resource.get(\"lastModifiedDateTime\", \"\"),\n                        })\n                    if len(results) >= top:\n                        return results\n        return results\n\n    def list_folder_files(self, library_name: str, folder: str = \"\") -> list[dict]:\n        \"\"\"Liệt kê tệp (không đệ quy) trong một thư mục của Document Library.\"\"\"\n        drive_id = self._drive_id(library_name)\n        folder = (folder or \"\").strip(\"/\")\n        base = f\"{GRAPH_BASE}/drives/{drive_id}/root\"\n        url = f\"{base}:/{folder}:/children\" if folder else f\"{base}/children\"\n        data = self._request(\"GET\", url, params={\"$top\": 200}).json()\n        items = []\n        for entry in data.get(\"value\", []):\n            if \"folder\" in entry:\n                continue\n            items.append({\n                \"name\": entry.get(\"name\", \"\"),\n                \"web_url\": entry.get(\"webUrl\", \"\"),\n                \"last_modified\": entry.get(\"lastModifiedDateTime\", \"\"),\n            })\n        return items\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Chạy test pass** (`python manage.py test apps.m365 -v 2` — cả file, đảm bảo test cũ không vỡ).\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**\n\n```powershell\ngit add apps.assistant.m365_search`.\n\n- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**\n\n```python\n# src/apps/assistant/m365_search.py\n\"\"\"Tìm kiếm tệp trên SharePoint cho chatbot qua GraphClient.\n\nƯu tiên Graph /search/query; khi thiếu consent (403/400) fallback duyệt các\nthư mục nghiệp vụ đã cấu hình và lọc theo tên tệp.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom django.conf import settings\n\nfrom apps.m365.graph_client import GraphAPIError, get_graph_client\n\nfrom .nlp import ParsedQuery, normalize\n\nMAX_RESULTS = 20\nFALLBACK_LIMIT_PER_FOLDER = 50\n\n\ndef _fallback_folders() -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    library = getattr(settings, \"M365_SHAREPOINT_LIBRARY\", \"Documents\") or \"Documents\"\n    folders = [\n        getattr(settings, \"M365_FOLDER_DISPATCHES\", \"CongVan\"),\n        getattr(settings, \"M365_FOLDER_INCOMING\", \"CongVanDen\"),\n        getattr(settings, \"M365_FOLDER_OUTGOING\", \"CongVanDi\"),\n    ]\n    seen, pairs = set(), []\n    for folder in folders:\n        folder = (folder or \"\").strip(\"/\")\n        if folder and folder not in seen:\n            seen.add(folder)\n            pairs.append((library, folder))\n    pairs.append((library, \"\"))\n    return pairs\n\n\ndef _to_result(hit: dict, parsed: ParsedQuery) -> dict:\n    name = hit.get(\"name\", \"\")\n    name_fold = normalize(name)\n    score = 0\n    if parsed.doc_number and normalize(parsed.doc_number) in name_fold:\n        score += 100\n    for phrase in parsed.phrases:\n        if normalize(phrase) in name_fold:\n            score += 40\n    for kw in parsed.keywords:\n        if kw in name_fold:\n            score += 10\n    return {\n        \"source\": \"sharepoint\",\n        \"type\": \"file\",\n        \"title\": name,\n        \"meta\": \"SharePoint\",\n        \"url\": hit.get(\"web_url\", \"\"),\n        \"date\": None,\n        \"score\": score,\n    }\n\n\ndef _fallback_listing(client, parsed: ParsedQuery) -> list[dict]:\n    terms = [normalize(p) for p in parsed.phrases] + list(parsed.keywords)\n    if parsed.doc_number:\n        terms.append(normalize(parsed.doc_number))\n    terms = [t for t in terms if t]\n    if not terms:\n        return []\n    results: list[dict] = []\n    for library, folder in _fallback_folders():\n        try:\n            hits = client.list_folder_files(library, folder)\n        except GraphAPIError:\n            continue\n        for hit in hits:\n            name_fold = normalize(hit.get(\"name\", \"\"))\n            if any(term in name_fold for term in terms):\n                results.append(_to_result(hit, parsed))\n        if len(results) >= MAX_RESULTS:\n            break\n    return results[:MAX_RESULTS]\n\n\ndef search_sharepoint(parsed: ParsedQuery) -> tuple[list[dict], str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Trả (results, error_note). error_note=None khi thành công hoặc không cấu hình.\n\n    'search_fallback' = search API thiếu quyền, đã duyệt thư mục thay thế.\n    'unavailable'     = lỗi mạng/khác — caller trả kết quả DB kèm cờ partial.\n    \"\"\"\n    client = get_graph_client()\n    if not client.is_configured():\n        return [], \"not_configured\"\n    terms = list(parsed.phrases) + list(parsed.keywords)\n    query = \" \".join(terms)[:200] if terms else (parsed.doc_number or \"\")\n    if not query.strip():\n        return [], None\n    try:\n        hits = client.search_files(query, top=MAX_RESULTS)\n    except GraphAPIError as exc:\n        if exc.status_code in (403, 400):\n            return _fallback_listing(client, parsed), \"search_fallback\"\n        return [], \"unavailable\"\n    return [_to_result(hit, parsed) for hit in hits], None\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Chạy test pass** (`python manage.py test apps.assistant.tests_m365_search -v 2`).\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**\n\n```powershell\ngit add src/apps/assistant/m365_search.py **Step 2: Chạy test, xác nhận fail** — `ModuleNotFoundError: apps.assistant.services`.\n\n- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**\n\n```python\n# src/apps/assistant/services.py\n\"\"\"Ghép nguồn, xếp hạng và ghi nhật ký truy vấn chatbot.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport time\nfrom dataclasses import asdict\n\nfrom . import db_search, m365_search, nlp\nfrom .models import SearchQueryLog\n\nMAX_RESULTS = 20\nPARTIAL_NOTES = (\"unavailable\", \"search_fallback\")\n\n\ndef _iso_date(value):\n    return value.isoformat() if hasattr(value, \"isoformat\") else None\n\n\ndef _parsed_dict(parsed: nlp.ParsedQuery) -> dict:\n    data = asdict(parsed)\n    data[\"date_from\"] = _iso_date(parsed.date_from)\n    data[\"date_to\"] = _iso_date(parsed.date_to)\n    return data\n\n\ndef ask(question: str, user) -> dict:\n    parsed = nlp.parse(question)\n    started = time.perf_counter()\n    db_results = db_search.search_database(parsed, user)\n    sp_results, sp_note = m365_search.search_sharepoint(parsed)\n    took_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)\n\n    merged = sorted(\n        db_results + sp_results,\n        key=lambda r: (\n            -r[\"score\"],\n            -(r[\"date\"].toordinal() if r.get(\"date\") else 0),\n        ),\n    )[:MAX_RESULTS]\n\n    if db_results and sp_results:\n        sources = \"db+sharepoint\"\n    elif db_results:\n        sources = \"db\"\n    elif sp_results:\n        sources = \"sharepoint\"\n    else:\n        sources = \"none\"\n\n    SearchQueryLog.objects.create(\n        user=user,\n        question=question[:500],\n        parsed_filters=_parsed_dict(parsed),\n        result_count=len(merged),\n        sources=sources,\n        took_ms=took_ms,\n        error_note=sp_note if sp_note in (\"unavailable\", \"search_fallback\") else None,\n        created_by=user,\n    )\n\n    results = [\n        {**{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != \"score\"}, \"date\": _iso_date(r.get(\"date\"))}\n        for r in merged\n    ]\n    return {\n        \"query\": question,\n        \"parsed\": _parsed_dict(parsed),\n        \"took_ms\": took_ms,\n        \"partial\": sp_note in PARTIAL_NOTES,\n        \"results\": results,\n    }\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Chạy test pass** (`python manage.py test apps.assistant.tests_services -v 2`).\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: Implementation**\n\n```python\n# src/apps/assistant/views.py\nimport json\n\nfrom django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required\nfrom django.core.cache import caches\nfrom django.http import JsonResponse\nfrom django.shortcuts import render\nfrom django.views.decorators.cache import never_cache\nfrom django.views.decorators.http import require_POST\n\nfrom . import services\n\nRATE_LIMIT = 30\nRATE_WINDOW_SECONDS = 60\n\n\ndef _throttle_ok(user) -> bool:\n    key = f\"assistant:rl:{user.pk}\"\n    try:\n        if caches[\"default\"].add(key, 1, RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS):\n            return True\n        return caches[\"default\"].incr(key) <= RATE_LIMIT\n    except ValueError:\n        return True\n\n\n@login_required\ndef assistant_page(request):\n    return render(request, \"assistant/chat.html\")\n\n\n@login_required\n@require_POST\n@never_cache\ndef api_search(request):\n    try:\n        data = json.loads(request.body.decode(\"utf-8\") or \"{}\")\n    except json.JSONDecodeError:\n        return JsonResponse({\"error\": \"invalid_json\"}, status=400)\n    question = str(data.get(\"question\", \"\")).strip()[:500]\n    if len(question) < 2:\n        return JsonResponse({\"error\": \"question_too_short\"}, status=400)\n    if not _throttle_ok(request.user):\n        return JsonResponse({\"error\": \"rate_limited\"}, status=429)\n    return JsonResponse(services.ask(question, request.user))\n```\n\n```python\n# src/apps/assistant/urls.py\nfrom django.urls import path\n\nfrom . import views\n\napp_name = \"assistant\"\n\nurlpatterns = [\n 35	class GraphAPIError(Exception):
36	    """Lỗi khi gọi Microsoft Graph API (mạng, xác thực, hoặc phản hồi lỗi)."""
37	    def __init__(self, message, *, status_code=None, retry_after=None):
38	        super().__init__(message)
39	        self.status_code = status_code
40	        self.retry_after = retry_after

44	class GraphNotConfigured(GraphAPIError):
45	    """Chưa điền đủ M365_TENANT_ID / M365_CLIENT_ID / M365_CLIENT_SECRET trong .env."""
46
