48	class GraphClient:
49	    """
50	    Wrapper mỏng quanh Microsoft Graph API. Tự lấy & cache access token,
51	    tự dò site_id / drive_id theo tên site + tên thư viện, và cung cấp các
52	    thao tác tệp cơ bản (upload/download/delete/exists/url).
53
54	    Instance này an toàn dùng lại nhiều lần (token được cache trong tiến
55	    trình, tự làm mới khi gần hết hạn).
56	    """
57
58	    _lock = threading.Lock()
59
60	    def __init__(self):
61	        self.tenant_id = getattr(settings, "M365_TENANT_ID", "") or ""
62	        self.client_id = getattr(settings, "M365_CLIENT_ID", "") or ""
63	        self.client_secret = getattr(settings, "M365_CLIENT_SECRET", "") or ""
64	        self.site_hostname = getattr(settings, "M365_SHAREPOINT_HOSTNAME", "") or ""
65	        self.site_path = getattr(settings, "M365_SHAREPOINT_SITE_PATH", "") or ""
66
67	        self._token = None
68	        self._token_expires_at = 0
69	        self._site_id_cache = None
70	        self._drive_id_cache = {}
71
72	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
73	    # Xác thực
74	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
75	    def is_configured(self) -> bool:
76	        return bool(self.tenant_id and self.client_id and self.client_secret)
77
78	    def _require_configured(self):
79	        if not self.is_configured():
80	            raise GraphNotConfigured(
81	                "Chưa cấu hình M365_TENANT_ID / M365_CLIENT_ID / M365_CLIENT_SECRET "
82	                "trong .env. Xem docs/16_M365_Integration_Setup.md."
83	            )
84
85	    def _get_token(self) -> str:
86	        self._require_configured()
87	        with self._lock:
88	            if self._token and time.time() < self._token_expires_at - 60:
89	                return self._token
90
91	            try:
92	                import msal
93	            except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - phụ thuộc môi trường
94	                raise GraphAPIError(
95	                    "Thiếu thư viện 'msal'. Chạy: pip install -r requirements.txt"
96	                ) from exc
97
98	            app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
99	                client_id=self.client_id,
100	                client_credential=self.client_secret,
101	                authority=AUTH_AUTHORITY.format(tenant_id=self.tenant_id),
102	            )
103	            result: dict = app.acquire_token_for_client(scopes=GRAPH_SCOPE)  # type: ignore[assignment]
104	            if "access_token" not in result:
105	                raise GraphAPIError(
106	                    "Không xác thực được với dịch vụ lưu trữ.", status_code=503
107	                )
108
109	            self._token = result["access_token"]
110	            self._token_expires_at = time.time() + result.get("expires_in", 3600)
111	            return self._token
112
113	    def _headers(self, extra=None):
114	        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {self._get_token()}"}
115	        if extra:
116	            headers.update(extra)
117	        return headers
118
119	    def _request(self, method, url, **kwargs):
120	        headers = kwargs.pop("headers", {}) or {}
121	        try:
122	            response = requests.request(method, url, headers=self._headers(headers), timeout=60, **kwargs)
123	        except requests.RequestException as error:
124	            raise GraphAPIError("Không kết nối được dịch vụ lưu trữ.", status_code=503) from error
125	        if response.status_code >= 400:
126	            retry_after = response.headers.get("Retry-After")
127	            raise GraphAPIError(f"Graph trả lỗi HTTP {response.status_code}.",
128	                status_code=response.status_code, retry_after=retry_after)
129	        return response
130
131	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
132	    # Dò site_id / drive_id (cache lại vì hiếm khi đổi)
133	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
134	    @property
135	    def site_id(self) -> str:
136	        if self._site_id_cache:
137	            return self._site_id_cache
138	        if not (self.site_hostname and self.site_path):
139	            raise GraphNotConfigured(
140	                "Chưa cấu hình M365_SHAREPOINT_HOSTNAME / M365_SHAREPOINT_SITE_PATH trong .env."
141	            )
142	        url = f"{GRAPH_BASE}/sites/{self.site_hostname}:{self.site_path}"
143	        data = self._request("GET", url).json()
144	        self._site_id_cache = data["id"]
145	        return self._site_id_cache
146
147	    def _drive_id(self, library_name: str) -> str:
148	        """Trả về drive_id của một Document Library (ví dụ 'Documents', 'CongVan')."""
149	        if library_name in self._drive_id_cache:
150	            return self._drive_id_cache[library_name]
151
152	        url = f"{GRAPH_BASE}/sites/{self.site_id}/drives"
153	        data = self._request("GET", url).json()
154	        for drive in data.get("value", []):
155	            if drive.get("name", "").lower() == library_name.lower():
156	                self._drive_id_cache[library_name] = drive["id"]
157	                return drive["id"]
158
159	        raise GraphAPIError(
160	            f"Không tìm thấy thư viện tài liệu '{library_name}' trong site SharePoint. "
161	            "Kiểm tra lại tên thư viện (Document Library) trên SharePoint."
162	        )
163
164	    def _item_url(self, library_name: str, path: str, suffix: str = "") -> str:
165	        drive_id = self._drive_id(library_name)
166	        path = path.lstrip("/")
167	        return f"{GRAPH_BASE}/drives/{drive_id}/root:/{path}{suffix}"
168
169	    def _ensure_parent_folders(self, library_name: str, path: str) -> None:
170	        """Create missing parent folders in a drive before uploading a file."""
171	        parent_path = posixpath.dirname(path.strip("/"))
172	        if not parent_path:
173	            return
174
175	        drive_id = self._drive_id(library_name)
176	        parent = ""
177	        for folder_name in parent_path.split("/"):
178	            if not folder_name:
179	                continue
180	            children_url = (
181	                f"{GRAPH_BASE}/drives/{drive_id}/root/children"
182	                if not parent
183	                else f"{GRAPH_BASE}/drives/{drive_id}/root:/{parent}:/children"
184	            )
185	            try:
186	                self._request(
187	                    "POST",
188	                    children_url,
189	                    json={
190	                        "name": folder_name,
191	                        "folder": {},
192	                        "@microsoft.graph.conflictBehavior": "fail",
193	                    },
194	                )
195	            except GraphAPIError as exc:
196	                if exc.status_code != 409:
197	                    raise
198	            parent = posixpath.join(parent, folder_name)
199
200	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
201	    # Thao tác tệp
202	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
203	    def upload_file(self, library_name: str, path: str, content: bytes) -> dict:
204	        """Tải tệp lên thư viện. Tự chọn upload đơn giản hoặc upload session
205	        theo dung lượng tệp. Trả về JSON metadata (driveItem) của Graph."""
206	        self._ensure_parent_folders(library_name, path)
207	        if len(content) <= SIMPLE_UPLOAD_LIMIT:
208	            url = self._item_url(library_name, path, ":/content")
209	            response = self._request(
210	                "PUT", url, data=content,
211	                headers={"Content-Type": "application/octet-stream"},
212	            )
213	            return response.json()
214
215	        return self._upload_large_file(library_name, path, content)
216
217	    def _upload_large_file(self, library_name: str, path: str, content: bytes) -> dict:
218	        session_url = self._item_url(library_name, path, ":/createUploadSession")
219	        session = self._request("POST", session_url, json={}).json()
220	        upload_url = session["uploadUrl"]
221
222	        stream = io.BytesIO(content)
223	        total = len(content)
224	        start = 0
225	        last_response = None
226	        while start < total:
227	            chunk = stream.read(CHUNK_SIZE)
228	            end = start + len(chunk) - 1
229	            # Upload session dùng URL đã ký sẵn, KHÔNG cần header Authorization.
230	            last_response = requests.put(
231	                upload_url,
232	                data=chunk,
233	                headers={
234	                    "Content-Length": str(len(chunk)),
235	                    "Content-Range": f"bytes {start}-{end}/{total}",
236	                },
237	                timeout=120,
238	            )
239	            if last_response.status_code >= 400:
240	                raise GraphAPIError(
241	                    f"Upload session lỗi tại byte {start}: "
242	                    f"HTTP {last_response.status_code}.", status_code=last_response.status_code,
243	                    retry_after=last_response.headers.get("Retry-After")
244	                )
245	            start = end + 1
246
247	        return last_response.json()
248
249	    def download_file(self, library_name: str, path: str) -> bytes:
250	        url = self._item_url(library_name, path, ":/content")
251	        return self._request("GET", url).content
252
253	    def delete_file(self, library_name: str, path: str) -> None:
254	        url = self._item_url(library_name, path)
255	        try:
256	            self._request("DELETE", url)
257	        except GraphAPIError as exc:
258	            if exc.status_code != 404:
259	                raise
260
261	    def exists(self, library_name: str, path: str) -> bool:
262	        url = self._item_url(library_name, path)
263	        try:
264	            self._request("GET", url)
265	            return True
266	        except GraphAPIError as exc:
267	            if exc.status_code == 404:
268	                return False
269	            raise
270
271	    def get_metadata(self, library_name: str, path: str) -> dict:
272	        url = self._item_url(library_name, path)
273	        return self._request("GET", url).json()
274
275	    def get_web_url(self, library_name: str, path: str) -> str:
276	        """Link xem tệp trực tiếp trên SharePoint/OneDrive (mở trình duyệt)."""
277	        return self.get_metadata(library_name, path).get("webUrl", "")

from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractUser
from django.db import models


class Role(models.Model):
    """Theo 10_RBAC_Permission_Matrix.md mục 2 — 8 vai trò chuẩn."""
    role_code = models.CharField(max_length=30, unique=True, db_column="RoleCode")
    role_name = models.CharField(max_length=100, db_column="RoleName")

    class Meta:
        db_table = "tblRole"

    def __str__(self):
        return self.role_name


class User(AbstractUser):
    role = models.ForeignKey(
        Role, null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        db_column="RoleID", related_name="users",
    )
    employee = models.OneToOneField(
        "hrm.Employee", null=True, blank=True, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        db_column="EmployeeID", related_name="user_account",
    )
    external_object_id = models.CharField(
        max_length=100, null=True, blank=True, unique=True,
        db_column="ExternalObjectId",
    )

    class Meta:
        db_table = "tblUser"


class SecurityEvent(models.Model):
    """Access metadata only: never store values, filenames, query strings or secrets."""
    user = models.ForeignKey('security.User', null=True, on_delete=models.SET_NULL)
    action = models.CharField(max_length=40)
    resource = models.CharField(max_length=100)
    record_id = models.CharField(max_length=64, blank=True)
    occurred_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True, db_index=True)

    class Meta:
        db_table = 'tblSecurityEvent'
        ordering = ('-occurred_at',)

80	def people_matches(scope, query):
81	    """Normalize only safe search columns after scope, bounded on both backends.
82
83	    A bounded probe and one result query add at most one SELECT to the previous
84	    direct result query. No collation/schema changes or sensitive field loads.
85	    """
86	    ordered = scope.order_by("full_name", "pk")
87	    candidates = list(ordered.values_list("pk", "full_name", "employee_code", "company_email")[:PEOPLE_SCAN_LIMIT + 1])
88	    limited = len(candidates) > PEOPLE_SCAN_LIMIT
89	    if limited:
90	        matches = ordered.filter(Q(full_name__icontains=query) | Q(employee_code__icontains=query)
91	                                 | Q(company_email__icontains=query))
92	    else:
93	        needle = normalized(query)
94	        ids = []
95	        for pk, *fields in candidates:
96	            if any(needle in normalized(field or "") for field in fields):
97	                ids.append(pk)
98	                if len(ids) == 21:
99	                    break
100	        matches = ordered.filter(pk__in=ids)
101	    return matches.select_related("department").only(
102	        "pk", "full_name", "employee_code", "company_email", "department__department_name")[:21], limited

105	@login_required
106	@require_GET
107	@never_cache
108	def global_search(request):
109	    query = request.GET.get("q", "").strip()[:100]
110	    people, pages = [], []
111	    search_limited = False
112	    if len(query) >= 2:
113	        needle = normalized(query)
114	        pages = [dict(label=label, href=reverse("portal:" + route))
115	                 for label, route, permission in PAGES
116	                 if page_visible(request.user, route, permission)
117	                 and needle in normalized(label)]
118	        employee = _get_employee(request)
119	        qs, _ = dashboard_employee_scope(request.user, employee)
120	        if qs is None:
121	            qs = Employee.objects.filter(pk=employee.pk) if employee and not employee.is_deleted else Employee.objects.none()
122	        matches, search_limited = people_matches(qs, query)
123	        can_open = has_permission(request.user, "manage_hr") or has_permission(request.user, "view_all_employees")
124	        for person in matches:
125	            people.append(dict(name=person.full_name, code=person.employee_code, email=person.company_email,
126	                               department=person.department.department_name if person.department else "—",
127	                               href=reverse("portal:hr_employee_detail", args=[person.pk]) if can_open
128	                               else reverse("portal:profile") if employee and person.pk == employee.pk else None))
129	    return render(request, "portal/global_search.html", dict(search_query=query,
130	                  search_people=people[:20], search_pages=pages, search_more=len(people) > 20,
131	                  search_limited=search_limited))

6	def managed_departments_for(user, *, global_roles=(), scoped_roles=(DEPT_MANAGER,)):

8	    from apps.organization.models import Department
9
10	    qs = Department.objects.all()
11	    if not getattr(user, "is_authenticated", False) or not getattr(user, "is_active", False):
12	        return qs.none()
13	    role = get_role_code(user)

15	        return qs

17	        return qs.none()
18	    employee = getattr(user, "employee", None)
19	    if not employee or employee.is_deleted:

37	def visible_dispatches_for(user, queryset=None):
38	    from apps.document.models import OfficialDispatch
39	    qs = queryset if queryset is not None else OfficialDispatch.objects.all()
40	    if not user.is_authenticated or not user.is_active:
41	        return qs.none()
42	    if user.is_superuser:
43	        return qs
44	    employee = getattr(user, 'employee', None)
45	    role = get_role_code(user)
46	    if role in ('PROJECT_MANAGER', 'PROJECT_COORDINATOR'):
47	        qs = qs.filter(dispatch_type='Outgoing')
48	    elif not has_permission(user, 'access_outgoing_document'):
49	        if not employee:
50	            return qs.none()
51	        scope = Q(assigned_to=employee)
52	        if employee.department_id:
53	            scope |= Q(department_id=employee.department_id)
54	        qs = qs.filter(scope)
55	    if role not in ('SUPER_ADMIN', 'DIRECTOR', 'HR_MANAGER', 'HR_OFFICER'):
56	        private_scope = Q(created_by=user)
57	        if employee:
58	            private_scope |= Q(assigned_to=employee) | Q(signer=employee)
59	        qs = qs.filter(Q(security_level='Normal') | private_scope)
60	    return qs

63	def can_read_file(user, obj):
64	    if not user.is_authenticated or not user.is_active or obj.is_deleted:
65	        return False
66	    employee = getattr(user, 'employee', None)
67	    if employee and employee.is_deleted:
68	        return False
69	    if user.is_superuser:
70	        return True
71	    role = get_role_code(user)
72	    label = obj._meta.label_lower
73	    if label == 'document.personneldecision':
74	        employee_recipient = bool(employee and obj.status == 'Issued' and obj.employee_id == employee.pk)
75	        return has_permission(user, 'manage_hr') or (
76	            employee_recipient or (
77	                has_permission(user, 'approve_personnel_decision')
78	                and (obj.status == 'PendingApproval' or obj.history.filter(created_by=user).exists())
79	            )
80	        )
81	    if label == 'document.document':
82	        return obj.status == 'Approved' or obj.created_by_id == user.pk or has_permission(user, 'approve_document') or has_permission(user, 'manage_hr')
83	    if label == 'document.officialdispatch':
84	        return visible_dispatches_for(user).filter(pk=obj.pk).exists()
85	    if label == 'office.incomingdocument':
86	        return has_permission(user, 'manage_office') or bool(employee and employee.pk in (obj.handler_id, obj.received_by_id))
87	    if label == 'office.outgoingdocument':
88	        return has_permission(user, 'access_outgoing_document')
89	    if label == 'recruitment.candidate':
90	        return has_permission(user, 'manage_hr')
91	    if label in ('leave.leaverequest', 'hrm.employeeprofilechangerequest'):
92	        if obj.employee.is_deleted:
93	            return False
94	        if employee and obj.employee_id == employee.pk:
95	            return True
96	        if label == 'hrm.employeeprofilechangerequest':
97	            return has_permission(user, 'approve_profile_change_request')
98	        if has_permission(user, 'manage_hr') or has_permission(user, 'approve_leave_all_departments'):
99	            return True
100	        return bool(employee and role == 'DEPT_MANAGER' and employee.managed_departments.filter(pk=obj.employee.department_id).exists())
101	    if label == 'm365.companymedia':
102	        return True  # Published internal company media, after authentication.
103	    if label in ('activity.activityproposal', 'task.task'):
104	        from apps.activity.permissions import can_view_activity
105	        if obj.activity_id and obj.activity.is_deleted:
106	            return False
107	        if label == 'activity.activityproposal':
108	            return can_view_activity(user, obj.activity)
109	        own = bool(employee and employee.pk in (obj.assigned_to_employee_id, obj.assigned_by_employee_id))
110	        if obj.activity_id:
111	            return own or can_view_activity(user, obj.activity)
112	        return own or role == 'HR_MANAGER' or bool(employee and role == 'DEPT_MANAGER' and employee.managed_departments.filter(pk=obj.assigned_to_employee.department_id).exists())
113	    return False

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

def get_role_code(user):
    """Mã vai trò của tài khoản, None nếu chưa gán vai trò."""
    role = getattr(user, "role", None)
    return role.role_code if role else None


def get_role_name(user):
    role = getattr(user, "role", None)
    if role:
        return role.role_name
    if getattr(user, "is_superuser", False):
        return "Quản trị viên cấp cao"
    if getattr(user, "is_staff", False):
        return "Quản trị viên"
    return "Nhân viên"


def has_permission(user, permission):
    """Tài khoản có quyền này không. Superuser luôn có mọi quyền."""
    if not getattr(user, "is_authenticated", False) or not getattr(user, "is_active", False):
        return False
    if getattr(user, "is_superuser", False):
        return True
    if permission in STAFF_ALSO_ALLOWED and getattr(user, "is_staff", False):
        return True
    return get_role_code(user) in PERMISSION_MATRIX.get(permission, ())


def permission_flags(user):
    """Toàn bộ quyền dưới dạng can_<tên quyền> để dùng trong template."""
    return {f"can_{name}": has_permission(user, name) for name in PERMISSION_MATRIX}

(\"quyết định\", \"personnel_decision\"),\n    (\"công văn\", \"dispatch\"),\n    (\"văn bản\", \"dispatch\"),\n    (\"tài liệu\", \"document\"),\n]\n\nSTOPWORDS = {\n    \"tìm\", \"kiếm\", \"tìm kiếm\", \"cho\", \"tôi\", \"mình\", \"em\", \"anh\", \"chị\", \"bạn\",\n    \"xin\", \"hãy\", \"về\", \"củа\", \"củа\", \"va\", \"và\", \"các\", \"những\", \"một\", \"là\",\n    \"ở\", \"theo\", \"giúp\", \"với\", \"được\", \"bị\", \"trong\", \"ngoài\", \"từ\", \"đến\",\n    \"ngày\", \"nào\", \"này\", \"đó\", \"mới\", \"gần\", \"nhất\", \"gần đây\", \"liên quan\",\n}\n\n_TYPE_TOKENS = set()\nfor _label, _code in DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS:\n    _TYPE_TOKENS.update(_label.split())\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ParsedQuery:\n    doc_number: str | None = None\n    phrases: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    keywords: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)\n    date_from: date | None = None\n    date_to: date | None = None\n    doc_type: str | None = None\n\n    def has_constraints(self) -> bool:\n        return bool(self.doc_number or self.phrases or self.keywords or self.date_from or self.date_to)\n\n\ndef normalize(text: str) -> str:\n    return \"\".join(\n        c for c in unicodedata.normalize(\"NFD\", text.casefold().replace(\"đ\", \"d\"))\n        if not unicodedata.combining(c)\n    )\n\n\ndef _last_day_of_month(year: int, month: int) -> date:\n    if month == 12:\n        return date(year, 12, 31)\n    return date(year, month + 1, 1) - timedelta(days=1)\n\n\ndef _parse_iso(value: str) -> date:\n    for fmt in (\"%d/%m/%Y\", \"%d-%m-%Y\", \"%Y-%m-%d\"):\n        try:\n            return date.fromisoformat(value) if \"%Y\" == fmt[:2] else datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date()\n        except ValueError:\n            continue\n    raise ValueError(value)\n\n\ndef _extract_dates(text: str, today: date) -> tuple[str, date | None, date | None]:\n    match = FROM_TO_RE.search(text)\n    if match:\n        start = _parse_iso(match.group(1).replace(\"-\", \"/\") if \"-\" in match.group(1) and match.group(1).count(\"-\") == 2 else match.group(1))\n        end = _parse_iso(match.group(2).replace(\"-\", \"/\") if \"-\" in match.group(2) and match.group(2).count(\"-\") == 2 else match.group(2))\n        return (text[:match.start()] + \" \" + text[match.end():], start, end)\n\n    lowered = text.casefold()\n    if \"tuần trước\" in lowered:\n        return (text.replace(\"tuần trước\", \"\", 1), today - timedelta(days=7), today)\n    if \"tháng trước\" in lowered:\n        first = today.replace(day=1)\n ngoái\", \"\", 1), date(today.year - 1, 1, 1), date(today.year - 1, 12, 31))\n\n    match = QUARTER_RE.search(text)\n    if match:\n        quarter = int(match.group(1))\n        year = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else today.year\n        start = date(year, quarter * 3 - 2, 1)\n        return (text[:match.start()] + \" \" + text[match.end():], start, _last_day_of_month(year, quarter * 3))\n\n    match = MONTH_RE.search(text)\n    if match:\n        month = int(match.group(1))\n        year = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else today.year\n YEAR_RE.search(text)\n    if match:\n        year = int(match.group(1))\n        return (text[:match.start()] + \" \" + text[match.end():], date(year, 1, 1), date(year, 12, 31))\n\n    return (text, None, None)\n\n\ndef parse(question: str, today: date | None = None) -> ParsedQuery:\n    today = today or date.today()\n    text = \" \".join(question.split())[:500]\n    parsed = ParsedQuery()\n\n parsed.doc_type = code\n            text = re.sub(re.escape(label), \" \", text, count=1, flags=re.IGNORECASE)\n            break\n\n    if parsed.doc_type in (\"Incoming\", \"Outgoing\", \"InternalDirective\"):\n        pass  # giữ nguyên, đây là dispatch subtype\n    elif parsed.doc_type == \"dispatch\" and any(\n        normalize(k) in lowered for k in (\"cong van den\", \"cong van di\")\n    ):\n        # đã xử lý ở trên theo thứ tự ưu tiên; an toàn khi không trùng\n        pass\n\n    raw_tokens = text.split()\n    keywords: list[str] = []\n    for token in raw_tokens:\n parsed.keywords = [normalize(text).strip()[:200]]\n\n    return parsed\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Chạy test, fix đến khi pass**\n\n```powershell\npython manage.py test apps.assistant.tests_nlp -v có.\n\nMỗi nhánh dùng đúng quy tắc visibility của view tương ứng: dispatch dùng\nvisible_dispatches_for; document chỉ status Approved; personnel decision theo\nmanage_hr / approve_personnel_decision.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom django.db.models import Q\nfrom django.urls import reverse\n\nfrom apps.document.models import Document, OfficialDispatch, PersonnelDecision\nfrom apps.document.hcns.catalog import FORMS\nfrom apps.security.data_access import visible_dispatches_for\nfrom apps.security.permissions import has_permission\n\nfrom .nlp import ParsedQuery\n\nRECENT_LIMIT = 10\nSCAN_LIMIT = 50\nMAX_PER_TYPE = 15\n\n\ndef _score(parsed: ParsedQuery, *, title: str, number: str = \"\", extra: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> int:\n    score = 0\n    if parsed.doc_number and parsed.doc_number.casefold() in (number or \"\").replace(\" \", \"\").casefold():\n        score += 100\n    title_fold = (title or \"\").casefold()\n    for phrase in parsed.phrases:\n        if phrase.casefold() in title_fold:\n            score += 40\n    for kw in parsed.keywords:\n        if kw.casefold() in title_fold:\n            score += 10\n            continue\n        for value in extra:\n            if kw.casefold() in (value or \"\").casefold():\n                score += 5\n                break\n    return score\n\n\ndef _has_constraints(parsed: ParsedQuery) -> bool:\n    return parsed.has_constraints()\n\n\ndef _search_dispatches(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:\n    if parsed.doc_type == \"document\" or parsed.doc_type == \"personnel_decision\":\n        return []\n    qs = visible_dispatches_for(user, OfficialDispatch.objects.select_related(\"dispatch_book\"))\n    if parsed.doc_type in (\"Incoming\", \"Outgoing\", \"InternalDirective\"):\n        qs = qs.filter(dispatch_type=parsed.doc_type)\n    if parsed.doc_number:\n        qs = qs.filter(\n            Q(dispatch_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number) | Q(original_doc_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)\n        )\n    elif _has_constraints(parsed):\n        text_q = Q()\n        for phrase in parsed.phrases:\n            text_q |= Q(title__icontains=phrase) | Q(issuing_organization__icontains=phrase)\n        for kw in parsed.keywords:\n            text_q |= Q(title__icontains=kw) | Q(issuing_organization__icontains=kw) | Q(dispatch_no__icontains=kw)\n        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()\n    if parsed.date_from:\n        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__gte=parsed.date_from)\n    if parsed.date_to:\n        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__lte=parsed.date_to)\n    if not _has_constraints(parsed):\n        qs = qs.order_by(\"-received_or_sent_date\")[:RECENT_LIMIT]\n    rows = []\n    for d in qs.order_by(\"-received_or_sent_date\")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:\n        title = f\"[{d.get_dispatch_type_display()}] {d.dispatch_no} - {d.title}\"\n        meta = f\"{d.get_dispatch_type_display()} · {d.dispatch_no} · {d.issuing_organization}\"\n        score = _score(parsed, title=d.title, number=f\"{d.dispatch_no} {d.original_doc_no or ''}\",\n                       extra=(d.issuing_organization, d.dispatch_no))\n        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:\n            continue\n        rows.append({\n            \"source\": \"ihrms\", \"type\": \"official_dispatch\", \"title\": title, \"meta\": meta,\n            \"url\": reverse(\"portal:dispatch_detail\", args=[d.pk]),\n            \"date\": d.issue_date, \"score\": score,\n        })\n    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]\n\n\ndef _search_documents(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:\n    if parsed.doc_type not in (None, \"document\") and parsed.doc_type not in (\"Incoming\", \"Outgoing\", \"InternalDirective\", \"dispatch\"):\n        if parsed.doc_type != \"document\":\n            return []\n    if parsed.doc_type == \"personnel_decision\":\n        return []\n    qs = Document.objects.filter(status=\"Approved\").select_related(\"category\")\n    if parsed.doc_number:\n        qs = qs.filter(document_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)\n    elif _has_constraints(parsed):\n        text_q = Q()\n        for phrase in parsed.phrases:\n            text_q |= Q(document_name__icontains=phrase) | Q(category__category_name__icontains=phrase)\n        for kw in parsed.keywords:\n            text_q |= Q(document_name__icontains=kw) | Q(document_no__icontains=kw)\n        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()\n    if parsed.date_from:\n        qs = qs.filter(effective_date__gte=parsed.date_from)\n    if parsed.date_to:\n        qs = qs.filter(effective_date__lte=parsed.date_to)\n    if not _has_constraints(parsed):\n        qs = qs.order_by(\"-effective_date\")[:RECENT_LIMIT]\n    rows = []\n    for doc in qs.order_by(\"-effective_date\")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:\n        score = _score(parsed, title=doc.document_name, number=doc.document_no,\n                       extra=(doc.category.category_name,))\n        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:\n            continue\n        rows.append({\n            \"source\": \"ihrms\", \"type\": \"document\",\n            \"title\": f\"{doc.document_no} - {doc.document_name}\",\n            \"meta\": f\"Tài liệu · {doc.document_no} · {doc.category.category_name}\",\n            \"url\": reverse(\"portal:document_list\"),\n            \"date\": doc.effective_date, \"score\": score,\n        })\n    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]\n\n\ndef _search_decisions(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:\n    if parsed.doc_type not in (None, \"personnel_decision\", \"dispatch\"):\n        return []\n    can_manage = has_permission(user, \"manage_hr\")\n    if not (can_manage or has_permission(user, \"approve_personnel_decision\")):\n        return []\n    qs = PersonnelDecision.objects.select_related(\"employee\")\n    if not can_manage:\n        qs = qs.filter(Q(status=\"PendingApproval\") | Q(history__created_by=user)).distinct()\n    if parsed.doc_number:\n        qs = qs.filter(decision_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)\n    elif _has_constraints(parsed):\n        text_q = Q()\n        for phrase in parsed.phrases:\n            text_q |= Q(employee__full_name__icontains=phrase) | Q(decision_no__icontains=phrase)\n        for kw in parsed.keywords:\n            text_q |= Q(employee__full_name__icontains=kw) | Q(employee__employee_code__icontains=kw) | Q(decision_no__icontains=kw)\n        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()\n    if parsed.date_from:\n        qs = qs.filter(decision_date__gte=parsed.date_from)\n    if parsed.date_to:\n        qs = qs.filter(decision_date__lte=parsed.date_to)\n    if not _has_constraints(parsed):\n        qs = qs.order_by(\"-created_date\")[:RECENT_LIMIT]\n    rows = []\n    for dec in qs.order_by(\"-created_date\")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:\n        template_title = FORMS.get(dec.template_slug, {}).get(\"title\", dec.template_slug)\n        title = f\"{dec.decision_no or dec.template_slug} - {template_title} - {dec.employee.full_name}\"\n        score = _score(parsed, title=title, number=dec.decision_no,\n                       extra=(dec.employee.full_name, template_title))\n        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:\n            continue\n        rows.append({\n            \"source\": \"ihrms\", \"type\": \"personnel_decision\", \"title\": title,\n            \"meta\": f\"Quyết định · {dec.decision_no or '—'} · {template_title}\",\n            \"url\": reverse(\"portal:personnel_decision_detail\", args=[dec.pk]),\n            \"date\": dec.decision_date, \"score\": score,\n        })\n    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]\n\n\ndef search_database(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:\n    return (\n        _search_dispatches(parsed, user)\n        + _search_documents(parsed, user)\n        + _search_decisions(parsed, user)\n    )\n```\n\n- [ ]    self._require_configured()\n        payload = {\n            \"requests\": [{\n                \"entityTypes\": [\"driveItem\"],\n                \"query\": {\"queryString\": query[:200]},\n f\"{GRAPH_BASE}/search/query\", json=payload).json()\n        prefix = f\"https://{self.site_hostname}{self.site_path}\"\n        results = []\n        for block in data.get(\"value\", []):\n            for container in block.get(\"hitsContainers\", []):\n                for hit in container.get(\"hits\", []):\n                    resource = hit.get(\"resource\", {}) or {}\n                    web_url = resource.get(\"webUrl\") or \"\"\n                    if web_url.startswith(prefix):\n                        results.append({\n                            \"name\": resource.get(\"name\", \"\"),\n                            \"web_url\": web_url,\n                            \"last_modified\": resource.get(\"lastModifiedDateTime\", \"\"),\n                        })\n                    if len(results) >= top:\n                        return results\n        return results\n\n    def list_folder_files(self, library_name: str, folder: str = \"\") -> list[dict]:\n        \"\"\"Liệt kê tệp (không đệ quy) trong một thư mục của Document Library.\"\"\"\n        drive_id = self._drive_id(library_name)\n        folder = (folder or \"\").strip(\"/\")\n        base = f\"{GRAPH_BASE}/drives/{drive_id}/root\"\n        url = f\"{base}:/{folder}:/children\" if folder else f\"{base}/children\"\n        data = self._request(\"GET\", url, params={\"$top\": 200}).json()\n        items = []\n        for entry in data.get(\"value\", []):\n            if \"folder\" in entry:\n                continue\n            items.append({\n                \"name\": entry.get(\"name\", \"\"),\n                \"web_url\": entry.get(\"webUrl\", \"\"),\n                \"last_modified\": entry.get(\"lastModifiedDateTime\", \"\"),\n            })\n        return apps.assistant.m365_search`.\n\n- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**\n\n```python\n# src/apps/assistant/m365_search.py\n\"\"\"Tìm kiếm tệp trên SharePoint cho chatbot qua GraphClient.\n\nƯu tiên Graph /search/query; khi thiếu consent (403/400) fallback duyệt các\nthư mục nghiệp vụ đã cấu hình và lọc theo tên tệp.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom django.conf import settings\n\nfrom apps.m365.graph_client import GraphAPIError, get_graph_client\n\nfrom .nlp import ParsedQuery, normalize\n\nMAX_RESULTS = 20\nFALLBACK_LIMIT_PER_FOLDER = 50\n\n\ndef _fallback_folders() -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    library = getattr(settings, \"M365_SHAREPOINT_LIBRARY\", \"Documents\") or \"Documents\"\n    folders = [\n        getattr(settings, \"M365_FOLDER_DISPATCHES\", \"CongVan\"),\n        getattr(settings, \"M365_FOLDER_INCOMING\", \"CongVanDen\"),\n        getattr(settings, \"M365_FOLDER_OUTGOING\", \"CongVanDi\"),\n    ]\n    seen, pairs = set(), []\n    for folder in folders:\n        folder = (folder or \"\").strip(\"/\")\n        if folder and folder not in seen:\n            seen.add(folder)\n            pairs.append((library, folder))\n    pairs.append((library, \"\"))\n    return pairs\n\n\ndef _to_result(hit: dict, parsed: ParsedQuery) -> dict:\n    name = hit.get(\"name\", \"\")\n    name_fold = normalize(name)\n    score = 0\n    if parsed.doc_number and normalize(parsed.doc_number) in name_fold:\n        score += 100\n    for phrase in parsed.phrases:\n        if normalize(phrase) in name_fold:\n            score += 40\n    for kw in parsed.keywords:\n        if kw in name_fold:\n            score += 10\n    return {\n        \"source\": \"sharepoint\",\n        \"type\": \"file\",\n        \"title\": name,\n        \"meta\": \"SharePoint\",\n        \"url\": hit.get(\"web_url\", \"\"),\n        \"date\": None,\n        \"score\": score,\n    }\n\n\ndef _fallback_listing(client, parsed: ParsedQuery) -> list[dict]:\n    terms = [normalize(p) for p in parsed.phrases] + list(parsed.keywords)\n    if parsed.doc_number:\n        terms.append(normalize(parsed.doc_number))\n    terms = [t for t in terms if t]\n    if not terms:\n        return []\n    results: list[dict] = []\n    for library, folder in _fallback_folders():\n        try:\n            hits = client.list_folder_files(library, folder)\n        except GraphAPIError:\n            continue\n        for hit in hits:\n            name_fold = normalize(hit.get(\"name\", \"\"))\n            if any(term in name_fold for term in terms):\n                results.append(_to_result(hit, parsed))\n        if len(results) >= MAX_RESULTS:\n            break\n    return results[:MAX_RESULTS]\n\n\ndef search_sharepoint(parsed: ParsedQuery) -> tuple[list[dict], str | None]:\n    \"\"\"Trả (results, error_note). error_note=None khi thành công hoặc không cấu hình.\n\n    'search_fallback' = search API thiếu quyền, đã duyệt thư mục thay thế.\n    'unavailable'     = lỗi mạng/khác — caller trả kết quả DB kèm cờ partial.\n    \"\"\"\n    client = get_graph_client()\n    if not client.is_configured():\n        return [], \"not_configured\"\n    terms = list(parsed.phrases) + list(parsed.keywords)\n    query = \" \".join(terms)[:200] if terms else (parsed.doc_number or \"\")\n    if not query.strip():\n        return [], None\n    try:\n        hits = client.search_files(query, top=MAX_RESULTS)\n    except GraphAPIError as exc:\n        if exc.status_code in (403, 400):\n            return _fallback_listing(client, parsed), \"search_fallback\"\n        return [], \"unavailable\"\n    return [_to_result(hit, parsed) for hit in hits], None\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Chạy test pass** (`python manage.py test apps.assistant.tests_m365_search -v 2`).\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**\n\n```powershell\ngit add src/apps/assistant/m365_search.py **Step 2: Chạy test, xác nhận fail** — `ModuleNotFoundError: apps.assistant.services`.\n\n- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**\n\n```python\n# src/apps/assistant/services.py\n\"\"\"Ghép nguồn, xếp hạng và ghi nhật ký truy vấn chatbot.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport time\nfrom dataclasses import asdict\n\nfrom . import db_search, m365_search, nlp\nfrom .models import SearchQueryLog\n\nMAX_RESULTS = 20\nPARTIAL_NOTES = (\"unavailable\", \"search_fallback\")\n\n\ndef _iso_date(value):\n    return value.isoformat() if hasattr(value, \"isoformat\") else None\n\n\ndef _parsed_dict(parsed: nlp.ParsedQuery) -> dict:\n    data = asdict(parsed)\n    data[\"date_from\"] = _iso_date(parsed.date_from)\n    data[\"date_to\"] = _iso_date(parsed.date_to)\n    return data\n\n\ndef ask(question: str, user) -> dict:\n    parsed = nlp.parse(question)\n    started = time.perf_counter()\n    db_results = db_search.search_database(parsed, user)\n    sp_results, sp_note = m365_search.search_sharepoint(parsed)\n    took_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)\n\n    merged = sorted(\n        db_results + sp_results,\n        key=lambda r: (\n            -r[\"score\"],\n            -(r[\"date\"].toordinal() if r.get(\"date\") else 0),\n        ),\n    )[:MAX_RESULTS]\n\n    if db_results and sp_results:\n        sources = \"db+sharepoint\"\n    elif db_results:\n        sources = \"db\"\n    elif sp_results:\n        sources = \"sharepoint\"\n    else:\n        sources = \"none\"\n\n    SearchQueryLog.objects.create(\n        user=user,\n        question=question[:500],\n        parsed_filters=_parsed_dict(parsed),\n        result_count=len(merged),\n        sources=sources,\n        took_ms=took_ms,\n        error_note=sp_note if sp_note in (\"unavailable\", \"search_fallback\") else None,\n        created_by=user,\n    )\n\n    results = [\n        {**{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != \"score\"}, \"date\": _iso_date(r.get(\"date\"))}\n        for r in merged\n    ]\n    return {\n        \"query\": question,\n        \"parsed\": _parsed_dict(parsed),\n        \"took_ms\": took_ms,\n        \"partial\": sp_note in PARTIAL_NOTES,\n        \"results\": results,\n    }\n```\n\n- [ ] **Step 4: Chạy test pass** (`python manage.py test apps.assistant.tests_services -v 2`).\n\n- [ ] **Step 5: 293	- [ ] **Step 3: Viết implementation**
294
295	```python
296	# src/apps/assistant/nlp.py
297	"""Parser câu hỏi tiếng Việt cho trợ lý tài liệu.
298
299	Thuần quy tắc, deterministic, không LLM. Pipeline: số hiệu → cụm ngoặc kép →
300	mốc thờ gian → loại văn bản → từ khóa còn lại (đã bỏ stopword).
301	"""
302	from __future__ import annotations
303
304	import re
305	import unicodedata
306	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
307	from datetime import date, timedelta
308
309	DOC_NUMBER_RE = re.compile(
310	    r"(?:số\s*)?(\d{1,5}\s*/\s*[A-Za-zÀ-ỹ0-9]+(?:\s*-\s*[A-Za-zÀ-ỹ0-9]+)*)",
311	    re.IGNORECASE,
312	)
313	QUOTED_RE = re.compile(r'"([^"]+)"')
314	MONTH_RE = re.compile(r"tháng\s+(\d{1,2})(?:\s*(?:năm|\/)\s*(\d{4}))?", re.IGNORECASE)
315	QUARTER_RE = re.compile(r"quý\s+([1-4])(?:\s*năm\s*(\d{4}))?", re.IGNORECASE)
316	YEAR_RE = re.compile(r"\bnăm\s+(\d{4})\b", re.IGNORECASE)
317	FROM_TO_RE = re.compile(
318	    r"từ\s+(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})\s*(?:đến|tới)\s+(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})",
319	    re.IGNORECASE,
320	)
321
322	DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS = [
323	    ("công văn đến", "Incoming"),
324	    ("công văn đi", "Outgoing"),
325	    ("văn bản chỉ đạo nội bộ", "InternalDirective"),
326	    ("chỉ đạo nội bộ", "InternalDirective"),
327	    ("văn bản nội bộ", "InternalDirective"),
328	    ("quyết định", "personnel_decision"),
329	    ("công văn", "dispatch"),
330	    ("văn bản", "dispatch"),
331	    ("tài liệu", "document"),
332	]
333
334	STOPWORDS = {
335	    "tìm", "kiếm", "tìm kiếm", "cho", "tôi", "mình", "em", "anh", "chị", "bạn",
336	    "xin", "hãy", "về", "củа", "củа", "va", "và", "các", "những", "một", "là",
337	    "ở", "theo", "giúp", "với", "được", "bị", "trong", "ngoài", "từ", "đến",
338	    "ngày", "nào", "này", "đó", "mới", "gần", "nhất", "gần đây", "liên quan",
339	}
340
341	_TYPE_TOKENS = set()
342	for _label, _code in DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS:
343	    _TYPE_TOKENS.update(_label.split())
344
345
346	@dataclass
347	class ParsedQuery:
348	    doc_number: str | None = None
349	    phrases: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
350	    keywords: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
351	    date_from: date | None = None
352	    date_to: date | None = None
353	    doc_type: str | None = None
354
355	    def has_constraints(self) -> bool:
356	        return bool(self.doc_number or self.phrases or self.keywords or self.date_from or self.date_to)
357
358
359	def normalize(text: str) -> str:
360	    return "".join(
361	        c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text.casefold().replace("đ", "d"))
362	        if not unicodedata.combining(c)
363	    )
364
365
366	def _last_day_of_month(year: int, month: int) -> date:
367	    if month == 12:
368	        return date(year, 12, 31)
369	    return date(year, month + 1, 1) - timedelta(days=1)
370
371
372	def _parse_iso(value: str) -> date:
373	    for fmt in ("%d/%m/%Y", "%d-%m-%Y", "%Y-%m-%d"):
374	        try:
375	            return date.fromisoformat(value) if "%Y" == fmt[:2] else datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date()
376	        except ValueError:
377	            continue
378	    raise ValueError(value)
379
380
381	def _extract_dates(text: str, today: date) -> tuple[str, date | None, date | None]:
382	    match = FROM_TO_RE.search(text)
383	    if match:
384	        start = _parse_iso(match.group(1).replace("-", "/") if "-" in match.group(1) and match.group(1).count("-") == 2 else match.group(1))
385	        end = _parse_iso(match.group(2).replace("-", "/") if "-" in match.group(2) and match.group(2).count("-") == 2 else match.group(2))
386	        return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], start, end)
387
388	    lowered = text.casefold()
389	    if "tuần trước" in lowered:
390	        return (text.replace("tuần trước", "", 1), today - timedelta(days=7), today)
391	    if "tháng trước" in lowered:
392	        first = today.replace(day=1)
393	        prev_end = first - timedelta(days=1)
394	        return (text.replace("tháng trước", "", 1), prev_end.replace(day=1), prev_end)
395	    if "năm ngoái" in lowered:
396	        return (text.replace("năm ngoái", "", 1), date(today.year - 1, 1, 1), date(today.year - 1, 12, 31))
397
398	    match = QUARTER_RE.search(text)
399	    if match:
400	        quarter = int(match.group(1))
401	        year = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else today.year
402	        start = date(year, quarter * 3 - 2, 1)
403	        return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], start, _last_day_of_month(year, quarter * 3))
404
405	    match = MONTH_RE.search(text)
406	    if match:
407	        month = int(match.group(1))
408	        year = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else today.year
409	        if 1 <= month <= 12:
410	            start = date(year, month, 1)
411	            return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], start, _last_day_of_month(year, month))
412
413	    match = YEAR_RE.search(text)
414	    if match:
415	        year = int(match.group(1))
416	        return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], date(year, 1, 1), date(year, 12, 31))
417
418	    return (text, None, None)
419
420
421	def parse(question: str, today: date | None = None) -> ParsedQuery:
422	    today = today or date.today()
423	    text = " ".join(question.split())[:500]
424	    parsed = ParsedQuery()
425
426	    match = QUOTED_RE.search(text)
427	    if match:
428	        parsed.phrases = [p.strip() for p in QUOTED_RE.findall(text) if p.strip()][:5]
429	        text = QUOTED_RE.sub(" ", text)
430
431	    match = DOC_NUMBER_RE.search(text)
432	    if match:
433	        parsed.doc_number = re.sub(r"\s+", "", match.group(1))
434	        text = DOC_NUMBER_RE.sub(" ", text, count=1)
435
436	    text, parsed.date_from, parsed.date_to = _extract_dates(text, today)
437
438	    lowered = " " + normalize(text) + " "
439	    for label, code in DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS:
440	        if f" {normalize(label)} " in lowered:
441	            parsed.doc_type = code
442	            text = re.sub(re.escape(label), " ", text, count=1, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
443	            break
444
445	    if parsed.doc_type in ("Incoming", "Outgoing", "InternalDirective"):
446	        pass  # giữ nguyên, đây là dispatch subtype
447	    elif parsed.doc_type == "dispatch" and any(
448	        normalize(k) in lowered for k in ("cong van den", "cong van di")
449	    ):
450	        # đã xử lý ở trên theo thứ tự ưu tiên; an toàn khi không trùng
451	        pass
452
453	    raw_tokens = text.split()
454	    keywords: list[str] = []
455	    for token in raw_tokens:
456	        norm = normalize(token)
457	        if len(norm) < 2 or norm in {normalize(w) for w in STOPWORDS} or norm in {normalize(t) for t in _TYPE_TOKENS}:
458	            continue
459	        keywords.append(norm)
460	    parsed.keywords = keywords[:10]
461
462	    if not parsed.has_constraints() and len(normalize(text).strip()) >= 2:
463	        # fallback: toàn bộ câu (đã normalize) làm từ khóa tự do
464	        parsed.keywords = [normalize(text).strip()[:200]]
465
466	    return parsed
467	```

591	```python
592	# src/apps/assistant/db_search.py
593	"""Tìm kiếm tài liệu trong DB IHRMS theo ParsedQuery, tôn trọng RBAC hiện có.
594
595	Mỗi nhánh dùng đúng quy tắc visibility của view tương ứng: dispatch dùng
596	visible_dispatches_for; document chỉ status Approved; personnel decision theo
597	manage_hr / approve_personnel_decision.
598	"""
599	from __future__ import annotations
600
601	from django.db.models import Q
602	from django.urls import reverse
603
604	from apps.document.models import Document, OfficialDispatch, PersonnelDecision
605	from apps.document.hcns.catalog import FORMS
606	from apps.security.data_access import visible_dispatches_for
607	from apps.security.permissions import has_permission
608
609	from .nlp import ParsedQuery
610
611	RECENT_LIMIT = 10
612	SCAN_LIMIT = 50
613	MAX_PER_TYPE = 15
614
615
616	def _score(parsed: ParsedQuery, *, title: str, number: str = "", extra: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> int:
617	    score = 0
618	    if parsed.doc_number and parsed.doc_number.casefold() in (number or "").replace(" ", "").casefold():
619	        score += 100
620	    title_fold = (title or "").casefold()
621	    for phrase in parsed.phrases:
622	        if phrase.casefold() in title_fold:
623	            score += 40
624	    for kw in parsed.keywords:
625	        if kw.casefold() in title_fold:
626	            score += 10
627	            continue
628	        for value in extra:
629	            if kw.casefold() in (value or "").casefold():
630	                score += 5
631	                break
632	    return score
633
634
635	def _has_constraints(parsed: ParsedQuery) -> bool:
636	    return parsed.has_constraints()
637
638
639	def _search_dispatches(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:
640	    if parsed.doc_type == "document" or parsed.doc_type == "personnel_decision":
641	        return []
642	    qs = visible_dispatches_for(user, OfficialDispatch.objects.select_related("dispatch_book"))
643	    if parsed.doc_type in ("Incoming", "Outgoing", "InternalDirective"):
644	        qs = qs.filter(dispatch_type=parsed.doc_type)
645	    if parsed.doc_number:
646	        qs = qs.filter(
647	            Q(dispatch_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number) | Q(original_doc_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)
648	        )
649	    elif _has_constraints(parsed):
650	        text_q = Q()
651	        for phrase in parsed.phrases:
652	            text_q |= Q(title__icontains=phrase) | Q(issuing_organization__icontains=phrase)
653	        for kw in parsed.keywords:
654	            text_q |= Q(title__icontains=kw) | Q(issuing_organization__icontains=kw) | Q(dispatch_no__icontains=kw)
655	        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()
656	    if parsed.date_from:
657	        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__gte=parsed.date_from)
658	    if parsed.date_to:
659	        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__lte=parsed.date_to)
660	    if not _has_constraints(parsed):
661	        qs = qs.order_by("-received_or_sent_date")[:RECENT_LIMIT]
662	    rows = []
663	    for d in qs.order_by("-received_or_sent_date")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:
664	        title = f"[{d.get_dispatch_type_display()}] {d.dispatch_no} - {d.title}"
665	        meta = f"{d.get_dispatch_type_display()} · {d.dispatch_no} · {d.issuing_organization}"
666	        score = _score(parsed, title=d.title, number=f"{d.dispatch_no} {d.original_doc_no or ''}",
667	                       extra=(d.issuing_organization, d.dispatch_no))
668	        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:
669	            continue
670	        rows.append({
671	            "source": "ihrms", "type": "official_dispatch", "title": title, "meta": meta,
672	            "url": reverse("portal:dispatch_detail", args=[d.pk]),
673	            "date": d.issue_date, "score": score,
674	        })
675	    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]
676
677
678	def _search_documents(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:
679	    if parsed.doc_type not in (None, "document") and parsed.doc_type not in ("Incoming", "Outgoing", "InternalDirective", "dispatch"):
680	        if parsed.doc_type != "document":
681	            return []
682	    if parsed.doc_type == "personnel_decision":
683	        return []
684	    qs = Document.objects.filter(status="Approved").select_related("category")
685	    if parsed.doc_number:
686	        qs = qs.filter(document_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)
687	    elif _has_constraints(parsed):
688	        text_q = Q()
689	        for phrase in parsed.phrases:
690	            text_q |= Q(document_name__icontains=phrase) | Q(category__category_name__icontains=phrase)
691	        for kw in parsed.keywords:
692	            text_q |= Q(document_name__icontains=kw) | Q(document_no__icontains=kw)
693	        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()
694	    if parsed.date_from:
695	        qs = qs.filter(effective_date__gte=parsed.date_from)
696	    if parsed.date_to:
697	        qs = qs.filter(effective_date__lte=parsed.date_to)
698	    if not _has_constraints(parsed):
699	        qs = qs.order_by("-effective_date")[:RECENT_LIMIT]
700	    rows = []
701	    for doc in qs.order_by("-effective_date")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:
702	        score = _score(parsed, title=doc.document_name, number=doc.document_no,
703	                       extra=(doc.category.category_name,))
704	        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:
705	            continue
706	        rows.append({
707	            "source": "ihrms", "type": "document",
708	            "title": f"{doc.document_no} - {doc.document_name}",
709	            "meta": f"Tài liệu · {doc.document_no} · {doc.category.category_name}",
710	            "url": reverse("portal:document_list"),
711	            "date": doc.effective_date, "score": score,
712	        })
713	    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]
714
715
716	def _search_decisions(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:
717	    if parsed.doc_type not in (None, "personnel_decision", "dispatch"):
718	        return []
719	    can_manage = has_permission(user, "manage_hr")
720	    if not (can_manage or has_permission(user, "approve_personnel_decision")):
721	        return []
722	    qs = PersonnelDecision.objects.select_related("employee")
723	    if not can_manage:
724	        qs = qs.filter(Q(status="PendingApproval") | Q(history__created_by=user)).distinct()
725	    if parsed.doc_number:
726	        qs = qs.filter(decision_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)
727	    elif _has_constraints(parsed):
728	        text_q = Q()
729	        for phrase in parsed.phrases:
730	            text_q |= Q(employee__full_name__icontains=phrase) | Q(decision_no__icontains=phrase)
731	        for kw in parsed.keywords:
732	            text_q |= Q(employee__full_name__icontains=kw) | Q(employee__employee_code__icontains=kw) | Q(decision_no__icontains=kw)
733	        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()
734	    if parsed.date_from:
735	        qs = qs.filter(decision_date__gte=parsed.date_from)
736	    if parsed.date_to:
737	        qs = qs.filter(decision_date__lte=parsed.date_to)
738	    if not _has_constraints(parsed):
739	        qs = qs.order_by("-created_date")[:RECENT_LIMIT]
740	    rows = []
741	    for dec in qs.order_by("-created_date")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:
742	        template_title = FORMS.get(dec.template_slug, {}).get("title", dec.template_slug)
743	        title = f"{dec.decision_no or dec.template_slug} - {template_title} - {dec.employee.full_name}"
744	        score = _score(parsed, title=title, number=dec.decision_no,
745	                       extra=(dec.employee.full_name, template_title))
746	        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:
747	            continue
748	        rows.append({
749	            "source": "ihrms", "type": "personnel_decision", "title": title,
750	            "meta": f"Quyết định · {dec.decision_no or '—'} · {template_title}",
751	            "url": reverse("portal:personnel_decision_detail", args=[dec.pk]),
752	            "date": dec.decision_date, "score": score,
753	        })
754	    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]
755
756
757	def search_database(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:
758	    return (
759	        _search_dispatches(parsed, user)
760	        + _search_documents(parsed, user)
761	        + _search_decisions(parsed, user)
762	    )
763	```

852	- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**
853
854	```python
855	    # thêm vào class GraphClient (sau get_metadata, trước get_web_url)
856	    def search_files(self, query: str, top: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
857	        """Tìm kiếm driveItem bằng Graph /search/query, giới hạn trong site IHRMS.
858
859	        Cần app permission cho phép search (Sites.Read.All / Sites.ReadWrite.All).
860	        GraphAPIError(403/400) nghĩa là chưa được consent — caller tự fallback.
861	        """
862	        self._require_configured()
863	        payload = {
864	            "requests": [{
865	                "entityTypes": ["driveItem"],
866	                "query": {"queryString": query[:200]},
867	                "from": 0,
868	                "size": top,
869	                "fields": ["name", "webUrl", "lastModifiedDateTime"],
870	            }]
871	        }
872	        data = self._request("POST", f"{GRAPH_BASE}/search/query", json=payload).json()
873	        prefix = f"https://{self.site_hostname}{self.site_path}"
874	        results = []
875	        for block in data.get("value", []):
876	            for container in block.get("hitsContainers", []):
877	                for hit in container.get("hits", []):
878	                    resource = hit.get("resource", {}) or {}
879	                    web_url = resource.get("webUrl") or ""
880	                    if web_url.startswith(prefix):
881	                        results.append({
882	                            "name": resource.get("name", ""),
883	                            "web_url": web_url,
884	                            "last_modified": resource.get("lastModifiedDateTime", ""),
885	                        })
886	                    if len(results) >= top:
887	                        return results
888	        return results
889
890	    def list_folder_files(self, library_name: str, folder: str = "") -> list[dict]:
891	        """Liệt kê tệp (không đệ quy) trong một thư mục của Document Library."""
892	        drive_id = self._drive_id(library_name)
893	        folder = (folder or "").strip("/")
894	        base = f"{GRAPH_BASE}/drives/{drive_id}/root"
895	        url = f"{base}:/{folder}:/children" if folder else f"{base}/children"
896	        data = self._request("GET", url, params={"$top": 200}).json()
897	        items = []
898	        for entry in data.get("value", []):
899	            if "folder" in entry:
900	                continue
901	            items.append({
902	                "name": entry.get("name", ""),
903	                "web_url": entry.get("webUrl", ""),
904	                "last_modified": entry.get("lastModifiedDateTime", ""),
905	            })
906	        return items
907	```

1012
1013	```python
1014	# src/apps/assistant/m365_search.py
1015	"""Tìm kiếm tệp trên SharePoint cho chatbot qua GraphClient.
1016
1017	Ưu tiên Graph /search/query; khi thiếu consent (403/400) fallback duyệt các
1018	thư mục nghiệp vụ đã cấu hình và lọc theo tên tệp.
1019	"""
1020	from __future__ import annotations
1021
1022	from django.conf import settings
1023
1024	from apps.m365.graph_client import GraphAPIError, get_graph_client
1025
1026	from .nlp import ParsedQuery, normalize
1027
1028	MAX_RESULTS = 20
1029	FALLBACK_LIMIT_PER_FOLDER = 50
1030
1031
1032	def _fallback_folders() -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
1033	    library = getattr(settings, "M365_SHAREPOINT_LIBRARY", "Documents") or "Documents"
1034	    folders = [
1035	        getattr(settings, "M365_FOLDER_DISPATCHES", "CongVan"),
1036	        getattr(settings, "M365_FOLDER_INCOMING", "CongVanDen"),
1037	        getattr(settings, "M365_FOLDER_OUTGOING", "CongVanDi"),
1038	    ]
1039	    seen, pairs = set(), []
1040	    for folder in folders:
1041	        folder = (folder or "").strip("/")
1042	        if folder and folder not in seen:
1043	            seen.add(folder)
1044	            pairs.append((library, folder))
1045	    pairs.append((library, ""))
1046	    return pairs
1047
1048
1049	def _to_result(hit: dict, parsed: ParsedQuery) -> dict:
1050	    name = hit.get("name", "")
1051	    name_fold = normalize(name)
1052	    score = 0
1053	    if parsed.doc_number and normalize(parsed.doc_number) in name_fold:
1054	        score += 100
1055	    for phrase in parsed.phrases:
1056	        if normalize(phrase) in name_fold:
1057	            score += 40
1058	    for kw in parsed.keywords:
1059	        if kw in name_fold:
1060	            score += 10
1061	    return {
1062	        "source": "sharepoint",
1063	        "type": "file",
1064	        "title": name,
1065	        "meta": "SharePoint",
1066	        "url": hit.get("web_url", ""),
1067	        "date": None,
1068	        "score": score,
1069	    }
1070
1071
1072	def _fallback_listing(client, parsed: ParsedQuery) -> list[dict]:
1073	    terms = [normalize(p) for p in parsed.phrases] + list(parsed.keywords)
1074	    if parsed.doc_number:
1075	        terms.append(normalize(parsed.doc_number))
1076	    terms = [t for t in terms if t]
1077	    if not terms:
1078	        return []
1079	    results: list[dict] = []
1080	    for library, folder in _fallback_folders():
1081	        try:
1082	            hits = client.list_folder_files(library, folder)
1083	        except GraphAPIError:
1084	            continue
1085	        for hit in hits:
1086	            name_fold = normalize(hit.get("name", ""))
1087	            if any(term in name_fold for term in terms):
1088	                results.append(_to_result(hit, parsed))
1089	        if len(results) >= MAX_RESULTS:
1090	            break
1091	    return results[:MAX_RESULTS]
1092
1093
1094	def search_sharepoint(parsed: ParsedQuery) -> tuple[list[dict], str | None]:
1095	    """Trả (results, error_note). error_note=None khi thành công hoặc không cấu hình.
1096
1097	    'search_fallback' = search API thiếu quyền, đã duyệt thư mục thay thế.
1098	    'unavailable'     = lỗi mạng/khác — caller trả kết quả DB kèm cờ partial.
1099	    """
1100	    client = get_graph_client()
1101	    if not client.is_configured():
1102	        return [], "not_configured"
1103	    terms = list(parsed.phrases) + list(parsed.keywords)
1104	    query = " ".join(terms)[:200] if terms else (parsed.doc_number or "")
1105	    if not query.strip():
1106	        return [], None
1107	    try:
1108	        hits = client.search_files(query, top=MAX_RESULTS)
1109	    except GraphAPIError as exc:
1110	        if exc.status_code in (403, 400):
1111	            return _fallback_listing(client, parsed), "search_fallback"
1112	        return [], "unavailable"
1113	    return [_to_result(hit, parsed) for hit in hits], None
1114	```

1206	- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**
1207
1208	```python
1209	# src/apps/assistant/services.py
1210	"""Ghép nguồn, xếp hạng và ghi nhật ký truy vấn chatbot."""
1211	from __future__ import annotations
1212
1213	import time
1214	from dataclasses import asdict
1215
1216	from . import db_search, m365_search, nlp
1217	from .models import SearchQueryLog
1218
1219	MAX_RESULTS = 20
1220	PARTIAL_NOTES = ("unavailable", "search_fallback")
1221
1222
1223	def _iso_date(value):
1224	    return value.isoformat() if hasattr(value, "isoformat") else None
1225
1226
1227	def _parsed_dict(parsed: nlp.ParsedQuery) -> dict:
1228	    data = asdict(parsed)
1229	    data["date_from"] = _iso_date(parsed.date_from)
1230	    data["date_to"] = _iso_date(parsed.date_to)
1231	    return data
1232
1233
1234	def ask(question: str, user) -> dict:
1235	    parsed = nlp.parse(question)
1236	    started = time.perf_counter()
1237	    db_results = db_search.search_database(parsed, user)
1238	    sp_results, sp_note = m365_search.search_sharepoint(parsed)
1239	    took_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
1240
1241	    merged = sorted(
1242	        db_results + sp_results,
1243	        key=lambda r: (
1244	            -r["score"],
1245	            -(r["date"].toordinal() if r.get("date") else 0),
1246	        ),
1247	    )[:MAX_RESULTS]
1248
1249	    if db_results and sp_results:
1250	        sources = "db+sharepoint"
1251	    elif db_results:
1252	        sources = "db"
1253	    elif sp_results:
1254	        sources = "sharepoint"
1255	    else:
1256	        sources = "none"
1257
1258	    SearchQueryLog.objects.create(
1259	        user=user,
1260	        question=question[:500],
1261	        parsed_filters=_parsed_dict(parsed),
1262	        result_count=len(merged),
1263	        sources=sources,
1264	        took_ms=took_ms,
1265	        error_note=sp_note if sp_note in ("unavailable", "search_fallback") else None,
1266	        created_by=user,
1267	    )
1268
1269	    results = [
1270	        {**{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != "score"}, "date": _iso_date(r.get("date"))}
1271	        for r in merged
1272	    ]
1273	    return {
1274	        "query": question,
1275	        "parsed": _parsed_dict(parsed),
1276	        "took_ms": took_ms,
1277	        "partial": sp_note in PARTIAL_NOTES,
1278	        "results": results,
1279	    }
1280	```

1384	```python
1385	# src/apps/assistant/views.py
1386	import json
1387
1388	from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
1389	from django.core.cache import caches
1390	from django.http import JsonResponse
1391	from django.shortcuts import render
1392	from django.views.decorators.cache import never_cache
1393	from django.views.decorators.http import require_POST
1394
1395	from . import services
1396
1397	RATE_LIMIT = 30
1398	RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS = 60
1399
1400
1401	def _throttle_ok(user) -> bool:
1402	    key = f"assistant:rl:{user.pk}"
1403	    try:
1404	        if caches["default"].add(key, 1, RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS):
1405	            return True
1406	        return caches["default"].incr(key) <= RATE_LIMIT
1407	    except ValueError:
1408	        return True
1409
1410
1411	@login_required
1412	def assistant_page(request):
1413	    return render(request, "assistant/chat.html")
1414
1415
1416	@login_required
1417	@require_POST
1418	@never_cache
1419	def api_search(request):
1420	    try:
1421	        data = json.loads(request.body.decode("utf-8") or "{}")
1422	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
1423	        return JsonResponse({"error": "invalid_json"}, status=400)
1424	    question = str(data.get("question", "")).strip()[:500]
1425	    if len(question) < 2:
1426	        return JsonResponse({"error": "question_too_short"}, status=400)
1427	    if not _throttle_ok(request.user):
1428	        return JsonResponse({"error": "rate_limited"}, status=429)
1429	    return JsonResponse(services.ask(question, request.user))
1430	```

#### Thinking

Now I do the pre-flight scan. Let me identify genuine issues:

**Task 1:**
- Files section is garbled (self-questioning text at lines 57-58): "Create: ... urls.py (placeholder views sẽ thay ở Task 7 — file chỉ định nghĩa route trỏ tới views chưa có sẽ ImportError; do đó Task 1 chỉ tạo urls.py ở bước cuối sau khi views tồn tại? Không — Task 1 chỉ tạo model + apps + admin, chưa gắn URL. URLs gắn ở Task 7.)" — This is confusing prose but the resolution is clear: Task 1 creates __init__.py, apps.py, models.py, admin.py, tests_models.py + migration. NOT urls.py. Line 58 mentions tests_ui.py then says "Không — tạo tests_models.py". So the file list should be: __init__.py, apps.py, models.py, admin.py, tests_models.py, migrations. The File Structure section (line 39) lists tests_api.py, tests_ui.py etc. — consistent enough. But File Structure line 39 doesn't list tests_models.py. Minor inconsistency → ruling: Task 1 creates tests_models.py (Step 1 code names it explicitly).
- Line 126: `"Thờ gian (ms)"` — typo for "Thời gian". Also line 300 "mốc thờ gian", line 1758 "ngườ được giao", 1758 "ngườ tạo/giao", 580 "không rơ constraints", line 16 "ngưởi dùng". These are Vietnamese typos in verbose_name / docstrings / comments. Since verbose_name is user-visible in admin, "Thờ gian" should be "Thời gian". Worth fixing. Also note STOPWORDS line 336 contains "củа" with Cyrillic а twice — that's a real bug! `"củа", "củа"` — the same entry twice, one with Cyrillic а. This is the exact bug I hit earlier in Phase A. Since normalize() in nlp.py only strips combining marks after replacing "đ" with "d" but doesn't handle Cyrillic, the stopword "củа" (Cyrillic) would never match user input → harmless functionally but a defect (duplicate entry + wrong script). Ruling: fix to "của", dedupe.

Wait, careful: STOPWORDS is a set; the duplicate is harmless. But the Cyrillic char means "của" is NOT in the stopwords set as normalized... Actually the check at line 457 is `norm in {normalize(w) for w in STOPWORDS}` — normalize("củа") → NFD of "củа" casefold → "cu" + combining removed... "ủ" → u+combining hook above → stripped → "u"; "а" Cyrillic → NFD doesn't decompose Cyrillic а, it stays as U+0430. So normalize("củа") = "cuа" (with Cyrillic а) ≠ normalize("của") = "cua". So the real Vietnamese word "của" would NOT be filtered as a stopword → "cua" would remain in keywords. That's a functional bug: queries containing "của" produce a spurious keyword "cua" that gets OR'd into icontains filters — mostly harmless but adds noise. Fix: use proper ASCII "của" once.

**Task 2:**
- `_parse_iso` (line 372-378) uses `datetime.strptime` but `datetime` is NOT imported (only `date, timedelta` from datetime at line 307). This is a real NameError bug that would surface in `test_from_to_range`. Ruling: import `datetime` too (`from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta`).
- Also `_parse_iso` logic is convoluted: `date.fromisoformat(value) if "%Y" == fmt[:2] else datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date()`. For fmt="%d/%m/%Y" it does strptime. For the third fmt "%Y-%m-%d", fromisoformat works. But loop order: "%d/%m/%Y" first. For "2026-06-01", strptime with %d/%m/%Y fails → ValueError → continue → "%d-%m-%Y" fails → "%Y-%m-%d" → fromisoformat OK. Fine. 2
3	Use this template when dispatching a task reviewer subagent. The reviewer
4	reads the task's diff once and returns two verdicts: spec compliance and
5	code quality.
6
7	**Purpose:** Verify one task's implementation matches its requirements (nothing
8	more, nothing less) and is well-built (clean, tested, maintainable)
9
10	```
11	Subagent (general-purpose):
12	  description: "Review Task N (spec + quality)"
13	  model: [MODEL — REQUIRED: choose per SKILL.md Model Selection; an omitted
14	         model silently inherits the session's most expensive one]
15	  prompt: |
16	    You are reviewing one task's implementation: first whether it matches its
17	    requirements, then whether it is well-built. This is a task-scoped gate,
18	    not a merge review — a broad whole-branch review happens separately after
19	    all tasks are complete.
20
21	    ## What Was Requested
22
23	    Read the task brief: [BRIEF_FILE]
24
25	    Global constraints from the spec/design that bind this task:
26	    [GLOBAL_CONSTRAINTS]
27
28	    ## What the Implementer Claims They Built
29
30	    Read the implementer's report: [REPORT_FILE]
31
32	    ## Diff Under Review
33
34	    **Base:** [BASE_SHA]
35	    **Head:** [HEAD_SHA]
36	    **Diff file:** [DIFF_FILE]
37
38	    Read the diff file once — it contains the commit list, a stat summary,
39	    and the full diff with surrounding context, and it is your view of the
40	    change. The diff's context lines ARE the changed files: do not Read a
41	    changed file separately unless a hunk you must judge is cut off
42	    mid-function — and say so in your report. Do not re-run git commands.
43	    If the diff file is missing, fetch the diff yourself:
44	    `git diff --stat [BASE_SHA]..[HEAD_SHA]` and `git diff [BASE_SHA]..[HEAD_SHA]`.
45	    Do not crawl the broader codebase. Inspect code outside the diff only
46	    to evaluate a concrete risk you can name — one focused check per named
47	    risk, and name both the risk and what you checked in your report.
48	    Cross-cutting changes are legitimate named risks: if the diff changes
49	    lock ordering, a function or API contract, or shared mutable state,
50	    checking the call sites is the right method.
51
52	    Your review is read-only on this checkout. Do not mutate the working
53	    tree, the index, HEAD, or branch state in any way.
54
55	    ## You Do Not Dispatch Subagents
56
57	    Do all of this review yourself. Never spawn a subagent to review part
58	    of the diff, and never spawn another reviewer for a second opinion.
59	    This process already provides every review seat the work gets; a
60	    reviewer you spawn duplicates one of them at full cost, and its
61	    verdict counts for nothing. If the diff feels too large for one
62	    pass, review it in passes yourself and say so in your report.
63
64	    ## Do Not Trust the Report
65
66	    Treat the implementer's report as unverified claims about the code. It
67	    may be incomplete, inaccurate, or optimistic. Verify the claims against
68	    the diff. Design rationales in the report are claims too: "left it per
69	    YAGNI," "kept it simple deliberately," or any other justification is the
70	    implementer grading their own work. Judge the code on its merits — a
71	    stated rationale never downgrades a finding's severity.
72
73	    ## Tests
74
75	    The implementer already ran the tests and reported results with TDD
76	    evidence for exactly this code. Do not re-run the suite to confirm their
77	    report. Run a test only when reading the code raises a specific doubt
78	    that no existing run answers — and then a focused test, never a
79	    package-wide suite, race detector run, or repeated/high-count loop. If
80	    heavy validation seems warranted, recommend it in your report instead of
81	    running it. If you cannot run commands in this environment, name the
82	    test you would run.
83
84	    Warnings or other noise in the implementer's reported test output are
85	    findings — test output should be pristine.
86
87	    Evidence you cannot see is not evidence that doesn't exist. If the
88	    report or its test evidence looks truncated, or you cannot locate the
89	    results it claims, re-read the file at its stated path — and if it is
90	    genuinely missing or garbled, report that as a gap for the controller.
91	    Re-running the suite to regenerate what you failed to read is not
92	    verification; illegibility of the evidence is not invalidation of it.
93
94	    ## Part 1: Spec Compliance
95
96	    Compare the diff against What Was Requested:
97
98	    - **Missing:** requirements they skipped, missed, or claimed without
99	      implementing
100	    - **Extra:** features that weren't requested, over-engineering, unneeded
101	      "nice to haves"
102	    - **Misunderstood:** right feature built the wrong way, wrong problem
103	      solved
104
105	    If the brief lists several files each with its own change (a batched
106	    dispatch), check the diff against that list file by file: every listed
107	    file must have its corresponding hunk. A listed file the diff never
108	    touches is a Missing finding, no matter how clean the rest of the
109	    batch looks.
110
111	    If a requirement cannot be verified from this diff alone (it lives in
112	    unchanged code or spans tasks), report it as a ⚠️ item instead of
113	    broadening your search.
114
115	    ## Part 2: Code Quality
116
117	    **Code quality:**
118	    - Clean separation of concerns?
119	    - Proper error handling?
120	    - DRY without premature abstraction?
121	    - Edge cases handled?
122
123	    **Tests:**
124	    - Do the new and changed tests verify real behavior, not mocks?
125	    - Are the task's edge cases covered?
126
127	    **Structure:**
128	    - Does each file have one clear responsibility with a well-defined interface?
129	    - Are units decomposed so they can be understood and tested independently?
130	    - Is the implementation following the file structure from the plan?
131	    - Did this change create new files that are already large, or
132	      significantly grow existing files? (Don't flag pre-existing file
133	      sizes — focus on what this change contributed.)
134
135	    Your report should point at evidence: file:line references for every
136	    finding and for any check you would otherwise answer with a bare
137	    "yes." A tight report that cites lines gives the controller everything
138	    it needs.
139
140	    Your final message is the report itself: begin directly with the
141	    spec-compliance verdict. Every line is a verdict, a finding with
142	    file:line, or a check you ran — no preamble, no process narration,
143	    no closing summary.
144
145	    ## Calibration
146
147	    Categorize issues by actual severity. Not everything is Critical.
148	    Important means this task cannot be trusted until it is fixed: incorrect
149	    or fragile behavior, a missed requirement, or maintainability damage you
150	    would block a merge over — verbatim duplication of a logic block,
151	    swallowed errors, tests that assert nothing. "Coverage could be broader"
152	    and polish suggestions are Minor.
153	    If the plan or brief explicitly mandates something this rubric calls a
154	    defect (a test that asserts nothing, verbatim duplication of a logic
155	    block), that IS a finding — report it as Important, labeled
156	    plan-mandated. The plan's authorship does not grade its own work; the
157	    human decides.
158	    Acknowledge what was done well before listing issues — accurate praise
159	    helps the implementer trust the rest of the feedback.
160
161	    ## Output Format
162
163	    ### Spec Compliance
164
165	    - ✅ Spec compliant | ❌ Issues found: [what's missing/extra/misunderstood,
166	      with file:line references]
167	    - ⚠️ Cannot verify from diff: [requirements you could not verify from the
168	      diff alone, and what the controller should check — report alongside the
169	      ✅/❌ verdict for everything you could verify]
170
171	    ### Strengths
172	    [What's well done? Be specific.]
173
174	    ### Issues
175
176	    #### Critical (Must Fix)
177	    #### Important (Should Fix)
178	    #### Minor (Nice to Have)
179
180	    For each issue: file:line, what's wrong, why it matters, how to fix
181	    (if not obvious).
182
183	    ### Assessment
184
185	    **Task quality:** [Approved | Needs fixes]
186
187	    **Reasoning:** [1-2 sentence technical assessment]
188	```

193	  prints the path; same file the implementer worked from)

204	  path it wrote; the package never enters the controller's context)
205
206	**Reviewer returns:** Spec Compliance verdict (✅/❌/⚠️), Strengths, Issues
207	(Critical/Important/Minor), Task quality verdict

54
55	    ## Scope
56
57	    Your scope is the findings list and the fix diff. Verdict every finding.
58	    Inspect the fix diff for new problems the fix itself introduced. Do NOT
59	    re-review code the fix did not touch: if you notice an issue entirely
