293	- [ ] **Step 3: Viết implementation**
294
295	```python
296	# src/apps/assistant/nlp.py
297	"""Parser câu hỏi tiếng Việt cho trợ lý tài liệu.
298
299	Thuần quy tắc, deterministic, không LLM. Pipeline: số hiệu → cụm ngoặc kép →
300	mốc thờ gian → loại văn bản → từ khóa còn lại (đã bỏ stopword).
301	"""
302	from __future__ import annotations
303
304	import re
305	import unicodedata
306	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
307	from datetime import date, timedelta
308
309	DOC_NUMBER_RE = re.compile(
310	    r"(?:số\s*)?(\d{1,5}\s*/\s*[A-Za-zÀ-ỹ0-9]+(?:\s*-\s*[A-Za-zÀ-ỹ0-9]+)*)",
311	    re.IGNORECASE,
312	)
313	QUOTED_RE = re.compile(r'"([^"]+)"')
314	MONTH_RE = re.compile(r"tháng\s+(\d{1,2})(?:\s*(?:năm|\/)\s*(\d{4}))?", re.IGNORECASE)
315	QUARTER_RE = re.compile(r"quý\s+([1-4])(?:\s*năm\s*(\d{4}))?", re.IGNORECASE)
316	YEAR_RE = re.compile(r"\bnăm\s+(\d{4})\b", re.IGNORECASE)
317	FROM_TO_RE = re.compile(
318	    r"từ\s+(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})\s*(?:đến|tới)\s+(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})",
319	    re.IGNORECASE,
320	)
321
322	DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS = [
323	    ("công văn đến", "Incoming"),
324	    ("công văn đi", "Outgoing"),
325	    ("văn bản chỉ đạo nội bộ", "InternalDirective"),
326	    ("chỉ đạo nội bộ", "InternalDirective"),
327	    ("văn bản nội bộ", "InternalDirective"),
328	    ("quyết định", "personnel_decision"),
329	    ("công văn", "dispatch"),
330	    ("văn bản", "dispatch"),
331	    ("tài liệu", "document"),
332	]
333
334	STOPWORDS = {
335	    "tìm", "kiếm", "tìm kiếm", "cho", "tôi", "mình", "em", "anh", "chị", "bạn",
336	    "xin", "hãy", "về", "củа", "củа", "va", "và", "các", "những", "một", "là",
337	    "ở", "theo", "giúp", "với", "được", "bị", "trong", "ngoài", "từ", "đến",
338	    "ngày", "nào", "này", "đó", "mới", "gần", "nhất", "gần đây", "liên quan",
339	}
340
341	_TYPE_TOKENS = set()
342	for _label, _code in DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS:
343	    _TYPE_TOKENS.update(_label.split())
344
345
346	@dataclass
347	class ParsedQuery:
348	    doc_number: str | None = None
349	    phrases: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
350	    keywords: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
351	    date_from: date | None = None
352	    date_to: date | None = None
353	    doc_type: str | None = None
354
355	    def has_constraints(self) -> bool:
356	        return bool(self.doc_number or self.phrases or self.keywords or self.date_from or self.date_to)
357
358
359	def normalize(text: str) -> str:
360	    return "".join(
361	        c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text.casefold().replace("đ", "d"))
362	        if not unicodedata.combining(c)
363	    )
364
365
366	def _last_day_of_month(year: int, month: int) -> date:
367	    if month == 12:
368	        return date(year, 12, 31)
369	    return date(year, month + 1, 1) - timedelta(days=1)
370
371
372	def _parse_iso(value: str) -> date:
373	    for fmt in ("%d/%m/%Y", "%d-%m-%Y", "%Y-%m-%d"):
374	        try:
375	            return date.fromisoformat(value) if "%Y" == fmt[:2] else datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date()
376	        except ValueError:
377	            continue
378	    raise ValueError(value)
379
380
381	def _extract_dates(text: str, today: date) -> tuple[str, date | None, date | None]:
382	    match = FROM_TO_RE.search(text)
383	    if match:
384	        start = _parse_iso(match.group(1).replace("-", "/") if "-" in match.group(1) and match.group(1).count("-") == 2 else match.group(1))
385	        end = _parse_iso(match.group(2).replace("-", "/") if "-" in match.group(2) and match.group(2).count("-") == 2 else match.group(2))
386	        return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], start, end)
387
388	    lowered = text.casefold()
389	    if "tuần trước" in lowered:
390	        return (text.replace("tuần trước", "", 1), today - timedelta(days=7), today)
391	    if "tháng trước" in lowered:
392	        first = today.replace(day=1)
393	        prev_end = first - timedelta(days=1)
394	        return (text.replace("tháng trước", "", 1), prev_end.replace(day=1), prev_end)
395	    if "năm ngoái" in lowered:
396	        return (text.replace("năm ngoái", "", 1), date(today.year - 1, 1, 1), date(today.year - 1, 12, 31))
397
398	    match = QUARTER_RE.search(text)
399	    if match:
400	        quarter = int(match.group(1))
401	        year = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else today.year
402	        start = date(year, quarter * 3 - 2, 1)
403	        return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], start, _last_day_of_month(year, quarter * 3))
404
405	    match = MONTH_RE.search(text)
406	    if match:
407	        month = int(match.group(1))
408	        year = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else today.year
409	        if 1 <= month <= 12:
410	            start = date(year, month, 1)
411	            return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], start, _last_day_of_month(year, month))
412
413	    match = YEAR_RE.search(text)
414	    if match:
415	        year = int(match.group(1))
416	        return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], date(year, 1, 1), date(year, 12, 31))
417
418	    return (text, None, None)
419
420
421	def parse(question: str, today: date | None = None) -> ParsedQuery:
422	    today = today or date.today()
423	    text = " ".join(question.split())[:500]
424	    parsed = ParsedQuery()
425
426	    match = QUOTED_RE.search(text)
427	    if match:
428	        parsed.phrases = [p.strip() for p in QUOTED_RE.findall(text) if p.strip()][:5]
429	        text = QUOTED_RE.sub(" ", text)
430
431	    match = DOC_NUMBER_RE.search(text)
432	    if match:
433	        parsed.doc_number = re.sub(r"\s+", "", match.group(1))
434	        text = DOC_NUMBER_RE.sub(" ", text, count=1)
435
436	    text, parsed.date_from, parsed.date_to = _extract_dates(text, today)
437
438	    lowered = " " + normalize(text) + " "
439	    for label, code in DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS:
440	        if f" {normalize(label)} " in lowered:
441	            parsed.doc_type = code
442	            text = re.sub(re.escape(label), " ", text, count=1, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
443	            break
444
445	    if parsed.doc_type in ("Incoming", "Outgoing", "InternalDirective"):
446	        pass  # giữ nguyên, đây là dispatch subtype
447	    elif parsed.doc_type == "dispatch" and any(
448	        normalize(k) in lowered for k in ("cong van den", "cong van di")
449	    ):
450	        # đã xử lý ở trên theo thứ tự ưu tiên; an toàn khi không trùng
451	        pass
452
453	    raw_tokens = text.split()
454	    keywords: list[str] = []
455	    for token in raw_tokens:
456	        norm = normalize(token)
457	        if len(norm) < 2 or norm in {normalize(w) for w in STOPWORDS} or norm in {normalize(t) for t in _TYPE_TOKENS}:
458	            continue
459	        keywords.append(norm)
460	    parsed.keywords = keywords[:10]
461
462	    if not parsed.has_constraints() and len(normalize(text).strip()) >= 2:
463	        # fallback: toàn bộ câu (đã normalize) làm từ khóa tự do
464	        parsed.keywords = [normalize(text).strip()[:200]]
465
466	    return parsed
467	```

487
488	**Files:**

490	- Test: `src/apps/assistant/tests_db_search.py`
491
492	**Interfaces:**
493	- Consumes: `ParsedQuery`, `has_permission` (`apps.security.permissions`), `visible_dispatches_for` (`apps.security.data_access`), models `OfficialDispatch/Document/PersonnelDecision` (`apps.document.models`), `FORMS` (`apps.document.hcns.catalog`).
494	- Produces: `search_database(parsed, user) -> list[dict]`; mỗi dict: `source="ihrms"`, `type` ∈ `{"official_dispatch","document","personnel_decision"}`, `title: str`, `meta: str`, `url: str`, `date: date | None`, `score: int`.
495	- Quy tắc phân quyền (khớp view hiện hữu):
496	  - Dispatch: `visible_dispatches_for(user, qs)` — dùng y nguyên hàm này.
497	  - Document: `Document.objects.filter(status="Approved")` (như `document_list`).
498	  - PersonnelDecision: cần `manage_hr` hoặc `approve_personnel_decision`; nếu không `manage_hr` thì chỉ `PendingApproval` hoặc `history__created_by=user` (như `personnel_decision_list`).
499	- URL: dispatch → `reverse("portal:dispatch_detail", args=[pk])`; document → `reverse("portal:document_list")`; decision → `reverse("portal:personnel_decision_detail", args=[pk])`.

591	```python
592	# src/apps/assistant/db_search.py
593	"""Tìm kiếm tài liệu trong DB IHRMS theo ParsedQuery, tôn trọng RBAC hiện có.
594
595	Mỗi nhánh dùng đúng quy tắc visibility của view tương ứng: dispatch dùng
596	visible_dispatches_for; document chỉ status Approved; personnel decision theo
597	manage_hr / approve_personnel_decision.
598	"""
599	from __future__ import annotations
600
601	from django.db.models import Q
602	from django.urls import reverse
603
604	from apps.document.models import Document, OfficialDispatch, PersonnelDecision
605	from apps.document.hcns.catalog import FORMS
606	from apps.security.data_access import visible_dispatches_for
607	from apps.security.permissions import has_permission
608
609	from .nlp import ParsedQuery
610
611	RECENT_LIMIT = 10
612	SCAN_LIMIT = 50
613	MAX_PER_TYPE = 15
614
615
616	def _score(parsed: ParsedQuery, *, title: str, number: str = "", extra: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> int:
617	    score = 0
618	    if parsed.doc_number and parsed.doc_number.casefold() in (number or "").replace(" ", "").casefold():
619	        score += 100
620	    title_fold = (title or "").casefold()
621	    for phrase in parsed.phrases:
622	        if phrase.casefold() in title_fold:
623	            score += 40
624	    for kw in parsed.keywords:
625	        if kw.casefold() in title_fold:
626	            score += 10
627	            continue
628	        for value in extra:
629	            if kw.casefold() in (value or "").casefold():
630	                score += 5
631	                break
632	    return score
633
634
635	def _has_constraints(parsed: ParsedQuery) -> bool:
636	    return parsed.has_constraints()
637
638
639	def _search_dispatches(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:
640	    if parsed.doc_type == "document" or parsed.doc_type == "personnel_decision":
641	        return []
642	    qs = visible_dispatches_for(user, OfficialDispatch.objects.select_related("dispatch_book"))
643	    if parsed.doc_type in ("Incoming", "Outgoing", "InternalDirective"):
644	        qs = qs.filter(dispatch_type=parsed.doc_type)
645	    if parsed.doc_number:
646	        qs = qs.filter(
647	            Q(dispatch_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number) | Q(original_doc_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)
648	        )
649	    elif _has_constraints(parsed):
650	        text_q = Q()
651	        for phrase in parsed.phrases:
652	            text_q |= Q(title__icontains=phrase) | Q(issuing_organization__icontains=phrase)
653	        for kw in parsed.keywords:
654	            text_q |= Q(title__icontains=kw) | Q(issuing_organization__icontains=kw) | Q(dispatch_no__icontains=kw)
655	        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()
656	    if parsed.date_from:
657	        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__gte=parsed.date_from)
658	    if parsed.date_to:
659	        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__lte=parsed.date_to)
660	    if not _has_constraints(parsed):
661	        qs = qs.order_by("-received_or_sent_date")[:RECENT_LIMIT]
662	    rows = []
663	    for d in qs.order_by("-received_or_sent_date")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:
664	        title = f"[{d.get_dispatch_type_display()}] {d.dispatch_no} - {d.title}"
665	        meta = f"{d.get_dispatch_type_display()} · {d.dispatch_no} · {d.issuing_organization}"
666	        score = _score(parsed, title=d.title, number=f"{d.dispatch_no} {d.original_doc_no or ''}",
667	                       extra=(d.issuing_organization, d.dispatch_no))
668	        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:
669	            continue
670	        rows.append({
671	            "source": "ihrms", "type": "official_dispatch", "title": title, "meta": meta,
672	            "url": reverse("portal:dispatch_detail", args=[d.pk]),
673	            "date": d.issue_date, "score": score,
674	        })
675	    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]
676
677
678	def _search_documents(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:
679	    if parsed.doc_type not in (None, "document") and parsed.doc_type not in ("Incoming", "Outgoing", "InternalDirective", "dispatch"):
680	        if parsed.doc_type != "document":
681	            return []
682	    if parsed.doc_type == "personnel_decision":
683	        return []
684	    qs = Document.objects.filter(status="Approved").select_related("category")
685	    if parsed.doc_number:
686	        qs = qs.filter(document_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)
687	    elif _has_constraints(parsed):
688	        text_q = Q()
689	        for phrase in parsed.phrases:
690	            text_q |= Q(document_name__icontains=phrase) | Q(category__category_name__icontains=phrase)
691	        for kw in parsed.keywords:
692	            text_q |= Q(document_name__icontains=kw) | Q(document_no__icontains=kw)
693	        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()
694	    if parsed.date_from:
695	        qs = qs.filter(effective_date__gte=parsed.date_from)
696	    if parsed.date_to:
697	        qs = qs.filter(effective_date__lte=parsed.date_to)
698	    if not _has_constraints(parsed):
699	        qs = qs.order_by("-effective_date")[:RECENT_LIMIT]
700	    rows = []
701	    for doc in qs.order_by("-effective_date")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:
702	        score = _score(parsed, title=doc.document_name, number=doc.document_no,
703	                       extra=(doc.category.category_name,))
704	        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:
705	            continue
706	        rows.append({
707	            "source": "ihrms", "type": "document",
708	            "title": f"{doc.document_no} - {doc.document_name}",
709	            "meta": f"Tài liệu · {doc.document_no} · {doc.category.category_name}",
710	            "url": reverse("portal:document_list"),
711	            "date": doc.effective_date, "score": score,
712	        })
713	    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]
714
715
716	def _search_decisions(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:
717	    if parsed.doc_type not in (None, "personnel_decision", "dispatch"):
718	        return []
719	    can_manage = has_permission(user, "manage_hr")
720	    if not (can_manage or has_permission(user, "approve_personnel_decision")):
721	        return []
722	    qs = PersonnelDecision.objects.select_related("employee")
723	    if not can_manage:
724	        qs = qs.filter(Q(status="PendingApproval") | Q(history__created_by=user)).distinct()
725	    if parsed.doc_number:
726	        qs = qs.filter(decision_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)
727	    elif _has_constraints(parsed):
728	        text_q = Q()
729	        for phrase in parsed.phrases:
730	            text_q |= Q(employee__full_name__icontains=phrase) | Q(decision_no__icontains=phrase)
731	        for kw in parsed.keywords:
732	            text_q |= Q(employee__full_name__icontains=kw) | Q(employee__employee_code__icontains=kw) | Q(decision_no__icontains=kw)
733	        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()
734	    if parsed.date_from:
735	        qs = qs.filter(decision_date__gte=parsed.date_from)
736	    if parsed.date_to:
737	        qs = qs.filter(decision_date__lte=parsed.date_to)
738	    if not _has_constraints(parsed):
739	        qs = qs.order_by("-created_date")[:RECENT_LIMIT]
740	    rows = []
741	    for dec in qs.order_by("-created_date")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:
742	        template_title = FORMS.get(dec.template_slug, {}).get("title", dec.template_slug)
743	        title = f"{dec.decision_no or dec.template_slug} - {template_title} - {dec.employee.full_name}"
744	        score = _score(parsed, title=title, number=dec.decision_no,
745	                       extra=(dec.employee.full_name, template_title))
746	        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:
747	            continue
748	        rows.append({
749	            "source": "ihrms", "type": "personnel_decision", "title": title,
750	            "meta": f"Quyết định · {dec.decision_no or '—'} · {template_title}",
751	            "url": reverse("portal:personnel_decision_detail", args=[dec.pk]),
752	            "date": dec.decision_date, "score": score,
753	        })
754	    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]
755
756
757	def search_database(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:
758	    return (
759	        _search_dispatches(parsed, user)
760	        + _search_documents(parsed, user)
761	        + _search_decisions(parsed, user)
762	    )
763	```

852	- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**
853
854	```python
855	    # thêm vào class GraphClient (sau get_metadata, trước get_web_url)
856	    def search_files(self, query: str, top: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
857	        """Tìm kiếm driveItem bằng Graph /search/query, giới hạn trong site IHRMS.
858
859	        Cần app permission cho phép search (Sites.Read.All / Sites.ReadWrite.All).
860	        GraphAPIError(403/400) nghĩa là chưa được consent — caller tự fallback.
861	        """
862	        self._require_configured()
863	        payload = {
864	            "requests": [{
865	                "entityTypes": ["driveItem"],
866	                "query": {"queryString": query[:200]},
867	                "from": 0,
868	                "size": top,
869	                "fields": ["name", "webUrl", "lastModifiedDateTime"],
870	            }]
871	        }
872	        data = self._request("POST", f"{GRAPH_BASE}/search/query", json=payload).json()
873	        prefix = f"https://{self.site_hostname}{self.site_path}"
874	        results = []
875	        for block in data.get("value", []):
876	            for container in block.get("hitsContainers", []):
877	                for hit in container.get("hits", []):
878	                    resource = hit.get("resource", {}) or {}
879	                    web_url = resource.get("webUrl") or ""
880	                    if web_url.startswith(prefix):
881	                        results.append({
882	                            "name": resource.get("name", ""),
883	                            "web_url": web_url,
884	                            "last_modified": resource.get("lastModifiedDateTime", ""),
885	                        })
886	                    if len(results) >= top:
887	                        return results
888	        return results
889
890	    def list_folder_files(self, library_name: str, folder: str = "") -> list[dict]:
891	        """Liệt kê tệp (không đệ quy) trong một thư mục của Document Library."""
892	        drive_id = self._drive_id(library_name)
893	        folder = (folder or "").strip("/")
894	        base = f"{GRAPH_BASE}/drives/{drive_id}/root"
895	        url = f"{base}:/{folder}:/children" if folder else f"{base}/children"
896	        data = self._request("GET", url, params={"$top": 200}).json()
897	        items = []
898	        for entry in data.get("value", []):
899	            if "folder" in entry:
900	                continue
901	            items.append({
902	                "name": entry.get("name", ""),
903	                "web_url": entry.get("webUrl", ""),
904	                "last_modified": entry.get("lastModifiedDateTime", ""),
905	            })
906	        return items
907	```

1011	- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**
1012
1013	```python
1014	# src/apps/assistant/m365_search.py
1015	"""Tìm kiếm tệp trên SharePoint cho chatbot qua GraphClient.
1016
1017	Ưu tiên Graph /search/query; khi thiếu consent (403/400) fallback duyệt các
1018	thư mục nghiệp vụ đã cấu hình và lọc theo tên tệp.
1019	"""
1020	from __future__ import annotations
1021
1022	from django.conf import settings
1023
1024	from apps.m365.graph_client import GraphAPIError, get_graph_client
1025
1026	from .nlp import ParsedQuery, normalize
1027
1028	MAX_RESULTS = 20
1029	FALLBACK_LIMIT_PER_FOLDER = 50
1030
1031
1032	def _fallback_folders() -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
1033	    library = getattr(settings, "M365_SHAREPOINT_LIBRARY", "Documents") or "Documents"
1034	    folders = [
1035	        getattr(settings, "M365_FOLDER_DISPATCHES", "CongVan"),
1036	        getattr(settings, "M365_FOLDER_INCOMING", "CongVanDen"),
1037	        getattr(settings, "M365_FOLDER_OUTGOING", "CongVanDi"),
1038	    ]
1039	    seen, pairs = set(), []
1040	    for folder in folders:
1041	        folder = (folder or "").strip("/")
1042	        if folder and folder not in seen:
1043	            seen.add(folder)
1044	            pairs.append((library, folder))
1045	    pairs.append((library, ""))
1046	    return pairs
1047
1048
1049	def _to_result(hit: dict, parsed: ParsedQuery) -> dict:
1050	    name = hit.get("name", "")
1051	    name_fold = normalize(name)
1052	    score = 0
1053	    if parsed.doc_number and normalize(parsed.doc_number) in name_fold:
1054	        score += 100
1055	    for phrase in parsed.phrases:
1056	        if normalize(phrase) in name_fold:
1057	            score += 40
1058	    for kw in parsed.keywords:
1059	        if kw in name_fold:
1060	            score += 10
1061	    return {
1062	        "source": "sharepoint",
1063	        "type": "file",
1064	        "title": name,
1065	        "meta": "SharePoint",
1066	        "url": hit.get("web_url", ""),
1067	        "date": None,
1068	        "score": score,
1069	    }
1070
1071
1072	def _fallback_listing(client, parsed: ParsedQuery) -> list[dict]:
1073	    terms = [normalize(p) for p in parsed.phrases] + list(parsed.keywords)
1074	    if parsed.doc_number:
1075	        terms.append(normalize(parsed.doc_number))
1076	    terms = [t for t in terms if t]
1077	    if not terms:
1078	        return []
1079	    results: list[dict] = []
1080	    for library, folder in _fallback_folders():
1081	        try:
1082	            hits = client.list_folder_files(library, folder)
1083	        except GraphAPIError:
1084	            continue
1085	        for hit in hits:
1086	            name_fold = normalize(hit.get("name", ""))
1087	            if any(term in name_fold for term in terms):
1088	                results.append(_to_result(hit, parsed))
1089	        if len(results) >= MAX_RESULTS:
1090	            break
1091	    return results[:MAX_RESULTS]
1092
1093
1094	def search_sharepoint(parsed: ParsedQuery) -> tuple[list[dict], str | None]:
1095	    """Trả (results, error_note). error_note=None khi thành công hoặc không cấu hình.
1096
1097	    'search_fallback' = search API thiếu quyền, đã duyệt thư mục thay thế.
1098	    'unavailable'     = lỗi mạng/khác — caller trả kết quả DB kèm cờ partial.
1099	    """
1100	    client = get_graph_client()
1101	    if not client.is_configured():
1102	        return [], "not_configured"
1103	    terms = list(parsed.phrases) + list(parsed.keywords)
1104	    query = " ".join(terms)[:200] if terms else (parsed.doc_number or "")
1105	    if not query.strip():
1106	        return [], None
1107	    try:
1108	        hits = client.search_files(query, top=MAX_RESULTS)
1109	    except GraphAPIError as exc:
1110	        if exc.status_code in (403, 400):
1111	            return _fallback_listing(client, parsed), "search_fallback"
1112	        return [], "unavailable"
1113	    return [_to_result(hit, parsed) for hit in hits], None
1114	```

1206	- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**
1207
1208	```python
1209	# src/apps/assistant/services.py
1210	"""Ghép nguồn, xếp hạng và ghi nhật ký truy vấn chatbot."""
1211	from __future__ import annotations
1212
1213	import time
1214	from dataclasses import asdict
1215
1216	from . import db_search, m365_search, nlp
1217	from .models import SearchQueryLog
1218
1219	MAX_RESULTS = 20
1220	PARTIAL_NOTES = ("unavailable", "search_fallback")
1221
1222
1223	def _iso_date(value):
1224	    return value.isoformat() if hasattr(value, "isoformat") else None
1225
1226
1227	def _parsed_dict(parsed: nlp.ParsedQuery) -> dict:
1228	    data = asdict(parsed)
1229	    data["date_from"] = _iso_date(parsed.date_from)
1230	    data["date_to"] = _iso_date(parsed.date_to)
1231	    return data
1232
1233
1234	def ask(question: str, user) -> dict:
1235	    parsed = nlp.parse(question)
1236	    started = time.perf_counter()
1237	    db_results = db_search.search_database(parsed, user)
1238	    sp_results, sp_note = m365_search.search_sharepoint(parsed)
1239	    took_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
1240
1241	    merged = sorted(
1242	        db_results + sp_results,
1243	        key=lambda r: (
1244	            -r["score"],
1245	            -(r["date"].toordinal() if r.get("date") else 0),
1246	        ),
1247	    )[:MAX_RESULTS]
1248
1249	    if db_results and sp_results:
1250	        sources = "db+sharepoint"
1251	    elif db_results:
1252	        sources = "db"
1253	    elif sp_results:
1254	        sources = "sharepoint"
1255	    else:
1256	        sources = "none"
1257
1258	    SearchQueryLog.objects.create(
1259	        user=user,
1260	        question=question[:500],
1261	        parsed_filters=_parsed_dict(parsed),
1262	        result_count=len(merged),
1263	        sources=sources,
1264	        took_ms=took_ms,
1265	        error_note=sp_note if sp_note in ("unavailable", "search_fallback") else None,
1266	        created_by=user,
1267	    )
1268
1269	    results = [
1270	        {**{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != "score"}, "date": _iso_date(r.get("date"))}
1271	        for r in merged
1272	    ]
1273	    return {
1274	        "query": question,
1275	        "parsed": _parsed_dict(parsed),
1276	        "took_ms": took_ms,
1277	        "partial": sp_note in PARTIAL_NOTES,
1278	        "results": results,
1279	    }
1280	```

1385	# src/apps/assistant/views.py
1386	import json
1387
1388	from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
1389	from django.core.cache import caches
1390	from django.http import JsonResponse
1391	from django.shortcuts import render
1392	from django.views.decorators.cache import never_cache
1393	from django.views.decorators.http import require_POST
1394
1395	from . import services
1396
1397	RATE_LIMIT = 30
1398	RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS = 60
1399
1400
1401	def _throttle_ok(user) -> bool:
1402	    key = f"assistant:rl:{user.pk}"
1403	    try:
1404	        if caches["default"].add(key, 1, RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS):
1405	            return True
1406	        return caches["default"].incr(key) <= RATE_LIMIT
1407	    except ValueError:
1408	        return True
1409
1410
1411	@login_required
1412	def assistant_page(request):
1413	    return render(request, "assistant/chat.html")
1414
1415
1416	@login_required
1417	@require_POST
1418	@never_cache
1419	def api_search(request):
1420	    try:
1421	        data = json.loads(request.body.decode("utf-8") or "{}")
1422	    except json.JSONDecodeError:
1423	        return JsonResponse({"error": "invalid_json"}, status=400)
1424	    question = str(data.get("question", "")).strip()[:500]
1425	    if len(question) < 2:
1426	        return JsonResponse({"error": "question_too_short"}, status=400)
1427	    if not _throttle_ok(request.user):
1428	        return JsonResponse({"error": "rate_limited"}, status=429)
1429	    return JsonResponse(services.ask(question, request.user))
1430	```

1578	- [ ] **Step 4: JS**
1579
1580	```javascript
1581	/* src/static/js/assistant.js — chatbot UI, vanilla JS */
1582	(function () {
1583	  "use strict";
1584
1585	  function csrfToken() {
1586	    var match = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|; )csrftoken=([^;]+)/);
1587	    return match ? decodeURIComponent(match[1]) : "";
1588	  }
1589
1590	  function el(tag, className, text) {
1591	    var node = document.createElement(tag);
1592	    if (className) node.className = className;
1593	    if (text !== undefined) node.textContent = text;
1594	    return node;
1595	  }
1596
1597	  function renderResults(panel, payload) {
1598	    if (payload.partial) {
1599	      panel.appendChild(el("div", "assistant-warning",
1600	        "SharePoint tạm không khả dụng — chỉ hiển thị kết quả trong IHRMS."));
1601	    }
1602	    if (!payload.results || payload.results.length === 0) {
1603	      panel.appendChild(el("div", "assistant-msg assistant-msg-bot",
1604	        "Không tìm thấy tài liệu phù hợp trong phạm vi quyền của anh/chị."));
1605	      return;
1606	    }
1607	    var wrap = el("div", "assistant-msg assistant-msg-bot");
1608	    payload.results.forEach(function (r) {
1609	      var a = el("a", "assistant-result");
1610	      a.href = r.url || "#";
1611	      if (r.url && r.url.indexOf("http") === 0) { a.target = "_blank"; a.rel = "noopener"; }
1612	      a.appendChild(el("div", "assistant-result-title", r.title || "(không tên)"));
1613	      a.appendChild(el("div", "assistant-result-meta", r.meta || ""));
1614	      wrap.appendChild(a);
1615	    });
1616	    panel.appendChild(wrap);
1617	  }
1618
1619	  function ask(root, panel, question) {
1620	    panel.appendChild(el("div", "assistant-msg assistant-msg-user", question));
1621	    panel.scrollTop = panel.scrollHeight;
1622	    fetch(root.getAttribute("data-api"), {
1623	      method: "POST",
1624	      headers: {
1625	        "Content-Type": "application/json",
1626	        "X-CSRFToken": csrfToken()
1627	      },
1628	      body: JSON.stringify({ question: question })
1629	    }).then(function (resp) {
1630	      if (!resp.ok) {
1631	        return resp.json().then(function (data) {
1632	          throw new Error(data.error || ("HTTP " + resp.status));
1633	        });
1634	      }
1635	      return resp.json();
1636	    }).then(function (payload) {
1637	      renderResults(panel, payload);
1638	    }).catch(function (err) {
1639	      panel.appendChild(el("div", "assistant-error",
1640	        "Không thực hiện được truy vấn (" + err.message + "). Anh/chị thử lại sau."));
1641	    }).finally(function () {
1642	      panel.scrollTop = panel.scrollHeight;
1643	    });
1644	  }
1645
1646	  function initRoot(root) {
1647	    var panel = root.querySelector('[data-role="panel"]');
1648	    var form = root.querySelector('[data-role="form"]');
1649	    var input = form ? form.querySelector("input[name='question']") : null;
1650	    if (!panel || !form || !input) return;
1651	    form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
1652	      event.preventDefault();
1653	      var question = input.value.trim();
1654	      if (question.length < 2) return;
1655	      input.value = "";
1656	      ask(root, panel, question);
1657	    });
1658	    var chips = root.querySelectorAll(".assistant-chip");
1659	    Array.prototype.forEach.call(chips, function (chip) {
1660	      chip.addEventListener("click", function () {
1661	        ask(root, panel, chip.getAttribute("data-question"));
1662	      });
1663	    });
1664	  }
1665
1666	  function initFab(fab) {
1667	    var dock = document.getElementById("assistantDock");
1668	    if (!dock) return;
1669	    fab.addEventListener("click", function () {
1670	      if (window.innerWidth < 640) {
1671	        window.location.href = fab.getAttribute("data-page-url");
1672	        return;
1673	      }
1674	      if (dock.hidden && !dock.firstChild) {
1675	        var root = el("div", "assistant-root");
1676	        root.setAttribute("data-api", fab.getAttribute("data-api"));
1677	        var panel = el("div", "assistant-panel");
1678	        panel.setAttribute("data-role", "panel");
1679	        panel.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
1680	        var form = el("form", "assistant-form");
1681	        form.setAttribute("data-role", "form");
1682	        var input = el("input");
1683	        input.type = "text";
1684	        input.maxLength = 500;
1685	        input.setAttribute("aria-label", "Câu hỏi tìm tài liệu");
1686	        input.placeholder = "Nhập câu hỏi…";
1687	        var btn = el("button", "btn btn-primary", "Gửi");
1688	        btn.type = "submit";
1689	        form.appendChild(input);
1690	        form.appendChild(btn);
1691	        root.appendChild(panel);
1692	        root.appendChild(form);
1693	        dock.appendChild(root);
1694	        initRoot(root);
1695	      }
1696	      dock.hidden = !dock.hidden;
1697	      if (!dock.hidden) {
1698	        var first = dock.querySelector("input");
1699	        if (first) first.focus();
1700	      }
1701	    });
1702	    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
1703	      if (event.key === "Escape" && !dock.hidden) {
1704	        dock.hidden = true;
1705	        fab.focus();
1706	      }
1707	    });
1708	  }
1709
1710	  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
1711	    var fab = document.getElementById("assistantFab");
1712	    if (fab) initFab(fab);
1713	    var roots = document.querySelectorAll(".assistant-root");
1714	    Array.prototype.forEach.call(roots, initRoot);
1715	  });
1716
1717	  window.IHRMSAssistant = { initRoot: initRoot, initFab: initFab };
1718	})();
1719	```

From T2 onward every test command is `DB_ENGINE=django.db.backends.sqlite3 DB_NAME=db.sqlite3 …`, which lands on the gitignored `db.sqlite3`. 243	## F2 — admin RBAC (Important, plan-mandated)
244
245	Read `src/apps/common/admin.py` in full first (163 lines). Decision per the controller's ruling: **`BaseAuditAdmin` fits**, so the mixin escape hatch was not needed. Reasoning:
246
247	- `SearchQueryLog` *is* a `BaseAuditModel` (soft-delete manager + `all_objects`), which is exactly what `BaseAuditAdmin`/`RoleBasedAdminMixin` are written against — `_object_in_scope` reads `getattr(self.model, "all_objects", ...)` and `get_queryset` uses `all_objects` for the `show_deleted=1` path.
248	- Precedent for a log model on this base already exists: `SealUsageLogAdmin(BaseAuditAdmin)` at `src/apps/office/admin.py:98`.
249	- `BaseAuditAdmin` **requires no attributes that make no sense here**. Everything it adds is either correct or provably inert once add/change/delete are all `False` (verified below): `soft_delete_selected`/`restore_selected` carry `permissions=['delete']` so `_filter_actions_by_permissions` drops them, and `get_actions` additionally pops `delete_selected`.
250	- Minor 6 is satisfied by *inheriting* `BaseAuditAdmin.exclude` (`src/apps/common/admin.py:80`) rather than inventing a field list, as the controller directed.
251
252	`src/apps/assistant/admin.py` now subclasses `BaseAuditAdmin` and sets `view_roles = ("SUPER_ADMIN",)`; `has_add_permission`, `has_change_permission` and the new `has_delete_permission` all return `False`. Imports switched to the project's absolute form (`from apps.common.admin import BaseAuditAdmin`, `from apps.assistant.models import ...`), matching `apps/activity/admin.py` and `apps/office/admin.py`.
253
254	Behavioural verification (read-only introspection via `manage.py shell -c` with both SQLite overrides; no DB writes, no requests issued):

274	No `scope_queryset` override was added: with `view_roles = ("SUPER_ADMIN",)` the only non-superuser principal that can reach the queryset at all is a staff user whose role *is* `SUPER_ADMIN`, for whom a department/person scope is meaningless. The controller's ruling did not require one and adding one would have been speculative.

523	CREATE INDEX "tblAssistantSearchLog_CreatedBy_54c7535e" ON "tblAssistantSearchLog" ("CreatedBy");
524	CREATE INDEX "tblAssistantSearchLog_DeletedBy_d5ada8dd" ON "tblAssistantSearchLog" ("DeletedBy");
525	CREATE INDEX "tblAssistantSearchLog_ModifiedBy_195d7f59" ON "tblAssistantSearchLog" ("ModifiedBy");
526	CREATE INDEX "tblAssistantSearchLog_UserID_aa04b58f" ON "tblAssistantSearchLog" ("UserID");
527	COMMIT;
528	EXIT=0
529	```
530
531	### Comparison verdict
532
533	Both backends create **only** `tblAssistantSearchLog`: the 7 declared columns plus the 7 inherited `BaseAuditModel` columns, 4 FKs to `tblUser`, 4 supporting indexes, a JSON-validity check on `ParsedFilters`, and non-negative checks on `ResultCount`/`TookMs`. No other table is created or altered. The only differences are the expected backend dialect ones — `ISJSON()` vs `JSON_VALID()`, `datetimeoffset`/`nvarchar`/`bit` vs `datetime`/`varchar`/`bool`, inline-deferred vs separate FK constraints, and mssql emitting its `ALTER TABLE`/`CREATE INDEX` statements in a different (non-deterministic) order than the pre-fix capture. The DDL is otherwise **identical to the pre-fix outputs in the original report**: `Meta.ordering` is application-level and produces no DDL on either backend, so the Minor 4 fix caused no schema drift. Scope matches what the plan approved.

347	+- [ ] **Step 3: Viết implementation**
348	+
349	+```python
350	+# src/apps/assistant/nlp.py
351	+"""Parser câu hỏi tiếng Việt cho trợ lý tài liệu.
352	+
353	+Thuần quy tắc, deterministic, không LLM. Pipeline: số hiệu → cụm ngoặc kép →
354	+mốc thờ gian → loại văn bản → từ khóa còn lại (đã bỏ stopword).
355	+"""
356	+from __future__ import annotations
357	+
358	+import re
359	+import unicodedata
360	+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
361	+from datetime import date, timedelta
362	+
363	+DOC_NUMBER_RE = re.compile(
364	+    r"(?:số\s*)?(\d{1,5}\s*/\s*[A-Za-zÀ-ỹ0-9]+(?:\s*-\s*[A-Za-zÀ-ỹ0-9]+)*)",
365	+    re.IGNORECASE,
366	+)
367	+QUOTED_RE = re.compile(r'"([^"]+)"')
368	+MONTH_RE = re.compile(r"tháng\s+(\d{1,2})(?:\s*(?:năm|\/)\s*(\d{4}))?", re.IGNORECASE)
369	+QUARTER_RE = re.compile(r"quý\s+([1-4])(?:\s*năm\s*(\d{4}))?", re.IGNORECASE)
370	+YEAR_RE = re.compile(r"\bnăm\s+(\d{4})\b", re.IGNORECASE)
371	+FROM_TO_RE = re.compile(
372	+    r"từ\s+(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})\s*(?:đến|tới)\s+(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})",
373	+    re.IGNORECASE,
374	+)
375	+
376	+DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS = [
377	+    ("công văn đến", "Incoming"),
378	+    ("công văn đi", "Outgoing"),
379	+    ("văn bản chỉ đạo nội bộ", "InternalDirective"),
380	+    ("chỉ đạo nội bộ", "InternalDirective"),
381	+    ("văn bản nội bộ", "InternalDirective"),
382	+    ("quyết định", "personnel_decision"),
383	+    ("công văn", "dispatch"),
384	+    ("văn bản", "dispatch"),
385	+    ("tài liệu", "document"),
386	+]
387	+
388	+STOPWORDS = {
389	+    "tìm", "kiếm", "tìm kiếm", "cho", "tôi", "mình", "em", "anh", "chị", "bạn",
390	+    "xin", "hãy", "về", "củа", "củа", "va", "và", "các", "những", "một", "là",
391	+    "ở", "theo", "giúp", "với", "được", "bị", "trong", "ngoài", "từ", "đến",
392	+    "ngày", "nào", "này", "đó", "mới", "gần", "nhất", "gần đây", "liên quan",
393	+}
394	+
395	+_TYPE_TOKENS = set()
396	+for _label, _code in DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS:
397	+    _TYPE_TOKENS.update(_label.split())
398	+
399	+
400	+@dataclass
401	+class ParsedQuery:
402	+    doc_number: str | None = None
403	+    phrases: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
404	+    keywords: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
405	+    date_from: date | None = None
406	+    date_to: date | None = None
407	+    doc_type: str | None = None
408	+
409	+    def has_constraints(self) -> bool:
410	+        return bool(self.doc_number or self.phrases or self.keywords or self.date_from or self.date_to)
411	+
412	+
413	+def normalize(text: str) -> str:
414	+    return "".join(
415	+        c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text.casefold().replace("đ", "d"))
416	+        if not unicodedata.combining(c)
417	+    )
418	+
419	+
420	+def _last_day_of_month(year: int, month: int) -> date:
421	+    if month == 12:
422	+        return date(year, 12, 31)
423	+    return date(year, month + 1, 1) - timedelta(days=1)
424	+
425	+
426	+def _parse_iso(value: str) -> date:
427	+    for fmt in ("%d/%m/%Y", "%d-%m-%Y", "%Y-%m-%d"):
428	+        try:
429	+            return date.fromisoformat(value) if "%Y" == fmt[:2] else datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date()
430	+        except ValueError:
431	+            continue
432	+    raise ValueError(value)
433	+
434	+
435	+def _extract_dates(text: str, today: date) -> tuple[str, date | None, date | None]:
436	+    match = FROM_TO_RE.search(text)
437	+    if match:
438	+        start = _parse_iso(match.group(1).replace("-", "/") if "-" in match.group(1) and match.group(1).count("-") == 2 else match.group(1))
439	+        end = _parse_iso(match.group(2).replace("-", "/") if "-" in match.group(2) and match.group(2).count("-") == 2 else match.group(2))
440	+        return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], start, end)
441	+
442	+    lowered = text.casefold()
443	+    if "tuần trước" in lowered:
444	+        return (text.replace("tuần trước", "", 1), today - timedelta(days=7), today)
445	+    if "tháng trước" in lowered:
446	+        first = today.replace(day=1)
447	+        prev_end = first - timedelta(days=1)
448	+        return (text.replace("tháng trước", "", 1), prev_end.replace(day=1), prev_end)
449	+    if "năm ngoái" in lowered:
450	+        return (text.replace("năm ngoái", "", 1), date(today.year - 1, 1, 1), date(today.year - 1, 12, 31))
451	+
452	+    match = QUARTER_RE.search(text)
453	+    if match:
454	+        quarter = int(match.group(1))
455	+        year = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else today.year
456	+        start = date(year, quarter * 3 - 2, 1)
457	+        return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], start, _last_day_of_month(year, quarter * 3))
458	+
459	+    match = MONTH_RE.search(text)
460	+    if match:
461	+        month = int(match.group(1))
462	+        year = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else today.year
463	+        if 1 <= month <= 12:
464	+            start = date(year, month, 1)
465	+            return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], start, _last_day_of_month(year, month))
466	+
467	+    match = YEAR_RE.search(text)
468	+    if match:
469	+        year = int(match.group(1))
470	+        return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], date(year, 1, 1), date(year, 12, 31))
471	+
472	+    return (text, None, None)
473	+
474	+
475	+def parse(question: str, today: date | None = None) -> ParsedQuery:
476	+    today = today or date.today()
477	+    text = " ".join(question.split())[:500]
478	+    parsed = ParsedQuery()
479	+
480	+    match = QUOTED_RE.search(text)
481	+    if match:
482	+        parsed.phrases = [p.strip() for p in QUOTED_RE.findall(text) if p.strip()][:5]
483	+        text = QUOTED_RE.sub(" ", text)
484	+
485	+    match = DOC_NUMBER_RE.search(text)
486	+    if match:
487	+        parsed.doc_number = re.sub(r"\s+", "", match.group(1))
488	+        text = DOC_NUMBER_RE.sub(" ", text, count=1)
489	+
490	+    text, parsed.date_from, parsed.date_to = _extract_dates(text, today)
491	+
492	+    lowered = " " + normalize(text) + " "
493	+    for label, code in DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS:
494	+        if f" {normalize(label)} " in lowered:
495	+            parsed.doc_type = code
496	+            text = re.sub(re.escape(label), " ", text, count=1, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
497	+            break
498	+
499	+    if parsed.doc_type in ("Incoming", "Outgoing", "InternalDirective"):
500	+        pass  # giữ nguyên, đây là dispatch subtype
501	+    elif parsed.doc_type == "dispatch" and any(
502	+        normalize(k) in lowered for k in ("cong van den", "cong van di")
503	+    ):
504	+        # đã xử lý ở trên theo thứ tự ưu tiên; an toàn khi không trùng
505	+        pass
506	+
507	+    raw_tokens = text.split()
508	+    keywords: list[str] = []
509	+    for token in raw_tokens:
510	+        norm = normalize(token)
511	+        if len(norm) < 2 or norm in {normalize(w) for w in STOPWORDS} or norm in {normalize(t) for t in _TYPE_TOKENS}:
512	+            continue
513	+        keywords.append(norm)
514	+    parsed.keywords = keywords[:10]
515	+
516	+    if not parsed.has_constraints() and len(normalize(text).strip()) >= 2:
517	+        # fallback: toàn bộ câu (đã normalize) làm từ khóa tự do
518	+        parsed.keywords = [normalize(text).strip()[:200]]
519	+
520	+    return parsed
521	+```

643	+- [ ] **Step 3: Viết implementation**
644	+
645	+```python
646	+# src/apps/assistant/db_search.py
647	+"""Tìm kiếm tài liệu trong DB IHRMS theo ParsedQuery, tôn trọng RBAC hiện có.
648	+
649	+Mỗi nhánh dùng đúng quy tắc visibility của view tương ứng: dispatch dùng
650	+visible_dispatches_for; document chỉ status Approved; personnel decision theo
651	+manage_hr / approve_personnel_decision.
652	+"""
653	+from __future__ import annotations
654	+
655	+from django.db.models import Q
656	+from django.urls import reverse
657	+
658	+from apps.document.models import Document, OfficialDispatch, PersonnelDecision
659	+from apps.document.hcns.catalog import FORMS
660	+from apps.security.data_access import visible_dispatches_for
661	+from apps.security.permissions import has_permission
662	+
663	+from .nlp import ParsedQuery
664	+
665	+RECENT_LIMIT = 10
666	+SCAN_LIMIT = 50
667	+MAX_PER_TYPE = 15
668	+
669	+
670	+def _score(parsed: ParsedQuery, *, title: str, number: str = "", extra: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> int:
671	+    score = 0
672	+    if parsed.doc_number and parsed.doc_number.casefold() in (number or "").replace(" ", "").casefold():
673	+        score += 100
674	+    title_fold = (title or "").casefold()
675	+    for phrase in parsed.phrases:
676	+        if phrase.casefold() in title_fold:
677	+            score += 40
678	+    for kw in parsed.keywords:
679	+        if kw.casefold() in title_fold:
680	+            score += 10
681	+            continue
682	+        for value in extra:
683	+            if kw.casefold() in (value or "").casefold():
684	+                score += 5
685	+                break
686	+    return score
687	+
688	+
689	+def _has_constraints(parsed: ParsedQuery) -> bool:
690	+    return parsed.has_constraints()
691	+
692	+
693	+def _search_dispatches(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:
694	+    if parsed.doc_type == "document" or parsed.doc_type == "personnel_decision":
695	+        return []
696	+    qs = visible_dispatches_for(user, OfficialDispatch.objects.select_related("dispatch_book"))
697	+    if parsed.doc_type in ("Incoming", "Outgoing", "InternalDirective"):
698	+        qs = qs.filter(dispatch_type=parsed.doc_type)
699	+    if parsed.doc_number:
700	+        qs = qs.filter(
701	+            Q(dispatch_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number) | Q(original_doc_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)
702	+        )
703	+    elif _has_constraints(parsed):
704	+        text_q = Q()
705	+        for phrase in parsed.phrases:
706	+            text_q |= Q(title__icontains=phrase) | Q(issuing_organization__icontains=phrase)
707	+        for kw in parsed.keywords:
708	+            text_q |= Q(title__icontains=kw) | Q(issuing_organization__icontains=kw) | Q(dispatch_no__icontains=kw)
709	+        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()
710	+    if parsed.date_from:
711	+        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__gte=parsed.date_from)
712	+    if parsed.date_to:
713	+        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__lte=parsed.date_to)
714	+    if not _has_constraints(parsed):
715	+        qs = qs.order_by("-received_or_sent_date")[:RECENT_LIMIT]
716	+    rows = []
717	+    for d in qs.order_by("-received_or_sent_date")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:
718	+        title = f"[{d.get_dispatch_type_display()}] {d.dispatch_no} - {d.title}"
719	+        meta = f"{d.get_dispatch_type_display()} · {d.dispatch_no} · {d.issuing_organization}"
720	+        score = _score(parsed, title=d.title, number=f"{d.dispatch_no} {d.original_doc_no or ''}",
721	+                       extra=(d.issuing_organization, d.dispatch_no))
722	+        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:
723	+            continue
724	+        rows.append({
725	+            "source": "ihrms", "type": "official_dispatch", "title": title, "meta": meta,
726	+            "url": reverse("portal:dispatch_detail", args=[d.pk]),
727	+            "date": d.issue_date, "score": score,
728	+        })
729	+    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]
730	+
731	+
732	+def _search_documents(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:
733	+    if parsed.doc_type not in (None, "document") and parsed.doc_type not in ("Incoming", "Outgoing", "InternalDirective", "dispatch"):
734	+        if parsed.doc_type != "document":
735	+            return []
736	+    if parsed.doc_type == "personnel_decision":
737	+        return []
738	+    qs = Document.objects.filter(status="Approved").select_related("category")
739	+    if parsed.doc_number:
740	+        qs = qs.filter(document_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)
741	+    elif _has_constraints(parsed):
742	+        text_q = Q()
743	+        for phrase in parsed.phrases:
744	+            text_q |= Q(document_name__icontains=phrase) | Q(category__category_name__icontains=phrase)
745	+        for kw in parsed.keywords:
746	+            text_q |= Q(document_name__icontains=kw) | Q(document_no__icontains=kw)
747	+        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()
748	+    if parsed.date_from:
749	+        qs = qs.filter(effective_date__gte=parsed.date_from)
750	+    if parsed.date_to:
751	+        qs = qs.filter(effective_date__lte=parsed.date_to)
752	+    if not _has_constraints(parsed):
753	+        qs = qs.order_by("-effective_date")[:RECENT_LIMIT]
754	+    rows = []
755	+    for doc in qs.order_by("-effective_date")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:
756	+        score = _score(parsed, title=doc.document_name, number=doc.document_no,
757	+                       extra=(doc.category.category_name,))
758	+        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:
759	+            continue
760	+        rows.append({
761	+            "source": "ihrms", "type": "document",
762	+            "title": f"{doc.document_no} - {doc.document_name}",
763	+            "meta": f"Tài liệu · {doc.document_no} · {doc.category.category_name}",
764	+            "url": reverse("portal:document_list"),
765	+            "date": doc.effective_date, "score": score,
766	+        })
767	+    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]
768	+
769	+
770	+def _search_decisions(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:
771	+    if parsed.doc_type not in (None, "personnel_decision", "dispatch"):
772	+        return []
773	+    can_manage = has_permission(user, "manage_hr")
774	+    if not (can_manage or has_permission(user, "approve_personnel_decision")):
775	+        return []
776	+    qs = PersonnelDecision.objects.select_related("employee")
777	+    if not can_manage:
778	+        qs = qs.filter(Q(status="PendingApproval") | Q(history__created_by=user)).distinct()
779	+    if parsed.doc_number:
780	+        qs = qs.filter(decision_no__icontains=parsed.doc_number)
781	+    elif _has_constraints(parsed):
782	+        text_q = Q()
783	+        for phrase in parsed.phrases:
784	+            text_q |= Q(employee__full_name__icontains=phrase) | Q(decision_no__icontains=phrase)
785	+        for kw in parsed.keywords:
786	+            text_q |= Q(employee__full_name__icontains=kw) | Q(employee__employee_code__icontains=kw) | Q(decision_no__icontains=kw)
787	+        qs = qs.filter(text_q) if text_q else qs.none()
788	+    if parsed.date_from:
789	+        qs = qs.filter(decision_date__gte=parsed.date_from)
790	+    if parsed.date_to:
791	+        qs = qs.filter(decision_date__lte=parsed.date_to)
792	+    if not _has_constraints(parsed):
793	+        qs = qs.order_by("-created_date")[:RECENT_LIMIT]
794	+    rows = []
795	+    for dec in qs.order_by("-created_date")[:SCAN_LIMIT]:
796	+        template_title = FORMS.get(dec.template_slug, {}).get("title", dec.template_slug)
797	+        title = f"{dec.decision_no or dec.template_slug} - {template_title} - {dec.employee.full_name}"
798	+        score = _score(parsed, title=title, number=dec.decision_no,
799	+                       extra=(dec.employee.full_name, template_title))
800	+        if _has_constraints(parsed) and score == 0 and not parsed.doc_number:
801	+            continue
802	+        rows.append({
803	+            "source": "ihrms", "type": "personnel_decision", "title": title,
804	+            "meta": f"Quyết định · {dec.decision_no or '—'} · {template_title}",
805	+            "url": reverse("portal:personnel_decision_detail", args=[dec.pk]),
806	+            "date": dec.decision_date, "score": score,
807	+        })
808	+    return rows[:MAX_PER_TYPE]
809	+
810	+
811	+def search_database(parsed: ParsedQuery, user) -> list[dict]:
812	+    return (
813	+        _search_dispatches(parsed, user)
814	+        + _search_documents(parsed, user)
815	+        + _search_decisions(parsed, user)
816	+    )
817	+```

904	+- [ ] **Step 2: Chạy test, xác nhận fail** — `AttributeError: 'GraphClient' object has no attribute 'search_files'`.

906	+- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**
907	+
908	+```python
909	+    # thêm vào class GraphClient (sau get_metadata, trước get_web_url)
910	+    def search_files(self, query: str, top: int = 20) -> list[dict]:
911	+        """Tìm kiếm driveItem bằng Graph /search/query, giới hạn trong site IHRMS.
912	+
913	+        Cần app permission cho phép search (Sites.Read.All / Sites.ReadWrite.All).
914	+        GraphAPIError(403/400) nghĩa là chưa được consent — caller tự fallback.
915	+        """
916	+        self._require_configured()
917	+        payload = {
918	+            "requests": [{
919	+                "entityTypes": ["driveItem"],
920	+                "query": {"queryString": query[:200]},
921	+                "from": 0,
922	+                "size": top,
923	+                "fields": ["name", "webUrl", "lastModifiedDateTime"],
924	+            }]
925	+        }
926	+        data = self._request("POST", f"{GRAPH_BASE}/search/query", json=payload).json()
927	+        prefix = f"https://{self.site_hostname}{self.site_path}"
928	+        results = []
929	+        for block in data.get("value", []):
930	+            for container in block.get("hitsContainers", []):
931	+                for hit in container.get("hits", []):
932	+                    resource = hit.get("resource", {}) or {}
933	+                    web_url = resource.get("webUrl") or ""
934	+                    if web_url.startswith(prefix):
935	+                        results.append({
936	+                            "name": resource.get("name", ""),
937	+                            "web_url": web_url,
938	+                            "last_modified": resource.get("lastModifiedDateTime", ""),
939	+                        })
940	+                    if len(results) >= top:
941	+                        return results
942	+        return results
943	+
944	+    def list_folder_files(self, library_name: str, folder: str = "") -> list[dict]:
945	+        """Liệt kê tệp (không đệ quy) trong một thư mục của Document Library."""
946	+        drive_id = self._drive_id(library_name)
947	+        folder = (folder or "").strip("/")
948	+        base = f"{GRAPH_BASE}/drives/{drive_id}/root"
949	+        url = f"{base}:/{folder}:/children" if folder else f"{base}/children"
950	+        data = self._request("GET", url, params={"$top": 200}).json()
951	+        items = []
952	+        for entry in data.get("value", []):
953	+            if "folder" in entry:
954	+                continue
955	+            items.append({
956	+                "name": entry.get("name", ""),
957	+                "web_url": entry.get("webUrl", ""),
958	+                "last_modified": entry.get("lastModifiedDateTime", ""),
959	+            })
960	+        return items
961	+```

1063	+- [ ] **Step 2: Chạy test, xác nhận fail** — `ModuleNotFoundError: apps.assistant.m365_search`.

1065	+- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**
1066	+
1067	+```python
1068	+# src/apps/assistant/m365_search.py
1069	+"""Tìm kiếm tệp trên SharePoint cho chatbot qua GraphClient.
1070	+
1071	+Ưu tiên Graph /search/query; khi thiếu consent (403/400) fallback duyệt các
1072	+thư mục nghiệp vụ đã cấu hình và lọc theo tên tệp.
1073	+"""
1074	+from __future__ import annotations
1075	+
1076	+from django.conf import settings
1077	+
1078	+from apps.m365.graph_client import GraphAPIError, get_graph_client
1079	+
1080	+from .nlp import ParsedQuery, normalize
1081	+
1082	+MAX_RESULTS = 20
1083	+FALLBACK_LIMIT_PER_FOLDER = 50
1084	+
1085	+
1086	+def _fallback_folders() -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
1087	+    library = getattr(settings, "M365_SHAREPOINT_LIBRARY", "Documents") or "Documents"
1088	+    folders = [
1089	+        getattr(settings, "M365_FOLDER_DISPATCHES", "CongVan"),
1090	+        getattr(settings, "M365_FOLDER_INCOMING", "CongVanDen"),
1091	+        getattr(settings, "M365_FOLDER_OUTGOING", "CongVanDi"),
1092	+    ]
1093	+    seen, pairs = set(), []
1094	+    for folder in folders:
1095	+        folder = (folder or "").strip("/")
1096	+        if folder and folder not in seen:
1097	+            seen.add(folder)
1098	+            pairs.append((library, folder))
1099	+    pairs.append((library, ""))
1100	+    return pairs
1101	+
1102	+
1103	+def _to_result(hit: dict, parsed: ParsedQuery) -> dict:
1104	+    name = hit.get("name", "")
1105	+    name_fold = normalize(name)
1106	+    score = 0
1107	+    if parsed.doc_number and normalize(parsed.doc_number) in name_fold:
1108	+        score += 100
1109	+    for phrase in parsed.phrases:
1110	+        if normalize(phrase) in name_fold:
1111	+            score += 40
1112	+    for kw in parsed.keywords:
1113	+        if kw in name_fold:
1114	+            score += 10
1115	+    return {
1116	+        "source": "sharepoint",
1117	+        "type": "file",
1118	+        "title": name,
1119	+        "meta": "SharePoint",
1120	+        "url": hit.get("web_url", ""),
1121	+        "date": None,
1122	+        "score": score,
1123	+    }
1124	+
1125	+
1126	+def _fallback_listing(client, parsed: ParsedQuery) -> list[dict]:
1127	+    terms = [normalize(p) for p in parsed.phrases] + list(parsed.keywords)
1128	+    if parsed.doc_number:
1129	+        terms.append(normalize(parsed.doc_number))
1130	+    terms = [t for t in terms if t]
1131	+    if not terms:
1132	+        return []
1133	+    results: list[dict] = []
1134	+    for library, folder in _fallback_folders():
1135	+        try:
1136	+            hits = client.list_folder_files(library, folder)
1137	+        except GraphAPIError:
1138	+            continue
1139	+        for hit in hits:
1140	+            name_fold = normalize(hit.get("name", ""))
1141	+            if any(term in name_fold for term in terms):
1142	+                results.append(_to_result(hit, parsed))
1143	+        if len(results) >= MAX_RESULTS:
1144	+            break
1145	+    return results[:MAX_RESULTS]
1146	+
1147	+
1148	+def search_sharepoint(parsed: ParsedQuery) -> tuple[list[dict], str | None]:
1149	+    """Trả (results, error_note). error_note=None khi thành công hoặc không cấu hình.
1150	+
1151	+    'search_fallback' = search API thiếu quyền, đã duyệt thư mục thay thế.
1152	+    'unavailable'     = lỗi mạng/khác — caller trả kết quả DB kèm cờ partial.
1153	+    """
1154	+    client = get_graph_client()
1155	+    if not client.is_configured():
1156	+        return [], "not_configured"
1157	+    terms = list(parsed.phrases) + list(parsed.keywords)
1158	+    query = " ".join(terms)[:200] if terms else (parsed.doc_number or "")
1159	+    if not query.strip():
1160	+        return [], None
1161	+    try:
1162	+        hits = client.search_files(query, top=MAX_RESULTS)
1163	+    except GraphAPIError as exc:
1164	+        if exc.status_code in (403, 400):
1165	+            return _fallback_listing(client, parsed), "search_fallback"
1166	+        return [], "unavailable"
1167	+    return [_to_result(hit, parsed) for hit in hits], None
1168	+```

1260	+- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**
1261	+
1262	+```python
1263	+# src/apps/assistant/services.py
1264	+"""Ghép nguồn, xếp hạng và ghi nhật ký truy vấn chatbot."""
1265	+from __future__ import annotations
1266	+
1267	+import time
1268	+from dataclasses import asdict
1269	+
1270	+from . import db_search, m365_search, nlp
1271	+from .models import SearchQueryLog
1272	+
1273	+MAX_RESULTS = 20
1274	+PARTIAL_NOTES = ("unavailable", "search_fallback")
1275	+
1276	+
1277	+def _iso_date(value):
1278	+    return value.isoformat() if hasattr(value, "isoformat") else None
1279	+
1280	+
1281	+def _parsed_dict(parsed: nlp.ParsedQuery) -> dict:
1282	+    data = asdict(parsed)
1283	+    data["date_from"] = _iso_date(parsed.date_from)
1284	+    data["date_to"] = _iso_date(parsed.date_to)
1285	+    return data
1286	+
1287	+
1288	+def ask(question: str, user) -> dict:
1289	+    parsed = nlp.parse(question)
1290	+    started = time.perf_counter()
1291	+    db_results = db_search.search_database(parsed, user)
1292	+    sp_results, sp_note = m365_search.search_sharepoint(parsed)
1293	+    took_ms = int((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
1294	+
1295	+    merged = sorted(
1296	+        db_results + sp_results,
1297	+        key=lambda r: (
1298	+            -r["score"],
1299	+            -(r["date"].toordinal() if r.get("date") else 0),
1300	+        ),
1301	+    )[:MAX_RESULTS]
1302	+
1303	+    if db_results and sp_results:
1304	+        sources = "db+sharepoint"
1305	+    elif db_results:
1306	+        sources = "db"
1307	+    elif sp_results:
1308	+        sources = "sharepoint"
1309	+    else:
1310	+        sources = "none"
1311	+
1312	+    SearchQueryLog.objects.create(
1313	+        user=user,
1314	+        question=question[:500],
1315	+        parsed_filters=_parsed_dict(parsed),
1316	+        result_count=len(merged),
1317	+        sources=sources,
1318	+        took_ms=took_ms,
1319	+        error_note=sp_note if sp_note in ("unavailable", "search_fallback") else None,
1320	+        created_by=user,
1321	+    )
1322	+
1323	+    results = [
1324	+        {**{k: v for k, v in r.items() if k != "score"}, "date": _iso_date(r.get("date"))}
1325	+        for r in merged
1326	+    ]
1327	+    return {
1328	+        "query": question,
1329	+        "parsed": _parsed_dict(parsed),
1330	+        "took_ms": took_ms,
1331	+        "partial": sp_note in PARTIAL_NOTES,
1332	+        "results": results,
1333	+    }
1334	+```

1436	+- [ ] **Step 3: Implementation**
1437	+
1438	+```python
1439	+# src/apps/assistant/views.py
1440	+import json
1441	+
1442	+from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
1443	+from django.core.cache import caches
1444	+from django.http import JsonResponse
1445	+from django.shortcuts import render
1446	+from django.views.decorators.cache import never_cache
1447	+from django.views.decorators.http import require_POST
1448	+
1449	+from . import services
1450	+
1451	+RATE_LIMIT = 30
1452	+RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS = 60
1453	+
1454	+
1455	+def _throttle_ok(user) -> bool:
1456	+    key = f"assistant:rl:{user.pk}"
1457	+    try:
1458	+        if caches["default"].add(key, 1, RATE_WINDOW_SECONDS):
1459	+            return True
1460	+        return caches["default"].incr(key) <= RATE_LIMIT
1461	+    except ValueError:
1462	+        return True
1463	+
1464	+
1465	+@login_required
1466	+def assistant_page(request):
1467	+    return render(request, "assistant/chat.html")
1468	+
1469	+
1470	+@login_required
1471	+@require_POST
1472	+@never_cache
1473	+def api_search(request):
1474	+    try:
1475	+        data = json.loads(request.body.decode("utf-8") or "{}")
1476	+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
1477	+        return JsonResponse({"error": "invalid_json"}, status=400)
1478	+    question = str(data.get("question", "")).strip()[:500]
1479	+    if len(question) < 2:
1480	+        return JsonResponse({"error": "question_too_short"}, status=400)
1481	+    if not _throttle_ok(request.user):
1482	+        return JsonResponse({"error": "rate_limited"}, status=429)
1483	+    return JsonResponse(services.ask(question, request.user))
1484	+```

Ruling: **test runs use a SQLite override** — `.env` sets `DB_ENGINE=mssql`, and `manage.py test` under that config would create `test_<DB_NAME>` on the user's shared SQL Server instance. Every implementer runs `DB_ENGINE=django.db.backends.sqlite3 <venv python> manage.py test …`. `sqlmigrate` under the mssql config is still allowed (it collects SQL, executes nothing). The SQL Server *test-database* run in T1 Step 5 / T10 Step 1 is deferred until the user confirms the instance is a test one. Cost if wrong: slower feedback only; no server side effects.

Ruling: **model selection is unavailable in this harness** (the Agent tool exposes no model parameter), so every subagent inherits the session model. Recorded per SKILL.md Model Selection.

Ruling: **the SQLite override must also pin `DB_NAME`** — `.env` sets `DB_NAME` to the SQL Server database name, so overriding only `DB_ENGINE` makes Django create a stray untracked SQLite file named after the production DB (`src/qlhcns`, observed during T1). From T2 onward every test command is `DB_ENGINE=django.db.backends.sqlite3 DB_NAME=db.sqlite3 …`, which lands on the gitignored `db.sqlite3`. The stray `src/qlhcns` (and any `test_qlhcns`) is deleted once T1's run finishes; it must never be staged. Cost if wrong: untracked junk in the repo, and a real risk of someone committing a file named after the production database.

Ruling: **work happens on `main`**, not a worktree. SKILL.md forbids implementing on main without consent, but AGENTS.md mandates a single `main` branch with no worktrees, and user instructions outrank skills. The user approved this plan and this execution mode. Cost if wrong: no isolated rollback point beyond git history — mitigated by one commit per task.

Cost if wrong: a user's search history disappears with the user — acceptable for this data class.

243	## F2 — admin RBAC (Important, plan-mandated)
244
245	Read `src/apps/common/admin.py` in full first (163 lines). Decision per the controller's ruling: **`BaseAuditAdmin` fits**, so the mixin escape hatch was not needed. Reasoning:
246
247	- `SearchQueryLog` *is* a `BaseAuditModel` (soft-delete manager + `all_objects`), which is exactly what `BaseAuditAdmin`/`RoleBasedAdminMixin` are written against — `_object_in_scope` reads `getattr(self.model, "all_objects", ...)` and `get_queryset` uses `all_objects` for the `show_deleted=1` path.
248	- Precedent for a log model on this base already exists: `SealUsageLogAdmin(BaseAuditAdmin)` at `src/apps/office/admin.py:98`.
249	- `BaseAuditAdmin` **requires no attributes that make no sense here**. Everything it adds is either correct or provably inert once add/change/delete are all `False` (verified below): `soft_delete_selected`/`restore_selected` carry `permissions=['delete']` so `_filter_actions_by_permissions` drops them, and `get_actions` additionally pops `delete_selected`.
250	- Minor 6 is satisfied by *inheriting* `BaseAuditAdmin.exclude` (`src/apps/common/admin.py:80`) rather than inventing a field list, as the controller directed.
251
252	`src/apps/assistant/admin.py` now subclasses `BaseAuditAdmin` and sets `view_roles = ("SUPER_ADMIN",)`; `has_add_permission`, `has_change_permission` and the new `has_delete_permission` all return `False`. Imports switched to the project's absolute form (`from apps.common.admin import BaseAuditAdmin`, `from apps.assistant.models import ...`), matching `apps/activity/admin.py` and `apps/office/admin.py`.
253
254	Behavioural verification (read-only introspection via `manage.py shell -c` with both SQLite overrides; no DB writes, no requests issued):

The controller's ruling did not require one and adding one would have been speculative.

531	### Comparison verdict
532
533	Both backends create **only** `tblAssistantSearchLog`: the 7 declared columns plus the 7 inherited `BaseAuditModel` columns, 4 FKs to `tblUser`, 4 supporting indexes, a JSON-validity check on `ParsedFilters`, and non-negative checks on `ResultCount`/`TookMs`. No other table is created or altered. The only differences are the expected backend dialect ones — `ISJSON()` vs `JSON_VALID()`, `datetimeoffset`/`nvarchar`/`bit` vs `datetime`/`varchar`/`bool`, inline-deferred vs separate FK constraints, and mssql emitting its `ALTER TABLE`/`CREATE INDEX` statements in a different (non-deterministic) order than the pre-fix capture. The DDL is otherwise **identical to the pre-fix outputs in the original report**: `Meta.ordering` is application-level and produces no DDL on either backend, so the Minor 4 fix caused no schema drift. Scope matches what the plan approved.

347	+- [ ] **Step 3: Viết implementation**
348	+
349	+```python
350	+# src/apps/assistant/nlp.py
351	+"""Parser câu hỏi tiếng Việt cho trợ lý tài liệu.
352	+
353	+Thuần quy tắc, deterministic, không LLM. Pipeline: số hiệu → cụm ngoặc kép →
354	+mốc thờ gian → loại văn bản → từ khóa còn lại (đã bỏ stopword).
355	+"""
356	+from __future__ import annotations
357	+
358	+import re
359	+import unicodedata
360	+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
361	+from datetime import date, timedelta
362	+
363	+DOC_NUMBER_RE = re.compile(
364	+    r"(?:số\s*)?(\d{1,5}\s*/\s*[A-Za-zÀ-ỹ0-9]+(?:\s*-\s*[A-Za-zÀ-ỹ0-9]+)*)",
365	+    re.IGNORECASE,
366	+)
367	+QUOTED_RE = re.compile(r'"([^"]+)"')
368	+MONTH_RE = re.compile(r"tháng\s+(\d{1,2})(?:\s*(?:năm|\/)\s*(\d{4}))?", re.IGNORECASE)
369	+QUARTER_RE = re.compile(r"quý\s+([1-4])(?:\s*năm\s*(\d{4}))?", re.IGNORECASE)
370	+YEAR_RE = re.compile(r"\bnăm\s+(\d{4})\b", re.IGNORECASE)
371	+FROM_TO_RE = re.compile(
372	+    r"từ\s+(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})\s*(?:đến|tới)\s+(\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{1,2}[\/\-]\d{4})",
373	+    re.IGNORECASE,
374	+)
375	+
376	+DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS = [
377	+    ("công văn đến", "Incoming"),
378	+    ("công văn đi", "Outgoing"),
379	+    ("văn bản chỉ đạo nội bộ", "InternalDirective"),
380	+    ("chỉ đạo nội bộ", "InternalDirective"),
381	+    ("văn bản nội bộ", "InternalDirective"),
382	+    ("quyết định", "personnel_decision"),
383	+    ("công văn", "dispatch"),
384	+    ("văn bản", "dispatch"),
385	+    ("tài liệu", "document"),
386	+]
387	+
388	+STOPWORDS = {
389	+    "tìm", "kiếm", "tìm kiếm", "cho", "tôi", "mình", "em", "anh", "chị", "bạn",
390	+    "xin", "hãy", "về", "củа", "củа", "va", "và", "các", "những", "một", "là",
391	+    "ở", "theo", "giúp", "với", "được", "bị", "trong", "ngoài", "từ", "đến",
392	+    "ngày", "nào", "này", "đó", "mới", "gần", "nhất", "gần đây", "liên quan",
393	+}
394	+
395	+_TYPE_TOKENS = set()
396	+for _label, _code in DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS:
397	+    _TYPE_TOKENS.update(_label.split())
398	+
399	+
400	+@dataclass
401	+class ParsedQuery:
402	+    doc_number: str | None = None
403	+    phrases: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
404	+    keywords: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
405	+    date_from: date | None = None
406	+    date_to: date | None = None
407	+    doc_type: str | None = None
408	+
409	+    def has_constraints(self) -> bool:
410	+        return bool(self.doc_number or self.phrases or self.keywords or self.date_from or self.date_to)
411	+
412	+
413	+def normalize(text: str) -> str:
414	+    return "".join(
415	+        c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text.casefold().replace("đ", "d"))
416	+        if not unicodedata.combining(c)
417	+    )
418	+
419	+
420	+def _last_day_of_month(year: int, month: int) -> date:
421	+    if month == 12:
422	+        return date(year, 12, 31)
423	+    return date(year, month + 1, 1) - timedelta(days=1)
424	+
425	+
426	+def _parse_iso(value: str) -> date:
427	+    for fmt in ("%d/%m/%Y", "%d-%m-%Y", "%Y-%m-%d"):
428	+        try:
429	+            return date.fromisoformat(value) if "%Y" == fmt[:2] else datetime.strptime(value, fmt).date()
430	+        except ValueError:
431	+            continue
432	+    raise ValueError(value)
433	+
434	+
435	+def _extract_dates(text: str, today: date) -> tuple[str, date | None, date | None]:
436	+    match = FROM_TO_RE.search(text)
437	+    if match:
438	+        start = _parse_iso(match.group(1).replace("-", "/") if "-" in match.group(1) and match.group(1).count("-") == 2 else match.group(1))
439	+        end = _parse_iso(match.group(2).replace("-", "/") if "-" in match.group(2) and match.group(2).count("-") == 2 else match.group(2))
440	+        return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], start, end)
441	+
442	+    lowered = text.casefold()
443	+    if "tuần trước" in lowered:
444	+        return (text.replace("tuần trước", "", 1), today - timedelta(days=7), today)
445	+    if "tháng trước" in lowered:
446	+        first = today.replace(day=1)
447	+        prev_end = first - timedelta(days=1)
448	+        return (text.replace("tháng trước", "", 1), prev_end.replace(day=1), prev_end)
449	+    if "năm ngoái" in lowered:
450	+        return (text.replace("năm ngoái", "", 1), date(today.year - 1, 1, 1), date(today.year - 1, 12, 31))
451	+
452	+    match = QUARTER_RE.search(text)
453	+    if match:
454	+        quarter = int(match.group(1))
455	+        year = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else today.year
456	+        start = date(year, quarter * 3 - 2, 1)
457	+        return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], start, _last_day_of_month(year, quarter * 3))
458	+
459	+    match = MONTH_RE.search(text)
460	+    if match:
461	+        month = int(match.group(1))
462	+        year = int(match.group(2)) if match.group(2) else today.year
463	+        if 1 <= month <= 12:
464	+            start = date(year, month, 1)
465	+            return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], start, _last_day_of_month(year, month))
466	+
467	+    match = YEAR_RE.search(text)
468	+    if match:
469	+        year = int(match.group(1))
470	+        return (text[:match.start()] + " " + text[match.end():], date(year, 1, 1), date(year, 12, 31))
471	+
472	+    return (text, None, None)
473	+
474	+
475	+def parse(question: str, today: date | None = None) -> ParsedQuery:
476	+    today = today or date.today()
477	+    text = " ".join(question.split())[:500]
478	+    parsed = ParsedQuery()
479	+
480	+    match = QUOTED_RE.search(text)
481	+    if match:
482	+        parsed.phrases = [p.strip() for p in QUOTED_RE.findall(text) if p.strip()][:5]
483	+        text = QUOTED_RE.sub(" ", text)
484	+
485	+    match = DOC_NUMBER_RE.search(text)
486	+    if match:
487	+        parsed.doc_number = re.sub(r"\s+", "", match.group(1))
488	+        text = DOC_NUMBER_RE.sub(" ", text, count=1)
489	+
490	+    text, parsed.date_from, parsed.date_to = _extract_dates(text, today)
491	+
492	+    lowered = " " + normalize(text) + " "
493	+    for label, code in DOC_TYPE_KEYWORDS:
494	+        if f" {normalize(label)} " in lowered:
495	+            parsed.doc_type = code
496	+            text = re.sub(re.escape(label), " ", text, count=1, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
497	+            break
498	+
499	+    if parsed.doc_type in ("Incoming", "Outgoing", "InternalDirective"):
500	+        pass  # giữ nguyên, đây là dispatch subtype
501	+    elif parsed.doc_type == "dispatch" and any(
502	+        normalize(k) in lowered for k in ("cong van den", "cong van di")
503	+    ):
504	+        # đã xử lý ở trên theo thứ tự ưu tiên; an toàn khi không trùng
505	+        pass
506	+
507	+    raw_tokens = text.split()
508	+    keywords: list[str] = []
509	+    for token in raw_tokens:
510	+        norm = normalize(token)
511	+        if len(norm) < 2 or norm in {normalize(w) for w in STOPWORDS} or norm in {normalize(t) for t in _TYPE_TOKENS}:
512	+            continue
513	+        keywords.append(norm)
514	+    parsed.keywords = keywords[:10]
515	+
516	+    if not parsed.has_constraints() and len(normalize(text).strip()) >= 2:
517	+        # fallback: toàn bộ câu (đã normalize) làm từ khóa tự do
518	+        parsed.keywords = [normalize(text).strip()[:200]]
519	+
520	+    return parsed
521	+```
